verses.text: Uhoraho avugana na Mose ari mw’Ihema ry’Ibonaniro mu bugaragwa bw’i Sinayi ku musi wa mbere w’ukwezi kwa kabiri, mu mwaka ugira kabiri Abisirayeli bavuye muri Egiputa, amubwira ati:
“Harura Abisirayeli bose ukurikije imiryango yabo n’inzu zabo, ushire ku rutonde amazina y’ingabo kandi uharure umwumwe.
Mwe na Aroni muze muharure abagabo bose b’Abisirayeli bamaze imyaka mirongo ibiri canke irenga, bashobora kuja ku rugamba, mubashire mu migwi yabo.
Umugabo aserukira umuryango akaba n’umukuru wawo azobafashe muri ico gikorwa.
Aya ni yo mazina y’abazogufasha: mu muryango wa Reyubeni, ni Elisuri mwene Shedewuri;
mu muryango wa Simeyoni, ni Shelumiyeli mwene Zurishadayi;
mu muryango wa Yuda, ni Nahashoni mwene Aminadabu;
mu muryango wa Isakari, ni Netaneli mwene Zuwari;
mu muryango wa Zebuloni, ni Eliyabu mwene Heloni;
muri bene Yosefu: mu muryango wa Efurayimu, ni Elishama mwene Amihudi; mu muryango wa Manase, ni Gamaliyeli mwene Pedasuri;
mu muryango wa Benyamini, ni Abidani mwene Gidiyoni;
mu muryango wa Dani, ni Ahiyezeri mwene Amishadayi;
mu muryango wa Asheri, ni Pagiyeli mwene Okurani;
mu muryango wa Gadi, ni Eliyasafu mwene Dewuyeli;
mu muryango wa Nafutali, ni Ahira mwene Enani.”
Abo ni bo batowe mw’ihanga ryose, bakaba bari abakuru b’imiryango ya ba sekuruza babo. Ni bo kandi bari abakuru b’amazu y’imiryango ya Isirayeli.
Nuko Mose na Aroni begeranya abo bantu batowe,

baca batumako ikoraniro ry’ihanga ryose ku musi wa mbere w’ukwezi kwa kabiri. Abantu bariyandikisha bakurikije amazu yabo n’imiryango yabo, hanyuma abagabo bakwije imyaka mirongo ibiri n’iyirenga barandikwa, umwumwe wese ku rutonde rw’amazina,
nk’uko Uhoraho yari yategetse Mose. Yabaharuriye mu bugaragwa bw’i Sinayi.

Mu bakomoka kuri Reyubeni imfura ya Isirayeli: Abagabo bose bari bamaze imyaka mirongo ibiri n’iyirenga bashobora kuja ku rugamba barandikwa, amazina y’umwumwe wese ashirwa ku rutonde, hakurikijwe amazu ya ba sekuruza n’imiryango yabo.
Igitigiri c’abakomoka kuri Reyubeni cari ibihumbi mirongo ine na bitandatu n’amajana atanu.

Mu bakomoka kuri Simeyoni: Abagabo bose bari bamaze imyaka mirongo ibiri n’iyirenga bashobora kuja ku rugamba barandikwa, amazina y’umwumwe wese ashirwa ku rutonde, hakurikijwe amazu ya ba sekuruza n’imiryango yabo.
Igitigiri c’abakomoka kuri Simeyoni cari ibihumbi mirongo itanu n’icenda n’amajana atatu.

Mu bakomoka kuri Gadi: Abagabo bose bari bamaze imyaka mirongo ibiri n’iyirenga bashobora kuja ku rugamba barandikwa, amazina y’umwumwe wese ashirwa ku rutonde, hakurikijwe amazu ya ba sekuruza n’imiryango yabo.
Igitigiri c’abakomoka kuri Gadi cari ibihumbi mirongo ine na bitanu n’amajana atandatu na mirongo itanu.

Mu bakomoka kuri Yuda: Abagabo bose bari bamaze imyaka mirongo ibiri n’iyirenga bashobora kuja ku rugamba barandikwa, amazina y’umwumwe wese ashirwa ku rutonde, hakurikijwe amazu ya ba sekuruza n’imiryango yabo.
Igitigiri c’abakomoka kuri Yuda cari ibihumbi mirongo indwi na bine n’amajana atandatu.

Mu bakomoka kuri Isakari: Abagabo bose bari bamaze imyaka mirongo ibiri n’iyirenga bashobora kuja ku rugamba barandikwa, amazina y’umwumwe wese ashirwa ku rutonde, hakurikijwe amazu ya ba sekuruza n’imiryango yabo.
Igitigiri c’abakomoka kuri Isakari cari ibihumbi mirongo itanu na bine n’amajana ane.

Mu bakomoka kuri Zebuloni: Abagabo bose bari bamaze imyaka mirongo ibiri n’iyirenga bashobora kuja ku rugamba barandikwa, amazina y’umwumwe wese ashirwa ku rutonde, hakurikijwe amazu ya ba sekuruza n’imiryango yabo.
Igitigiri c’abakomoka kuri Zebuloni cari ibihumbi mirongo itanu n’indwi n’amajana ane.

Abo mu bahungu ba Yosefu: Mu bakomoka kuri Efurayimu, Abagabo bose bari bamaze imyaka mirongo ibiri n’iyirenga bashobora kuja ku rugamba barandikwa, amazina y’umwumwe wese ashirwa ku rutonde, hakurikijwe amazu ya ba sekuruza n’imiryango yabo.
Igitigiri c’abakomoka kuri Efurayimu cari ibihumbi mirongo ine n’amajana atanu.

Mu bakomoka kuri Manase, Abagabo bose bari bamaze imyaka mirongo ibiri n’iyirenga bashobora kuja ku rugamba barandikwa, amazina y’umwe umwe wese ashirwa ku rutonde, hakurikijwe amazu ya ba sekuruza n’imiryango yabo.
Igitigiri c’abakomoka kuri Manase cari ibihumbi mirongo itatu na bibiri n’amajana abiri.

Mu bakomoka kuri Benyamini: Abagabo bose bari bamaze imyaka mirongo ibiri n’iyirenga bashobora kuja ku rugamba barandikwa, amazina y’umwe umwe wese ashirwa ku rutonde, hakurikijwe amazu ya ba sekuruza n’imiryango yabo.
Igitigiri c’abakomoka kuri Benyamini cari ibihumbi mirongo itatu na bitanu n’amajana ane.

Mu bakomoka kuri Dani: Abagabo bose bari bamaze imyaka mirongo ibiri n’iyirenga bashobora kuja ku rugamba barandikwa, amazina y’umwumwe wese ashirwa ku rutonde, hakurikijwe amazu ya ba sekuruza n’imiryango yabo.
Igitigiri c’abakomoka kuri Dani cari ibihumbi mirongo itandatu na bibiri n’amajana indwi.

Mu bakomoka kuri Asheri: Abagabo bose bari bamaze imyaka mirongo ibiri n’iyirenga bashobora kuja ku rugamba barandikwa, amazina y’umwumwe wese ashirwa ku rutonde, hakurikijwe amazu ya ba sekuruza n’imiryango yabo.
Igitigiri c’abakomoka kuri Asheri cari ibihumbi mirongo ine na kimwe n’amajana atanu.

Mu bakomoka kuri Nafutali: Abagabo bose bari bamaze imyaka mirongo ibiri n’iyirenga bashobora kuja ku rugamba barandikwa, amazina y’umwumwe wese ashirwa ku rutonde, hakurikijwe amazu ya ba sekuruza n’imiryango yabo.
Igitigiri c’abakomoka kuri Nafutali cari ibihumbi mirongo itanu na bitatu n’amajana ane.
Abo ni bo bagabo baharuwe na Mose na Aroni na ba bakuru icumi na babiri batowe mu Bisirayeli, umwe wese aserukira umuryango na ba sekuruza akomokako.
Abisirayeli bose bari bamaze imyaka mirongo ibiri n’iyirenga bashobora kuja ku rugamba baraharuwe hakurikijwe amazu ya ba sekuruza n’imiryango yabo.
Igitigiri cabo bose hamwe cari ibihumbi amajana atandatu na bitatu n’amajana atanu na mirongo itanu.
Ariko abakomoka kuri Lewi ntibaharuwe hamwe n’abandi.
Uhoraho yari yarabariye Mose ati:
“Ntimuze muharure abakomoka kuri Lewi canke ngo mubashire hamwe n’abandi mu guharura Abisirayeli.

Ariko, Abalewi uzobazeze igikorwa co kwitaho ivyo mw’ihema ry’ibonaniro, bazezwe ibikoresho vyaho hamwe n’ibintu vyose biri muri ryo. Ni bo bazoterura ihema n’ibikoresho vyaryo vyose; baze baryitwararike kandi bacumbike barikikuje.
Igihe cose bizoba bikenewe ko ihema ryimurwa, Abalewi baze bazobe ari bo barizinga, na ho bikenewe ko rishingwa, Abalewi bazobe ari bo barishinga. Uwundi muntu wese azoryegera aze yicwe.
Abisirayeli baze bashinge amahema yabo mu migwi, umuntu wese azobe mu muce agenewe, abe musi y’ibendera ryabo.
Ariko Abalewi bo baze bashinge amahema yabo bakikuje iryo hema ry’isezerano kugira ngo simpave ndakira Abisirayeli. Abalewi ni bo bajejwe kwitaho ihema ry’isezerano.”
Nuko Abisirayeli bakora vyose nk’uko Uhoraho yari yabitegetse Mose.
Uhoraho abarira Mose na Aroni ati:
“Abisirayeli baze bacumbike bakikuje Ihema ry’Ibonaniro ariko bataryegereye cane, umuntu wese azobe musi y’ibendera ry’umuryango wiwe no musi y’ibendera ry’inzu yiwe.”
Mu buseruko hazobe hari: Abakomoka kuri Yuda bari musi y’ibendera ryabo. Umukuru wabo ni Nahashoni mwene Aminadabu.
Igitigiri c’umugwi wabo ni ibihumbi mirongo indwi na bine n’amajana atandatu.
Abakomoka kuri Isakari baze bakurikire. Umukuru wabo ni Netaneli mwene Zuwari.
Igitigiri c’umugwi wabo ni ibihumbi mirongo itanu na bine n’amajana ane.
Abakomoka kuri Zebuloni baze bakurikire. Umukuru wabo ni Eliyabu mwene Heloni.
Igitigiri c’umugwi wabo ni ibihumbi mirongo itanu n’indwi n’amajana ane.

Abagabo bose bazoba bari ku ruhande rwa Yuda, nk’uko imigwi yabo iri, ni ibihumbi ijana na mirongo umunani na bitandatu n’amajana ane. Abo ni bo bazoja imbere y’Abisirayeli. Ni bo bazofata inzira ubwa mbere.
Mu bumanuko hazoba hari: Abakomoka kuri Reyubeni, bari musi y’ibendera ryabo. Umukuru wabo ni Elisuri mwene Shedewuri.
Igitigiri c’umugwi wabo ni ibihumbi mirongo ine na bitandatu n’amajana atanu.
Abakomoka kuri Simeyoni baze bakurikire. Umukuru wabo ni Shelumiyeli mwene Zurishadayi.
Igitigiri c’umugwi wabo ni ibihumbi mirongo itanu n’icenda n’amajana atatu.
Abakomoka kuri Gadi baze bakurikire. Umukuru wabo ni Eliyasafu mwene Reyuweli
Igitigiri c’umugwi wabo ni ibihumbi mirongo ine na bitanu n’amajana atandatu na mirongo itanu.
Abagabo bose bazoba bari ku ruhande rwa Reyubeni, nk’uko imigwi yabo iri, ni ibihumbi ijana na mirongo itanu na kimwe n’amajana ane na mirongo itanu. Ni bo bazofata inzira ubwa kabiri.

Hanyuma haze hakurikire ihema ry’ibonaniro n’abakomoka kuri Lewi, bagendere hagati y’iyindi migwi. Baze bakurikirane mu guhaguruka nk’uko bakurikirana mu gucumbika, umwe wese mu kibanza ciwe, kandi ari musi y’ibendera ryabo.
Mu burengero hazoba hari: Abakomoka kuri Efurayimu, bari musi y’ibendera ryabo. Umukuru wabo ni Elishama mwene Amihudi.
Igitigiri c’umugwi wabo ni ibihumbi mirongo ine n’amajana atanu.
Abakomoka kuri Manase baze bakurikire. Umukuru wabo ni Gamaliyeli mwene Pedasuri.
Igitigiri c’umugwi wabo ni ibihumbi mirongo itatu na bibiri n’amajana abiri.
Abakomoka kuri Benyamini baze bakurikire. Umukuru wabo ni Abidani mwene Gidiyoni.
Igitigiri c’umugwi wabo ni ibihumbi mirongo itatu na bitanu n’amajana ane.
Abagabo bose bazoba bari ku ruhande rwa Efurayimu, nk’uko imigwi yabo iri, ni ibihumbi ijana n’umunani n’ijana. Baze bafate inzira ubwa gatatu.
Mu buraruko hazoba hari: Abakomoka kuri Dani bari musi y’ibendera ryabo. Umukuru wabo ni Ahiyezeri mwene Amishadayi.
Igitigiri c’umugwi wabo ni ibihumbi mirongo itandatu na bibiri n’amajana indwi.
Abakomoka kuri Asheri baze bakurikire. Umukuru wabo ni Pagiyeli mwene Okurani.
Igitigiri c’umugwi wabo ni ibihumbi mirongo ine na kimwe n’amajana atanu.
Abakomoka kuri Nafutali baze bakurikire. Umukuru wabo ni Ahira mwene Enani.
Igitigiri c’umugwi w’abo ni ibihumbi mirongo itanu na bitatu n’amajana ane.
Abagabo bose bazoba bari ku ruhande rwa Dani ni ibihumbi ijana na mirongo itanu n’indwi n’amajana atandatu. Abo ni bo bazohaguruka ubwa nyuma.

Abo ni bo Bisirayeli, baharuwe hakurikijwe imiryango bakomokamwo. Abaharuwe bose mu mice y’igisoda cabo, nk’uko imigwi yabo iri, ni ibihumbi amajana atandatu na bitatu n’amajana atanu na mirongo itanu.
Ariko Abalewi bo, ntibaharuwe hamwe n’abandi Bisirayeli, nk’uko Uhoraho yari yabitegetse Mose.

Nuko Abisirayeli bakora vyose nk’uko Uhoraho yari yabitegetse Mose. Bashinga amahema musi y’amabendera yabo, umwe wese mu nzu ya ba sekuruza no mu muryango wiwe, kandi ni muri urwo rutonde nyene bahaguruka bagafata inzira.

headings.text: Uko imiryango yashinga amahema aho bacumbitse

verses.text: Uru ni rwo ruvyaro rwa Aroni n’urwa Mose igihe Uhoraho yavugana na Mose ku musozi Sinayi.
Amazina y’abahungu ba Aroni yari Nadabu, imfura yiwe, Abihu, Eliyazeri na Itamari.
Ayo ni yo mazina y’abahungu ba Aroni, abaherezi basizwe amavuta, barobanuriwe igikorwa c’ubuherezi.

Ariko Nadabu na Abihu bapfiriye imbere y’ Uhoraho igihe batanga ikimazi bakoresheje umuriro utemewe imbere yiwe mu bugaragwa bw’i Sinayi. Nta bahungu bari bafise; ni co catumye Eliyazeri na Itamari bonyene ari bo bakoze nk’abaherezi igihe se Aroni yari akiriho.
Uhoraho abarira Mose ati:
“Zana abakomoka kuri Lewi imbere ya Aroni umuherezi kugira ngo bamufashe.
Baze bakore ibikorwa vyerekeye Ihema ry’Ibonaniro bakorera Aroni n’Abisirayeli bose.
Bazoba bajejwe gutunganya ibikoresho vyose vyo mw’Ihema ry’Ibonaniro, bakorera Abisirayeli bose ivyashinzwe mu gukora ibikorwa vyabo vyo mw’Ihema.
Abo Balewi ubashikirize Aroni n’abahungu biwe; kuko ni bo bitanze mu Bisirayeli bose ngo babafashe ibikorwa.
Uze utoranye Aroni n’abahungu biwe ni bo bazokora nk’abaherezi; uwundi muntu wese azokwegera ihema aze yicwe.”
Uhoraho yongera abarira Mose ati:
“Natoranije Abalewi mu bandi Bisirayeli ngo babe mu gishingo c’abahungu bose b’imfura bavyawe n’umugore wese w’Umwisirayelikazi. Abalewi ni abanje,
kuko abana bose b’imfura ari abanje. Igihe nica abana b’imfura bose bo muri Egiputa, naciye nitoraniriza imfura zose zo muri Isirayeli, imfura z’abantu n’iz’ibitungwa. Ni izanje; ndi Uhoraho .”
Uhoraho abarira Mose ari mu bugaragwa bw’i Sinayi ati:
“Harura Abalewi ukurikije imiryango yabo n’amazu ya ba sekuruza babo. Muze muharure umuhungu wese kuva ku wumaze ukwezi kumwe avutse no kuduga.”
Nuko Mose arabaharura, nk’uko yategetswe n’ijambo ry’ Uhoraho .
Aya ni yo mazina y’abahungu ba Lewi: Gerishoni, Kohati na Merari.
Amazu akomoka kuri Gerishoni yitiriwe abahungu biwe babiri: Libuni na Shimeyi
Amazu akomoka kuri Kohati yitiriwe abahungu biwe bane: Amuramu, Izihari, Heburoni na Uziyeli.
Amazu akomoka kuri Merari yitiriwe abahungu biwe babiri: Mahuli na Mushi. Ayo ni yo yari amazu y’abakomoka kuri Lewi, hakurikijwe imiryango yabo.
Abakomoka kuri Gerishoni bari Abalibuni n’Abashimeyi; ayo ni yo yari amazu akomoka kuri Gerishoni.
Abahungu bamaze ukwezi bavutse n’abakurenza baharuwe bari ibihumbi indwi n’amajana atanu.
Abakomoka kuri Gerishoni bacumbika mu burengero, inyuma y’ihema.
Umukuru w’amazu akomoka kuri Gerishoni yari Eliyasafu mwene Layeli.
Mw’ihema ry’ibonaniro, Abagerishoni bari bashinzwe gutunganya ihema imbere n’inyuma, n’igipfutse ihema, n’igihuzu gikingiriye ku muryango w’Ihema ry’Ibonaniro,
ibihuzu bigize urugo, n’igihuzu co ku muryango w’irembo ry’urugo rukikuje ihema n’igicaniro, n’imigozi y’ihema, n’ibikoresho vyose bijanye n’ikoreshwa ryayo.
Imiryango iva kuri Kohati ni Abamurani, Abayizari, Abaheburoni n’Abawuziyeli; abo ni bo bari bagize imiryango y’Abakohati.
Igitigiri c’abahungu bamaze ukwezi n’ukurenga cari ibihumbi umunani n’amajana atandatu. Abakohati bari bajejwe gutunganya ahera.
Imiryango y’Abakohati bacumbika mu ruhande rwo mu bumanuko rw’ihema.
Umukuru w’amazu ya ba sekuruza y’imiryango y’Abakohati yari Elizafani mwene Uziyeli.
Bari bajejwe gutunganya Isandugu y’Isezerano, imeza, igiterekwako amatara, ibicaniro, ibikoresho vy’ahera bikoreshwa mu gikorwa caho, igihuzu gikingiriye ahera, n’ibindi vyose bijanye n’ivyo.
Umukuru yatwara bose mu Balewi yari Eliyazeri mwene Aroni, umuherezi. Yari ashinzwe kurongora abari bashinzwe gutunganya ahera.
Imiryango y’Abamahuli n’Abamushi bari Aba Merari; abo ni bo bari bagize imiryango y’Abamerari.
Igitigiri c’abahungu bamaze ukwezi n’ukurenga baharuwe cari ibihumbi bitandatu n’amajana abiri.
Umukuru w’amazu y’abo mu miryango y’Abamerari yari Zuriyeli mwene Abihayili; bategerezwa gucumbika mu ruhande rwo mu buraruko bw’ihema.
Abamerari bari bashinzwe gutunganya ibishimaryango vy’ihema, ibizingiti, inkingi, ivyo gushingamwo inkingi n’ibikoresho vyaryo vyose, n’ibijanye na vyo vyose n’ikoreshwa ryavyo,
n’inkingi z’urugo rukikuje ihema n’ivyo kuzishingamwo vyose, imambo n’imigozi vy’ihema.

Mose na Aroni n’abahungu babo bategerezwa gushinga amahema mu buseruko bw’Ihema ry’Ibonaniro, batumbereye iyo izuba riserukira, imbere y’Ihema ry’Ibonaniro. Bari bajejwe gutunganya ivy’Ihema mu gishingo c’abandi Bisirayeli. Uwundi wese yegera Ihema yategerezwa kwicwa.

Igitigiri cose c’Abalewi baharuwe na Mose na Aroni nk’uko Uhoraho yabitegetse hakurikijwe imiryango yabo, bagizwe n’abahungu bakwije ukwezi bavutse n’abakurenza, cari ibihumbi mirongo ibiri na bibiri.
Uhoraho abarira Mose ati: “Harura imfura z’Abisirayeli zose z’abahungu bamaze ukwezi n’abakurenza ushire ku rutonde amazina yabo.
Uce wakira Abalewi ubanzanire mu gishingo c’imfura zose z’Abisirayeli, n’imfura z’ibitungwa vy’Abalewi mu gishingo c’imfura zose z’ibitungwa vy’Abisirayeli. Ndi Uhoraho .”
Nuko Mose aharura imfura zose z’Abisirayeli, nk’uko Uhoraho yabimutegetse.
Igitigiri cose c’imfura z’abahungu bamaze ukwezi kumwe n’abakurenza, bashizwe ku rutonde, cari ibihumbi mirongo ibiri na bibiri n’amajana abiri na mirongo indwi na batatu.
Uhoraho abarira Mose ati:
“Fata Abalewi mu gishingo c’imfura z’Abisirayeli, n’ibitungwa vy’Abalewi mu gishingo c’ibitungwa vy’Abisirayeli. Abalewi ni abanje. Ndi Uhoraho .
Mu gucungura abo bana b’imfura amajana abiri na mirongo indwi na batatu barenga ku gitigiri c’Abalewi,
uze wegeranye shekeli zitanu ku muntu umwe umwe, ukoresheje ingero shekeli y’Ahera, ipima ingero gera mirongo ibiri.
Uyatange kwa Aroni n’abahungu biwe kugira ngo ucungure abo Bisirayeli barengako.”
Nuko Mose yegeranya ayo mahera y’incungu y’Abisirayeli barenga kuri ca gitigiri cacunguwe n’Abalewi.
Mu mfura z’Abisirayeli yegeranije ifeza zipima shekeli igihumbi n’amajana atatu na mirongo itandatu na zitanu, hakoreshejwe ingero shekeli y’Ahera.
Mose atanga ayo mahera y’incungu kwa Aroni n’abahungu biwe, nk’uko yari yabitegetswe n’ijambo ry’ Uhoraho .
Uhoraho abarira Mose na Aroni ati:
“Andika amazina y’abakomoka mu nzu kwa Kohati hamwe n’imiryango y’Abakohati bose bakomoka kuri Lewi.
Uharure abagabo bose bafise imyaka mirongo itatu gushika kuri mirongo itanu bashobora gukora ibikorwa mw’Ihema ry’Ibonaniro.
Iki ni co gikorwa c’Abakohati mw’Ihema ry’Ibonaniro: ni ugutunganya ibintu vyeguriwe Uhoraho kuruta ibindi.
Igihe Abisirayeli bazoba bagomba kuva aho bazoba bacumbitse, Aroni n’abahungu biwe baze binjire bamanure ca gihuzu gikingiriye ahera bagipfukishe ya Isandugu y’Isezerano.
Hanyuma baze barenzeko igipfukisho gikozwe mu rusato, bongereko igitambara gikozwe mu bwoya bw’intama c’ubururu bace bashirako vya biti vyo guterura iyo sandugu.

Hanyuma, baze basanze igitambara c’ubururu ku meza aho bahora bashira imikate yejejwe, bace bashiraho imibehe, amasahani n’ibikombe, n’ibikoresho vyo gutanga ishikanwa ry’ibinyobwa; ya mikate yama kuri iyo meza ize igumeko.
Hejuru y’ivyo, baze basanzeko igitambara gitukura, barenzeko impuzu ikozwe mu rusato bace bashirako vya biti vyo guterura iyo meza.
Hanyuma, baze bafate igitambara c’ubururu bagipfukishe igiterekwako amatara n’amatara yaco, ivyo kuduza intambi n’ibijako umunyota, n’ibijamwo amavuta yo gusukwa mu matara.
Bazoce bakizingira mu mpuzu ikozwe mu rusato hamwe n’ibikoresho bijanye na co babitereke ku nderuzo yaco.
Hanyuma, baze bapfukishe ca gicaniro c’inzahabu igitambara c’ubururu barenzeko impuzu ikozwe mu rusato bace bashirako vya biti vyo kugiterura.
Bazoheze bafate ibindi bikoresho vyose bikoreshwa imbere mw’ihema, babizingire mu mpuzu y’ubururu, barenzeko impuzu y’urusato bace babishira ku nderuzo yavyo.
Baze bakure iminyota kuri ca gicaniro c’umwakaka, hanyuma bagipfuke impuzu itukura.

Bazoce bagishirako ibikoresho bikoreshwa mu bikorwa vyo ku gicaniro, harimwo ivyotezo, amakanya yo guterura inyama, amapanu n’ibikoresho vyo kumijagira amaraso. Baze bagipfukishe impuzu ikozwe mu rusato bace bashiramwo vya biti vyo kugiterura.

Aroni n’abahungu biwe nibaheza gupfuka ibikoresho vyose vyejejwe, abantu na bo bakaba biteguye kugenda bava aho bahora bacumbitse, Abakohati bazoce baza guterura ivyo bikoresho vyose. Ariko ntibaze bakore kuri vya bikoresho vyejejwe kuko bohava bapfa. Abakohati baze baterure vya bikoresho biri mw’ihema ry’ibonaniro.

Eliyazeri mwene Aroni, umuherezi, azoba ajejwe kuraba amavuta yo mu matara, ivyo guturirwa bimota neza, amashikanwa y’ifu atangwa imisi yose n’amavuta yo kurobanura. Azoba ajejwe ahera hose n’ibintu vyose biri ngaho, harimwo n’ibikoresho vyose vy’ahera.”
Uhoraho abarira Mose na Aroni ati:
“Muze mwiyubare kugira ngo inzu y’Abakohati ntize izimangane mu Balewi.

Kugira ngo ntibaze bapfe igihe bazoba begereye ibintu vyera, ng’ibi ivyo mukwiye kubakorera: Aroni n’abahungu biwe baze baje mw’ihema kugira ngo umuntu wese bamwereke igikorwa akwiye gukora canke akwiye guterura.
Ariko Abakohati ntibaze binjire mw’ihema ngo barabe ivyera, naho hoba akanya gatoya, kuko boca bapfa.”
Uhoraho abarira Mose ati:
“Andika amazina y’abakomoka mu nzu kwa Gerishoni hamwe n’imiryango y’Abagerishoni bose bakomoka kuri Lewi.
Uharure abagabo bose bamaze imyaka mirongo itatu gushika kuri mirongo itanu baza gukora mw’ihema ry’ibonaniro.
Ibi ni vyo bikorwa vy’imiryango y’Abagerishoni:
Bazoba bajejwe guterura ibihuzu bikingira ahera n’ivyo mw’ihema ry’ibonaniro, n’ico gupfuka ahera hamwe n’ibipfuka hanze bikozwe mu nsato, n’ibihuzu bikingira ku muryango w’ihema ry’ibonaniro,
ibihuzu bikingira bigize urugo rw’ihema n’igicaniro, igihuzu gikingiriye irembo, imigozi n’ibindi bikoresho bijanye bigize urwo rugo. Abagerishoni baze bakore ibikeneye gukorwa vyo kuri ivyo bintu.
Aroni n’abahungu biwe baze bereke Abagerishoni ibikorwa vyose bajejwe vyaba ivyo bakora canke ivyo baterura.
Ivyo ni vyo abakomoka ku nzu ya Gerishoni bazokora mw’ihema ry’ibonaniro. Ivyo bazokora baze babikore barongowe na Itamari mwene Aroni, umuherezi.
Andika amazina y’abakomoka mu nzu kwa Merari hamwe n’imiryango y’Abamerari bose bakomoka kuri Lewi.
Uze uharure abagabo bose bakwije imyaka mirongo itatu gushika ku mirongo itanu bakwiye gukora mw’ihema ry’ibonaniro.
Iki ni co gikorwa cabo bazokora mw’ihema ry’ibonaniro: kurerura imbaho zubatse ihema, imitambikwa, inkingi n’ivyo kuziterekamwo,
inkingi z’urugo n’ivyo kuziterekamwo, imambo zo gushinga ihema, imigozi, n’ibindi vyose bijanye n’igikorwa cavyo. Uze ugenere umuntu wese ivyo akwiye guterura.
Ivyo ni vyo bikorwa vy’abakomoka kuri Merari nk’uko bakora mw’ihema ry’ibonaniro barongowe na Itamari mwene Aroni, umuherezi.”
Mose, Aroni n’abakuru barongoye abandi baharura Abakohati nk’uko inzu zabo n’imiryango yabo biri.
Abagabo bose bamaze imyaka mirongo itatu gushika ku myaka mirongo itanu baza gukora mu gikorwa co mw’ihema ry’ibonaniro,
basanze bose hamwe ari ibihumbi bibiri n’amajana indwi na mirongo itanu.
Ico ni co cari igitigiri c’abakomoka kuri ku mazu ya Kohati bakora mw’ihema ry’ibonaniro. Mose na Aroni barabaharura nk’uko Uhoraho yari yabitegetse Mose.
Abagerishoni baraharurwa nk’uko amazu yabo n’imiryango yabo iri.
Abagabo bose bamaze imyaka iri hagati ya mirongo itatu na mirongo itanu bakwiye gukora mw’ihema ry’ibonaniro,
baharuwe nk’uko amazu n’imiryango yabo biri basanze ari ibihumbi bibiri n’amajana atandatu na mirongo itatu.
Ico cari igitigiri c’abakomoka kuri Gerishoni bakora mw’ihema ry’ibonaniro. Mose na Aroni barabaharura nk’uko Uhoraho yari yabitegetse.
Abamerari baraharurwa nk’uko amazu n’imiryango yabo biri.
Abagabo bose bari hagati y’imyaka mirongo itatu na mirongo itanu baza gukora mw’ihema ry’ibonaniro,
baharuwe nk’uko amazu n’imiryango yabo biri bari ibihumbi bitatu n’amajana abiri.
Ico ni co gitigiri c’abakomoka ku mazu n’imiryango y’Abamerari. Mose na Aroni barabaharura nk’uko Uhoraho yari yabitegetse abicishije kuri Mose.
Nuko Mose, Aroni n’abakuru b’Abisirayeli baharura Abalewi bose bakurikije amazu yabo n’imiryango yabo.
Abagabo bose bamaze imyaka mirongo itatu gushika kuri mirongo itanu bakwiye gukora mw’ihema ry’ibonaniro
bari ibihumbi umunani n’amajana atanu na mirongo umunani.
Nk’uko Uhoraho yari yabitegetse abicishije kuri Mose, umwe wese ahabwa igikorwa ciwe kandi abarirwa ico akwiye guterura. Maze bose baharurwa, nk’uko Uhoraho yari yabitegetse Mose.
Uhoraho abarira Mose ati:
“Tegeka Abisirayeli ngo baze bakure hagati muri bo umuntu wese afise imibembe canke afise ibintu bimuvamwo vy’uburyo ubwo ari bwo bwose, canke yahumanijwe no gukora ku muvyimba.
Muze musohore yaba umugabo canke umugore; muze mubasohore bave aho mucumbitse kugira ngo ntibahumanye ikoraniro ryose, kuko jewe mba hagati muri bo.”
Abisirayeli babikora nk’uko Uhoraho yabitegetse Mose, barabasohora babajana inyuma y’aho bacumbitse.
Uhoraho abarira Mose ati:
“Barira Abisirayeli uti: ‘Nihagira umugabo canke umugore agirira nabi uwundi mu buryo ubwo ari bwo bwose, bigatuma ataba umwizigirwa imbere y’ Uhoraho , uwo muntu azoba ari uwo gutsindwa n’urubanza
kandi azoba akwiye kwatura icaha yakoze. Aze arihe ivyo yononye vyose, yongereko ica gatanu c’ico kintu; vyose ace abiha uwo yagiriye nabi.
Ariko niyaba nyenevyo yarapfuye akaba atagira incuti ya hafi yoshobora kwakira iyo ndishi, izoba ari iy’ Uhoraho izoce ihabwa umuherezi, ayiherekereshe impfizi y’intama yo gutanga impongano yiwe.
Ibimazi vyose bikuwe ku vyo Abisirayeli bazoba bahaye Uhoraho bizoba ari ivy’umuherezi.
Ibintu vyejejwe biba ari ivya nyenevyo; ico umuntu ahaye umuherezi kizoba ari ic’umuherezi.’ ”
Nuko Uhoraho abarira Mose ati:
“Vugana n’Abisirayeli ubabwire uti: ‘Umugore afise umugabo niyigenza nabi agahemukira umugabo wiwe
mu kuryamana n’uwundi mugabo, kandi ivyo umugabo wiwe akaba ata vyo azi kuko ubwo buhumane bwiwe butamenyekanye (kuko ata cabona co kumwagiriza kandi ata wigeze amufata),
ariko umugabo akamwikeka ko yiyanduje mu kumuhemukira, canke na ho akamwikeka kandi atiyanduje,

azoce atwara uwo mugore ku muherezi. Aze ajane n’ishikanwa ringana n’ic’icumi c’ingero efa y’ifu ya sayiri amutangira. Ntaze ayisukeko amavuta canke ngo ayishireko ivyo baturira bikamota neza, kuko ari ishikanwa ry’ifu ritanzwe kubera umwikeko, kandi ari ukugira ngo ikibi kimenyekane.
Uwo muherezi aze amuzane amuhagarike imbere y’ Uhoraho .
Hanyuma ashire amazi ahezagiye mu nkono y’ibumba ashiremwo ivu akuye ahera.

Amaze kumuhagarika imbere y’ Uhoraho , aze apfundurure umushatsi w’uwo mugore ashire mu maboko yiwe rya shikanwa, rimwe ry’ifu ryatanzwe kubera kumwikeka, na we aze agumye ya mazi arura azana umuvumo.

Hanyuma aze arahize uwo mugore avuga ati: “Niwaba ata mugabo mwaryamanye kandi utahemukiye umugabo wawe ngo wiyanduze kandi wari ufise umugabo wawe, aya mazi arura kandi atera umuvumo ntagire ico akugira.
Ariko niwaba warahemutse kandi ufise umugabo wawe ukaba wariyanduje mu kuryamana n’uwundi mugabo atari rwawe”;

aha rero umuherezi aze ashire kuri uwo mugore umuvumo uri muri iyi ndahiro ati: “ Uhoraho atume abantu bawe bakuvuma bongere bakugire akabarore kuko azoba aguhinduye ingumba kandi atumye inda yawe ivyimba.
Aya mazi atera umuvumo yinjire muri wewe atume inda yawe ivyimba kandi aguhindure ingumba.” Uwo mugore aze yishure ati: “Amen. Nibibe gutyo.”
Uwo muherezi aze yandike iyo mivumo ku muzingo w’igitabu kandi azoce ayogesha ya mazi y’umururazi.
Azoce aha wa mugore ayo mazi atera umuvumo ayanywe, na yo azomutera ububabare bwinshi.
Uwo muherezi azoce afata rya shikanwa ry’ifu ritanzwe kubera ukwikeka ryari mu minwe yiwe, arizungagize imbere y’ Uhoraho azoce arizana ku gicaniro.
Uwo muherezi aze afate ifu yuzuye igipfunsi kuri iryo shikanwa kugira ribe ishikanwa ry’icibutso arituririre ku gicaniro; inyuma y’ivyo, azoce anywesha ya mazi wa mugore.

Niyaba yariyandurishije kurenga ibigo kandi afise umugabo, hanyuma akanyweshwa ayo mazi atera umuvumo, azoca yinjira muri we amutere ububabare bwinshi; inda yiwe izovyimba hanyuma abe ingumba, yongere abe ikivume mu bantu b’iwabo.
Ariko niyaba atiyanduje akaba adahumanye, nta co azoba azokurwako urubanza ashobore no kuvyara abana.
Iri ni ryo tegeko rijanye n’ukwikeka ko umugore yahemukiye umugabo akiyanduza kandi afise umugabo wiwe,
canke umugabo niyafatwa n’ivyiyumviro vyo kwikeka umugore wiwe. Umuherezi aze amuhagarike imbere y’ Uhoraho ace akoresha iryo tegeko ryose kuri we.
Umugabo we nta co azokwagirizwa na kimwe, ariko umugore we azogibwako n’inkurikizi zose z’icaha ciwe.’ ”

headings.text: Uburyo bwo gusuzuma umugore yarenze ibigo

verses.text: Uhoraho abarira Mose ati:
“Barira Abisirayeli uti: ‘Umugabo canke umugore niyashaka gusezerana isezerano ridasanzwe, isezerano ryo kwiyegurira Uhoraho ; ari kwo kuba umunaziri,

aze yirinde ntanywe umuvinyu canke ikindi kinyobwa kiboreza na kimwe canke inkarisha yakozwe mu muvinyu canke mu kindi kinyobwa cambiwe. Ntaze anywe umutobe ukozwe mu vyamwa vy’umuzabibu canke ngo arye ivyamwa vy’umuzabibu.
Igihe cose azoba akiri umunaziri, ntaze yigere arya ikintu na kimwe kiva mu muzabibu, n’aho zoba imbuto canke ibishishwa.
Mu kiringo cose iryo sezerano rizomara, ntaze yigere yikozako urwembe. Azogume ari uwera gushika ico kiringo co kwiyegurira Uhoraho giheze; aze areke umushatsi wo ku mutwe wiwe ukure ube muremure.
Muri ico kiringo co kwiyegurira Uhoraho ntaze yegere umuvyimba w’uwapfuye.
Naho yoba ari se canke nyina canke uwo bavukana yapfuye, ntaze yiyandurishe imivyimba yabo, kuko ikimenyetso co kwiyegurira Imana ciwe kiri ku mutwe wiwe.
Muri ico kiringo cose azoba yiyeguye azoba yatoranirijwe Uhoraho .
Umuntu niyapfa giturumbuka agapfira imbere yiwe, bigatuma yanduza umushatsi wiwe, aze yimoshe umushatsi ku musi wo guhumanurwa kwiwe, ari ho ku musi ugira indwi.
Hanyuma ku musi ugira umunani aze azane ivyana bibiri vy’inuma canke vy’intunguru, abihe umuherezi ku muryango w’Ihema ry’Ibonaniro.

Uwo muherezi aze atange kimwe kw’ikimazi c’ivyaha ikindi kw’ikimazi co guturirwa kugira ngo amutangire impongano kuko yacumuye mu kwegera umuvyimba. Kuri uwo musi nyene aze asubire yegurire umutwe wiwe kuba uwera.

Aze yiyegurire Uhoraho mu kiringo cose yasezeranye kandi aze atange umwagazi w’intama utarengeje umwaka umwe w’ikimazi c’indishi. Ariko imisi yari amaze nta n’umwe uzoharurwa, kuko yabaye uwuhumanye mu gihe ciwe c’ubunaziri.
Iri ni ryo tegeko ku munaziri ahejeje ikiringo ciwe co kuba umunaziri: aze azanwe ku muryango w’ihema ry’ibonaniro.

Aho ni ho azotangira ibimazi vyiwe vy’ Uhoraho : impfizi y’intama imaze umwaka umwe itagira agasembwa y’ikimazi co guturirwa, umwagazi uvyara w’intama umaze umwaka umwe utagira agasembwa w’ikimazi c’ivyaha, impfizi y’intama y’ikimazi c’ishimwe,

biri kumwe n’amashikanwa y’ifu yavyo hamwe n’amashikanwa y’ibinyobwa yavyo, igiseke c’imikate itarimwo umwambiro, imikate ikozwe mw’ifu inoze neza ikaranzwe mu amavuta, n’imikate itarimwo umwambiro isize mavuta.
Umuherezi aze abizane imbere y’ Uhoraho ace atanga ca kimazi c’ivyaha na ca kimazi co guturirwa.
Aze ashikane na ca giseke c’imikate itarimwo umwambiro ace ashikanira Uhoraho ya mpfizi y’intama y’ikimazi c’impongano, hamwe n’amashikanwa yaco y’ifu n’ibinyobwa.
Hanyuma wa munaziri akiri ngaho ku muryango w’ihema ry’ibonaniro, aze yimoshe wa mushatsi yari yarateretse. Aze afate wa mushatsi awuterere mu muriro uri musi y’ikimazi c’impongano.

Uwo munaziri ahejeje kwimosha umushatsi yari yarateretse, umuherezi aze ashire mu minwe yiwe igitugu ca ya mpfizi y’intama yatetswe mu mazi, n’umukate umwe utetswe mu mavuta n’umukate umwe usizwe amavuta iri muri ca giseke, yompi izoba itarimwo umwambiro.

Umuherezi aze abizungagize imbere y’ Uhoraho nk’ishikanwa ryo kuzungagiza; bizoba ari ivyera kandi bibe ivy’umuherezi, harimwo na ca gikiriza cazungagizwa na rya tako ryatangwa. Inyuma y’ivyo, uwo munaziri ashobora kunywa umuvinyu.

Iryo ni ryo tegeko rigenga umunaziri yasezeranye kwiyegurira Uhoraho kubera isezerano. Bashobora kwongerako ikindi cose bashobora kuronka. Aze ashitse ico yasezeranye, nk’uko itegeko ryo kuba umunaziri rivuga.’ ”
Uhoraho abarira Mose ati:
“Bwira Aroni n’abahungu biwe uti: ‘Uku ni ko muzohezagira Abisirayeli. Muze mubabwire muti:
“ Uhoraho aguhezagire kandi akuzigame;
Uhoraho akumurikishirize mu nyonga hiwe kandi akugirire ubuntu;
Uhoraho aguhindukirize inyonga ziwe kandi aguhe amahoro.” ’
Uko ni ko bazoshira izina ryanje ku Bisirayeli, nanje nzobahezagira.”
Ku musi Mose yaherejeko gutunganya rya hema, yaciye arirobanuza amavuta arishikiriza Imana hamwe n’ibikoresho vyose biri muri ryo. Yarobanuye kandi igicaniro n’ibikoresho vyaco.
Hanyuma abakuru b’Abisirayeli, abakuru b’amazu aserukira imiryango bari bashinzwe guharura abasoda, baraza batanga ibimazi vyabo.

Bazana ingabire k’ Uhoraho igizwe n’imikogote itandatu ikwegwa n’impfizi zibiri, bazana n’impfizi z’inka icumi na zibiri, abakuru babiri basangira umukogote kandi umukuru wese atanga impfizi imwimwe. Ivyo vyose babizana imbere y’ihema.
Uhoraho abarira Mose ati:
“Ubakirire ivyo batanze, kugira ngo bikoreshwe mu gikorwa co mw’Ihema ry’Ibonaniro. Ubihereze Abalewi nk’uko igikorwa c’umuntu wese kiri.”
Nuko Mose yakira ya mikogote na za mpfizi z’inka abiha Abalewi.
Abagerishoni abaha imikogote ibiri n’impfizi z’inka zine, nk’uko igikorwa cabo cabisaba,
Abamerari abaha imikogote ine n’impfizi umunani nk’uko igikorwa cabo cabisaba. Bose bari barongowe na Itamari mwene Aroni, umuherezi.
Ariko Mose ntiyaha na kimwe Abakohati, kuko bari bajejwe ivyerejwe Uhoraho, bakaba bategerezwa kubirerura ku bitugu vyabo.
Igihe igicaniro carobanuzwa amavuta, ba bakuru bazanye ibimazi vyabo vyo kukirobanura barabizana babishira imbere y’igicaniro.
Uhoraho yari yabwiye Mose ati: “Ku musi ku musi umukuru umwe wese aze atange ikimazi ciwe co guhereza Imana ico gicaniro.”
Uwazanye ishikanwa ryiwe ku musi wa mbere yari Nahashoni mwene Aminadabu wo mu muryango wa Yuda.

Ishikanwa ryiwe ryari: isiniya ikozwe mw’ifeza ipima shekeli ijana na mirongo itatu, n’igikombe c’ifeza gipima shekeli mirongo indwi, vyompi vyapimwe hakoreshejwe ingero shekeli y’Ahera, kimwe cose cuzuye ifu inoze neza ivanze n’amavuta y’ishikanwa ry’ifu;
isahani imwe y’inzahabu ipima shekeli icumi, yuzuye ibimota neza;
ishuri imwe, impfizi y’intama imwe n’umwagazi w’intama umaze umwaka, ngo bibe ikimazi co guturirwa;
isuguru y’impene imwe y’ikimazi c’ivyaha;

n’impfizi zibiri z’inka, impfizi z’intama zitanu, amasuguru atanu y’impene n’imyagazi itanu y’intama imaze umwaka umwe, vyo gutangwa kw’ikimazi c’ishimwe. Iryo ni ryo ryari ishikanwa rya Nahashoni mwene Aminadabu.
Ku musi ugira kabiri Netaneli mwene Zuwari, Umukuru w’umuryango w’Abisakari, azana ishikanwa ryiwe.

Ku musi ugira gatatu, Eliyabu mwene Heloni, umukuru w’umuryango w’Abazebuloni, azana ishikanwa ryiwe.

Ku musi ugira gatanu Shelumiyeli mwene Zurishadayi, umukuru w’umuryango w’Abasimeyoni, azana ishikanwa ryiwe.

Ku musi ugira gatandatu Eliyasafu mwene Dewuyeli, umukuru w’umuryango w’Abagadi, azana ishikanwa ryiwe.

Mose amaze kwinjira mw’Ihema ry’Ibonaniro kugira ngo avugane n’ Uhoraho , yumva ijwi rivugana na we rivuye hagati ya ba bakerubi babiri bari ku mupfundikizo w’impongano w’Isandugu y’Isezerano. Na we araheza avugana na we.

headings.text: Ibimazi vyatanzwe mu gushikiriza Uhoraho ihema

verses.text: Uhoraho abarira Mose ati:
“Bwira Aroni, uti: ‘Igihe muzoshiraho ya matara indwi, muze muyashire ahantu ashobora kumurika ku ruhande rw’imbere rw’igiterekwako amatara.’ ”
Aroni aca akora uko; ashira amatara aho ashobora kubonesha imbere y’igiterekwako amatara, nk’uko Uhoraho yabitegetse Mose.
Uku ni ko ico giterekwako amatara cakozwe: cari gikozwe mu nzahabu yahondeshejwe inyundo; kuva musi gushika hejuru. Ico giterekwako amatara cari gikozwe nka ca kigereranyo Uhoraho yari yeretse Mose.
Uhoraho abarira Mose ati:
“Toranya Abalewi ubakure mu bandi Bisirayeli ubahumanure.
Mu kubahumanura, uze ukore gutya: uze ubamijagire ya mazi yo guhumanura; hanyuma bamobwe umushatsi aho uri hose ku mibiri yabo kandi bamesure impuzu zabo; uko ni ko bazoba bahumanuwe.
Baze bazane ishuri ikiri nto n’ishikanwa ryayo ry’ifu rigizwe n’ifu inoze neza ivanzwe n’amavuta; uzane n’iyindi shuri ya kabiri y’ikimazi c’ivyaha.
Uze uzane Abalewi imbere y’Ihema ry’Ibonaniro ukoranye n’Abisirayeli bose.
Uze uzane Abalewi imbere y’ Uhoraho , hanyuma Abisirayeli baze babarambikeko ibiganza.
Aroni aze azane ba Balewi imbere y’ Uhoraho nk’ishikanwa ryo kuzungagiza rivuye mu Bisirayeli, kugira ngo bitegurire igikorwa c’ Uhoraho .

Hanyuma Abalewi barambike ibiganza ku mitwe ya ya mashuri, imwe uheze uyitange nk’ikimazi c’ivyaha gishikaniwe Uhoraho , iyindi na yo uyitange nk’ikimazi co guturirwa, kugira ngo Abalewi batangirwe ikimazi co kwikurako icaha.
Uze uzane Abalewi bahagarare imbere ya Aroni n’abahungu biwe hanyuma uce ubatanga nk’ishikanwa ryo kuzungagiza rishikaniwe Uhoraho .
Uko ni ko uzorobanura Abalewi ubakuye mu bandi Bisirayeli, hanyuma Abalewi bazoba abanje.
Niwaheza guhumanura Abalewi no kubashikana nk’ishikanwa ryo kuzungagiza, bazoce baza gukora igikorwa cabo kw’ihema ry’ibonaniro.
Ni Abisirayeli banyeguriwe. Nabagize abanje mu gishingo c’imfura, abana b’imfura b’abahungu b’Umwisirayelikazi wese.
Imfura zose mu Bisirayeli, baba abantu canke ibitungwa, ni ivyanje. Igihe nahonya imfura zose muri Egiputa, naciye nirobanurira abo kuba abanje.
Natoranije Abalewi mu gishingo c’abahungu bose b’imfura muri Isirayeli.

Kandi mpaye Aroni n’abahungu biwe Abalewi mbakuye mu Bisirayeli bose ngo bakore igikorwa co mw’ihema ry’ibonaniro bagikorera Abisirayeli ngo babatangire impongano kugira ngo ntihagire ikiza gitera Abisirayeli igihe bazokwegera ahera.”
Mose, Aroni n’Abisirayeli bose baca bakora ivyo Uhoraho yategetse Mose vyose ku Balewi.
Nuko Abalewi bariyeza bamesura n’impuzu zabo. Maze Aroni aca abazana nk’ishikanwa rizungagizwa imbere y’ Uhoraho aca abatangira impongano kugira ngo abeze.
Inyuma y’ivyo, Abalewi baza gukora igikorwa cabo kw’ihema ry’ibonaniro barongowe na Aroni n’abahungu biwe. Uko Uhoraho yari yategetse Mose, ni ko bakoze ku Balewi.
Uhoraho abarira Mose ati:
“Ibi ni vyo bizokorwa ku Balewi: abagabo bamaze imyaka mirongo ibiri n’itanu n’iyirenga baze baze gukora kw’ihema ry’ibonaniro,
ariko bamaze imyaka mirongo itanu, baze bakukuruke bave mu gikorwa cabo bahora bakora ntibasubire kugikora.
Bashobora gufasha abavukanyi babo mu gukora ibikorwa vyabo mw’ihema ry’ibonaniro, ariko bo ntibaze bakore ico gikorwa. Ng’uko rero uko uzotunganya ibikorwa vy’Abalewi.”
Uhoraho avugana na Mose mu bugaragwa bw’i Sinayi mu kwezi kwa mbere kw’umwaka ugira kabiri bavuye muri Egiputa. Aramubwira ati:
“Abisirayeli baze bahimbaze Pasika mu gihe cashinzwe.
Muze muyihimbaze mu gihe cashinzwe, ku mugoroba w’umusi ugira icumi na kane w’uku kwezi, nk’uko amategeko n’ingingo biyigenga bimeze.”
Nuko Mose abarira Abisirayeli guhimbaza Pasika,
na bo barabikora mu bugaragwa bw’i Sinayi ku mugoroba w’umusi ugira icumi na kane w’ukwezi kwa mbere. Abisirayeli bakora vyose nk’uko Uhoraho yari yabitegetse Mose.
Ariko hariho bamwe batashoboye guhimbaza Pasika kuri uwo musi kuko bari bahumanijwe n’uko bakoze ku mivyimba. Nuko baza aho Mose na Aroni bari kuri uwo musi nyene
babarira Mose bati: “Twahumanijwe n’uko twakoze ku mivyimba. None ntitwemererwa gushikanira Uhoraho ikimazi hamwe n’abandi Bisirayeli kandi ari igihe cashinzwe?”
Mose arabishura ati: “Rindira nsiguze Uhoraho kugira ngo menye ico avuga ku biberekeye.”
Nuko Uhoraho abarira Mose ati:
“Bwira Abisirayeli uti: ‘Igihe umuntu wese wo muri mwebwe canke wo mu ruvyaro rwanyu azoba ahumanijwe n’umuvyimba canke afashe urugendo, azoshobora guhimbaza Pasika y’ Uhoraho .
Baze bayihimbaze ku musi ugira icumi na kane w’ukwezi kwa kabiri ku mugoroba. Baze barye umwagazi, bawukoze imikate itarimwo umwambiro n’imboga zirura.
Ntibaze bareke ivyasigaye ngo bishike mu gitondo bukeye canke ngo bavune igufa na rimwe. Igihe bazohimbaza Pasika, baze babikore nk’uko amategeko avuga.
Ariko umuntu azoba adahumanye kandi atafashe urugendo atazohimbaza Pasika, uwo muntu aze akurwe mu bwoko bwabo kuko atatanze ikimazi k’ Uhoraho mu gihe cashinzwe. Uwo muntu azozira icaha ciwe.
Umunyamahanga aba muri mwebwe ashaka guhimbaza Pasika y’ Uhoraho aze abikore yisunze amateka n’amategeko ayigenga. Mwese muze mugengwe n’amategeko amwe yaba umunyamahanga canke imvukira.’ ”
Ku musi ihema ryashingwa, ari ryo Hema ry’Ibonaniro, igicu caciye kiritwikira. Kuva ku mugoroba gushika mu gitondo ico gicu cari kw’Ihema kandi casa n’umuriro.
Uko ni ko vyagumye; ico gicu gipfutse iryo Hema mw’ijoro casa n’umuriro.
Igihe cose ico gicu cava kw’Ihema, Abisirayeli baca bahaguruka bagafata urugendo; aho ico gicu cahagarara, ni ho baca bashinga amahema bagacumbika.
Uhoraho ategetse ngo bimuke baca bimuka, yategeka ngo bacumbike, bagacumbika. Igihe cose ico gicu caguma hejuru ya rya hema, baguma aho bacumbitse.
Iyo ico gicu kigumye kuri iryo Hema igihe kirekire, Abisirayeli barubaha ico Uhoraho ategetse ntibimuka aho bacumbitse.
Rimwe na rimwe ico gicu camara imisi mikeya hejuru yaryo; Uhoraho ategetse ko bacumbika bagashinga amahema, yategeka ko bimuka bakayashingura.

Hari aho ico gicu caguma hejuru yaryo kuva ku mugoroba gushika mu gitondo gusa, cahaguruka mu gitondo bagaca bahaguruka bakagenda. Haba ku murango canke mw’ijoro, iyo ico gicu kivuye hasi baca bahaguruka bakagenda.
Nimba ico gicu kigumye hejuru y’ihema imisi ibiri canke ukwezi canke umwaka, Abisirayeli baguma aho bacumbitse, ntibimuka; ariko igihe kivuye hasi, baca bazinga amahema bakagenda.
Uhoraho ategetse baca bacumbika, yategeka bakazinga amahema bakagenda. Bumvira itegeko ry’ Uhoraho , nk’uko yari yabibategetse abicishije kuri Mose.
Uhoraho abarira Mose ati:
“Cura inzamba zibiri mw’ifeza ihondaguye, uze uzikoreshe mu guhamagara ikoraniro no mu kumenyesha umwanya wo kuzinga amahema ngo babandanye urugendo.
Igihe izo nzamba zivugirijwe rimwe, ikoraniro ryose rize rikoranire imbere yawe, imbere y’Ihema ry’Ibonaniro.
Iyo havugijwe imwe gusa, abarongoye abandi, abakuru b’amazu y’Abisirayeli, baze bakoranire imbere yawe.
Inzamba niyavuga n’ijwi rirengera rimwe, imiryango iherereye mu buseruko baze bahaguruke bagende.
Inzamba niyavuga ubwa kabiri mw’ijwi rirengera, imiryango iri mu bumanuko baze bahaguruke bagende.
Mu gukoranya ikoraniro, muze muvuze izo nzamba, ariko ntimukoreshe ijwi rimwe.
Abahungu ba Aroni, ari bo baherezi, baze bavuze izo nzamba; iri ni ryo tegeko ry’intahava uko urunganwe ruzogenda rukurikirana n’urundi.
Nimwaja mu ntambara mu gihugu canyu bwite muriko muragwanya umwansi abasugereje, muze muvuze izo nzamba mw’ijwi rirengera. Uhoraho Imana yanyu azoca abibuka kandi muzotabarwa mukire abansi banyu.

No mu bihe vyanyu vy’umunezero, haba mu misi mikuru yashinzwe canke imboneko z’ukwezi, muze muvuze izo nzamba mwongere mutange n’ibimazi vyo guturirwa n’ivy’impongano, na vyo bizoba icibutso canyu imbere y’ Uhoraho . Ndi Uhoraho Imana yanyu.”
Ku musi wa mirongo ibiri w’ukwezi kwa kabiri kw’umwaka wa kabiri, ca gicu kiraduga kiva kw’Ihema ry’ibishingantahe.
Nuko Abisirayeli bava hasi bava mu bugaragwa bw’i Sinayi bagenda barunguruza gushika aho ca gicu cahagarariye mu bugaragwa bw’i Parani.
Ubwo ni bwo bwa mbere Abisirayeli bavuye aho bari bacumbitse nk’uko Uhoraho yari yabibategetse abicishije kuri Mose.
Imigwi yo mu ba Yuda ni bo babanje guhaguruka, bari musi y’ibendera ryabo. Nahashoni mwene Aminadabu ni we yari abarongoye.
Netaneli mwene Zuwari ni we yari arongoye umugwi wo mu muryango wa Isakari,
Eliyabu mwene Heloni na we ni we yari arongoye umugwi wo mu muryango wa Zebuloni.
Hanyuma rya hema rica rirazingwa, Abagerishoni n’Abamerari, ari bo bari bariteruye, baca baragenda.
Imigwi yari musi y’ibendera rya Reyubeni barakurikira, bari musi y’ibendera ryabo. Elisuri mwene Shedewuri ni we yari abarongoye.
Shelumiyeli mwene Zurishadayi yari arongoye umugwi w’umuryango wa Simeyoni,
Eliyasafu na we, mwene Dewuyeli yari arongoye umugwi w’umuryango wa Gadi.
Hanyuma Abakohati bava hasi, bateruye vya bikoresho vyera. Ihema ryategerezwa gushingwa aho ryategerezwa kuba imbere y’uko bashika.
Imigwi yari musi y’ibendera rya Efurayimu barakurikira, bari musi y’ibendera ryabo. Elishama mwene Amihudi ni we yari abarongoye.
Gamaliyeli mwene Pedasuri ni we yari arongoye umugwi w’umuryango wa Manase,
Abidani mwene Gidiyoni na we yari arongoye umugwi w’umuryango wa Benyamini.
Ubwa nyuma, imigwi irongowe n’ibendera rya Dani, nk’umugwi ujejwe umutekano w’inyuma, bava hasi barongowe n’ibendera ryabo. Ahiyezeri mwene Amishadayi ni we yari abarongoye.
Pagiyeli mwene Okurani ni we yari arongoye umugwi w’umuryango wa Asheri,
Ahira mwene Enani na we yari arongoye umugwi w’umuryango wa Nafutali.
Uru ni rwo rwari urutonde rwo kugenda rw’imigwi y’Abisirayeli uko bakurikirana mu kuva hasi.
Nuko Mose abarira muramuwe Hobabu, mwene Reyuweli Umumidiyani, ati: “Tugiye aho Uhoraho yavuze ati: ‘Nzohabaha.’ Nuze tujane natwe tuzogufata neza, kuko Uhoraho yasezeraniye Abisirayeli ivyiza.”
Na we arishura ati: “Oya ntitujana. Nsubiye mu gihugu navukiyemwo no mu bwoko bwacu.”
Ariko Mose aravuga ati: “Ndakwinginze ntuduhebe. Kuko wewe uzi ubu bugaragwa, aho dushobora gushinga amahema, ushobora kutubera amaso.
Niwajana natwe, tuzosangira ivyiza vyose Uhoraho azoduha.”
Nuko bava ku musozi w’ Uhoraho bagenda imisi itatu. Isandugu y’Isezerano y’ Uhoraho yagendera imbere yabo muri iyo misi itatu kugira ngo abaronkere aho kuruhukira.
Ca gicu c’ Uhoraho cari hejuru yabo ku murango igihe bava aho bari bacumbitse.
Igihe cose iyo isandugu igiye, Mose yavuga ati: “Haguruka, yewe Uhoraho ! Abansi bawe nibasanzare; abakwanka nibahunge mu nyonga hawe.”
Igihe cose ihagaze, yavuga ati: “Garuka, Yewe Uhoraho , mu bihumbi n’ibihumbi vy’Abisirayeli.”
Muri iyo misi, Abisirayeli bidodombera Uhoraho kubera ingorane barimwo. Uhoraho avyumvise araraka. Maze umuriro uvuye k’ Uhoraho urarurumba uturira abari ku mpera y’aho bari bacumbitse.
Abantu batakambiye Mose, aca arasenga Uhoraho uwo muriro urazima.
Aho hantu haca hitwa Tabera bisigura “Guturira”, kuko umuriro uvuye k’ Uhoraho watse hagati muri bo.
Hanyuma, ikivange c’abanyamahanga bakurikiye Abisirayeli batangura kwipfuza inyama. N’Abisirayeli na bo nyene batangura kwidodomba bavuga bati: “Icoduha inyama zo kurya!
Twibutse amafi ya gusa twarya muri Egiputa n’amakonkomburi, imyungu, amapwaro, ibitunguru na tungurusumu.
Ariko ubu n’akayabagu kaheze; nta kindi turonka atari iyi manu gusa!”
Manu yari imeze nk’utubuto tw’igiti citwa koriyanderi, igasa n’ubukame bw’igiti.
Abantu barasohoka bakayegeranya, hanyuma bakayisya ku rusyo canke bakayisekura mw’isekuro. Bayiteka mu nkono canke bakayicumbamwo udukate. Mu kanwa yari imeze nk’ivyakaranzwe n’amavuta ya elayo.
Urume rutonze aho bacumbitse mw’ijoro, manu na yo nyene yazanana na rwo.
Mose yumva abantu bo mu miryango yose bariko baridodomba, umwe wese imbere y’ihema ryiwe. Uhoraho arashavura cane, na Mose arababara.
Abaza Uhoraho ati: “Mbega ni kuki wanteje uwu mubabaro jewe umusavyi wawe? Mbega nakoze iki cakubabaje catumye undemeka umuzigo ungana utya w’aba bantu?

Mbega ni jewe nabatwaye inda? Canke ni jewe nabavyaye? None ni igiki gituma ubantererana ngo ndabaterure mu maboko yanje, nk’uko umurezi aterura uruyoya, ngo ndabajane mu gihugu warahiye ba sekuruza ko uzokibaha?
Mbega nokura hehe inyama zikwiye aba bantu? Ko baguma banyidodombera bati: ‘Duhe inyama turye!’
Jewe sinshobora kwiremeka aba bantu bose jenyene; uyu mutwaro uraremereye cane.
Nimba uku ari ko bizohora, nunyicire ngaha ubu nyene, ungirire ubuntu mu nyonga zawe, kugira ngo undinde aya magorwa.”
Uhoraho abarira Mose ati: “Ntorera abakuru mirongo indwi mu Bisirayeli basanzwe bubahwa. Ubazane kw’Ihema ry’Ibonaniro, kugira ngo bahagararane nawe.
Nanje ndaza mvuganire nawe aho hantu, mpeze mfate ku Mpwemu iri kuri wewe nce ndayishira kuri bo. Bazogufasha kwikorera uwo mutwaro w’ubu bwoko kugira ngo ntubatware wenyene.

Ubwire abantu uti: ‘Mwitegure mwiyeze kubera umusi w’ejo, aho muzorya inyama. Uhoraho yabumvise igihe mwidodomba ngo: “Icoduha inyama zo kurya! Twari tumerewe neza muri Egiputa!” Nuko Uhoraho azobaha inyama, namwe muzozirya.
Ntimuzozirya gusa umusi umwe, canke imisi ibiri, canke itanu, canke icumi canke mirongo ibiri,
ariko ni ukwezi kwose, gushika aho zibaduhira zikabaca mu mazuru, kuko mwateye ibitugu Uhoraho , ari muri mwebwe, mukidodombera imbere yiwe, muvuga muti: “Mbega ni kuki twavuye muri Egiputa?” ’ ”
Ariko Mose aravuga ati: “Aba bantu bankikuje ntibari musi y’ibihumbi amajana atandatu bigize ikoraniro, none uvuze ngo: ‘Nzobaha inyama zo kurya ukwezi kwose!’
Mbega uwobabagira amasho n’imikuku vyo vyokwira? Mbega ifi zose zo mu kiyaga zorobwa zobakwira?”
Uhoraho yishura Mose ati: “Mbega ukuboko kw’ Uhoraho ni kugufi? Uzokwibonera ubwawe ko ivyo ndakubwiye bidashika kuri mwebwe.”
Nuko Mose arasohoka abarira abantu ivyo Uhoraho yavuze. Atoranya ba bakuru mirongo indwi bahagarara bazungurutse Ihema ry’Ibonaniro.

Nuko Uhoraho aramanuka ari muri ca gicu avugana na we, aca yakira ku Mpwemu yari kuri we ayishira kuri ba bakuru mirongo indwi. Igihe Mpwemu yabazako, baravugishijwe, ariko ntibasubira kuvugishwa hanyuma.

Ariko hari abagabo babiri, amazina yabo yari Eludadi na Medadi, bari basigaye aho bacumbitse. Bari kuri rwa rutonde rw’abakuru mirongo indwi, ariko ntibasohoka ngo baje kw’ihema. Ariko na bo nyene Mpwemu abazako, kandi bavugishirizwa aho bacumbitse.
Umusore umwe araza yiruka abarira Mose ati: “Eludadi na Medadi bariko baravugishirizwa aho ducumbitse.”
Yosuwa mwene Nuni, yari umwunganizi wa Mose kuva mu buto bwiwe, ashira ijwi hejuru aravuga ati: “Nyakwubahwa Mose, babuze!”
Ariko Mose arishura ati: “Ugize ishari ku bwanje? Icompa abantu b’ Uhoraho bose bakaba abavugishwa, Uhoraho akabashirako Mpwemu wiwe!”
Nuko Mose na ba bakuru b’Abisirayeli basubira aho bacumbitse.

Maze umuyaga uvuye k’ Uhoraho uraza uzana inkware uzikuye ku kiyaga, urazizana uzigwisha hagati y’aho bacumbitse, zagurukira nko ku ngero z’igice c’ukuboko zibiri uvuye hasi zikwira ahantu hangana n’urugendo rw’umusi umwe.

Kuri uwo musi, ku murango no mw’ijoro, no ku musi wakurikiye, abantu barasohoka begeranya inkware. Nta n’umwe yegeranije iziri musi y’ingero homeru icumi, baraheza bazisanza ku mpande zose z’aho bacumbitse kugira ngo zume.
Ariko igihe inyama zari zikiri mu menyo yabo batarazimira, ishavu ry’ Uhoraho riraziriringa, ashavurira abantu, abateza icago gikomeye.
Nuko aho hantu baca bahita Kiburoti Hatava bisigura “imva z’abipfuje inyama” kuko ari ho bahamvye abari bipfuje inyama.
Nuko abantu bava i Kiburoti Hatava bagenda gucumbika i Hazeroti bagumaho.
Miriyamu na Aroni batangura kuvuga nabi Mose kubera umugore wiwe w’Umunyakushi, kuko yari yarongoye Umunyakushikazi. Barabaza bati:
“Mbega Uhoraho yavugiye muri Mose gusa? Mbega ntiyavugiye no muri twebwe?” Maze Uhoraho aravyumva.
Uwo mugabo Mose yari umuntu aciye bugufi kurusha abandi bantu bose bo kw’isi.
Ubwo nyene Uhoraho abarira Mose, Aroni na Miriyamu ati: “Nimuze kw’Ihema ry’Ibonaniro, uko muri batatu.” Nuko uko ari batatu barasohoka.
Maze Uhoraho aramanuka ari mu nkingi y’igicu, ahagarara ku muryango w’Ihema, ahamagara Aroni na Miriyamu ngo abo babiri bigire imbere,
arababarira ati: “Nimwumve amajambo yanje: Iyo hari uwuvugishwa n’ Uhoraho muri mwebwe, ndamwihishurira mu vyo yerekwa, nkavugana na we mu ndoto.
Ariko si ko bimeze ku musavyi wanje Mose; ni umwizigirwa mu nzu yanje yose.
Mvugana na we imbonankubone, mu buryo bufoboye ntapfinze; arabona ishusho yanje jewe Uhoraho . None ni iki catumye mudatinya kuvuga nabi umusavyi wanje Mose?”
Uhoraho arabashavurira, aca aragenda abasigaho.
Ca gicu kimaze kuduga hejuru y’ihema, Miriyamu agihagaze ngaho yuzura imibembe, yera derere. Aroni ahindukiye ngo amurabe abona yuzuye imibembe;
na we aca abarira Mose ati: “Ndakwinginze nyakwubahwa, ntushishikare kuduharurako icaha cacu twakoze mu bujuju bwacu.
Ntumureke ngo amere nk’icavutse gipfuye kikiva mu nda ya nyina catanguye kubora.”
Nuko Mose atakambira Uhoraho ati: “Yewe Mana ndakwinginze umukize!”
Nuko Uhoraho yishura Mose ati: “Mbega iyo aba ari se yamuvumye amate mu maso, ntiyari kumara iyinga ryose amaramara? Nimumukure hagati y’aho mucumbitse hahere imisi indwi, hanyuma azobone kugaruka.”
Nuko rero Miriyamu ashirwa inyuma y’aho bacumbitse amarayo imisi indwi, abantu ntibava ngaho kugeza igihe yagarukanwa muri bo.
Inyuma y’ivyo Abisirayeli bava i Hazeroti bacumbika mu bugaragwa bw’i Parani.

headings.text: Miriyamu na Aroni bagirira ishari Mose

verses.text: Uhoraho abarira Mose ati:
“Rungika abagabo bamwe gutata igihugu c’i Kanani, ico ngiye guha Abisirayeli. Mu muryango wose batore umwe mu bakuru bawo.”
Maze nk’uko Uhoraho yari yategetse Mose arabarungika bavuye mu bugaragwa bw’i Parani. Bose bari abakuru mu Bisirayeli.
Ayo ni yo mazina yabo: Uwavuye mu muryango wa Reyubeni, ni Shamuwa mwene Zakuri;
uwavuye mu muryango wa Simeyoni, ni Shafati mwene Hori;
Uwavuye mu muryango wa Yuda, ni Kalebu mwene Yefune,
uwavuye mu muryango wa Isakari, ni Igali mwene Yosefu;
uwavuye mu muryango wa Efurayimu, ni Hoseya mwene Nuni
uwavuye mu muryango wa Benyamini, ni Paluti mwene Rafu;
uwavuye mu muryango wa Zebuloni, ni Gadiyeli mwene Sodi;
uwavuye mu muryango wa Manase (umuryango wa Yosefu), ni Gadi mwene Susi;
uwavuye mu muryango wa Dani, ni Amiyeli mwene Gemali;
uwavuye mu muryango wa Asheri, ni Seturi mwene Mikayeli;
uwavuye mu muryango wa Nafutali, ni Nahubi mwene Vofusi;
uwavuye mu muryango wa Gadi, ni Geyuweli mwene Maki.
Abo ni bo bagabo Mose yarungitse gutata igihugu. (Uwari asanzwe yitwa Hoseya mwene Nuni, Mose amwita Yosuwa.)
Igihe Mose yabatuma gutata igihugu c’i Kanani, yavuze ati: “Muce i Negebu, hanyuma muce muduga mu misozi.
Murabe uko ico gihugu kimeze kandi ko abantu baho ari abanyenkomezi canke abanyantegenke, ko ari bake canke ari benshi.
Murabe ko ico gihugu ari ciza canke kibi; uko ibisagara vyaco bimeze, nimba bifise inzitiro canke bitazifise.
Uko isi yaho imeze, ko imera canke ko itamera, ko hari ibiti canke ata biriho. Muze mukore ibishoboka vyose muzane ivyamwa vyo muri ico gihugu.” (Ico gihe hari mw’iyera ry’imizabibu ya mbere).
Nuko baraduga batata ico gihugu kuva mu Bugaragwa bw’i Zini gushika i Rehobu, aharabana n’i Lebo-Hamati.
Nuko baraduga baca i Negebu bashika i Heburoni aho Ahimani, Sheshayi na Talumayi abakomoka kuri Anaki baba. (Heburoni hari hubatswe imyaka indwi imbere ya Zowani muri Egiputa.)
Bashitse mu kiyaya c’i Eshikoli, basoroma amahando y’imizabibu. Abantu babiri ni bo bari baziteruye ku giti, umwe inyuma uwundi imbere, bongera bazana n’amakomamanga n’insukoni.
Aho hantu hitwa ikiyaya c’i Eshikoli (risobanurwa ngo ihando ry’inzabibu) kubera izo Abisirayeli basoromye aho hantu.
Haheze imisi mirongo ine baragaruka bavuye gutata ico gihugu.

Bagaruka kwa Mose na Aroni no ku Bisirayeli bose bari i Kadeshi mu bugaragwa bw’i Parani. Aho ni ho bahereye amakuru Mose na Aroni no n’ikoraniro ryose, bongera babereka ivyamwa bimera muri ico gihugu.
Ibi ni vyo bashikirije Mose: “Twagiye mu gihugu wari waturungitsemwo, kandi gitemba amata n’ubuki! Ng’ibi n’ivyama muri co.
Ariko abantu baba muri co ni abanyenkomezi, n’ibisagara vyaho bizitije inzitiro zikomeye kandi ndende cane. Twanabonyeyo n’abo mu ruvyaro rwa Anaki.
Abamaleki ni bo baba i Negebu, Abaheti, Abayebusi n’Abamori baba mu gihugu c’imisozi, Abanyakanani na bo baba ku nkengera z’ikiyaga n’uruzi rwa Yorodani.”
Nuko Kalebu asaba abantu guhora imbere ya Mose hanyuma aravuga ati: “Muze tuduge tuje gufata ico gihugu, kuko vy’ukuri tubishoboye.”
Ariko abagabo bari baduganye na we baravuga bati: “Ntidushobora gutera barya bantu; kuko baturusha inkomezi.”
Nuko bakwiragiza hose mu Bisirayeli iyo nkuru mbi yerekeye ico gihugu bagiye gutata. Baravuga bati: “Igihugu twagiye gutata ni igihugu kirya ababa muri co. Abantu bose twabonye muri co ni ibigatanya.
Twabonyeyo n’Abanefilimu (abakomoka kuri Anaki). Twari tumeze nk’inzige mu maso yacu ubwacu, kandi no kuri bo twasa nk’inzige.”
Muri iryo joro abantu bose bashira amajwi yabo hejuru bararira, baraboroga.
Abisirayeli bose bidodombera Mose na Aroni, kandi ikoraniro ryose rirababarira riti: “Iyo dupfuma dupfira muri Egiputa, canke muri buno bugaragwa!
Ni kuki Uhoraho atujanye muri kirya gihugu ngo tuje kwicishwa inkota? Abagore bacu n’abana bacu bazojanwe nk’inyagano. Mbega ivyotubera vyiza si uko twokwisubirira muri Egiputa?”
Nuko baravugana bati: “Reka twitorere uwuturongora duheze twisubirire muri Egiputa.”
Nuko Mose na Aroni bikubita hasi imbere y’ikoraniro ryose ry’Abisirayeli.
Yosuwa mwene Nuni na Kalebu mwene Yefune, mu bari baduze gutata ico gihugu, bitabagurirako impuzu zabo
babarira Abisirayeli bose bati: “Igihugu twaciyemwo ni igihugu ciza cane.
Uhoraho nimba atunezererewe, azoturongora akiduhe.
Ariko, ntimugararize Uhoraho kandi ntimutinye abantu bo muri ico gihugu, kuko tuzobamira miyonzwa. Icabakingira cakuweho, ariko tweho Uhoraho ari kumwe natwe. Ntimubatinye.”
Ariko ikoraniro ryose ritangura kuvugana ngo babatere amabuye. Maze ubwiza bw’ Uhoraho bubonekera Abisirayeli bose buri kuri rya hema ry’ibonaniro.
Uhoraho abarira Mose ati: “Aba bantu bazogeza ryari kunkengera? Bazogeza hehe kutanyizera, n’ibimenyetso bitangaje nakoreye hagati muri bo?
Reka ndabateze icago ndabamare, ariko wewe nzokugira ihanga rinini kandi rikomeye rizobarusha inkomezi.”
Mose abaza Uhoraho ati: “None Abanyegiputa bazokwiyumvira iki nibavyumva? Kuko wakuje iri hanga muri Egiputa ukuboko kwawe kw’inkomezi.

Niwabarandura bazovyumva kandi babibwire ababa muri iki gihugu, bamaze kwumva ko wewe Uhoraho , uri kumwe n’iri hanga kandi ko wewe Uhoraho bakwiboneye amaso ku yandi, ko igicu cawe kiba hejuru yabo, kandi ko ubaja imbere mu nkingi y’igicu ku murango n’inkingi y’umuriro mw’ijoro.
Niwicira aba bantu bose icarimwe, ya mahanga yumvise ivyo wakoze bazovuga bati:
‘ Uhoraho ntiyari ashoboye gushikana aba bantu mu gihugu yari yarabarahiye ko azokibaha; ni co catumye abicira mu bugaragwa.’
Ubu rero icompa inkomezi z’Imana zikiyerekana, nk’uko wabivuze uti:

‘ Uhoraho ateba kuraka, yuzuye urukundo rwinshi kandi ababarira icaha n’ubugarariji. Ariko ntazokwirengagiza guhana uwacumuye; ahora abana icaha ca ba se gushika ku runganwe rugira gatatu n’urugira kane.’
Nk’uko urukundo rwawe rwinshi ruri, harira icaha c’ubu bwoko, nk’uko wamye ubaharira kuva igihe baviriye muri Egiputa kugeza n’ubu.”
Uhoraho arishura ati: “Ndabahariye, nk’uko ubinsavye.
Ariko, ndahiye uguhoraho kwanje n’ubwiza bwanje bwuzuye isi yose,
nta n’umwe mu babonye ubwiza bwanje n’ibitangaza nakoreye muri Egiputa no mu bugaragwa ariko bakangarariza kandi bakangerageza incuro icumi zose;
azobona ico gihugu nasezeraniye ba sekuruza nkabarahira ko nzokibaha. Nta n’umwe mu bankengereye azokwigera akibona.
Ariko kubera umusavyi wanje Kalebu afise impwemu itandukanye n’iyabo kandi akankurikira n’umutima wiwe wose, nzomujana mu gihugu yagiye gutata, kandi uruvyaro rwiwe ruzoragwa ico gihugu.
Ko Abamaleki n’Abanyakanani baba mu biyaya, ejo muze muhindukire mugende mwerekeye mu bugaragwa mu nzira ija ku Kiyaga Gitukura.”
Uhoraho abarira Mose na Aroni ati:
“Aba bantu bononekaye bazogeza ryari kunyidodombera? Numvise imyidodombo y’aba Bisirayeli banyidodombera.
Nuko rero mubabwire muti uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: ‘Ndahiye uguhoraho kwanje, nzobakorera ivyo nyene numvise mwivugiye:
Imivyimba yanyu izogwa muri ubu bugaragwa, umuntu wese muri mwebwe afise imyaka mirongo ibiri n’iyirenga yaharuwe muri rya harura kandi yanyidodombeye.
Nta n’umwe wo muri mwebwe azokwinjira mu gihugu narahiye manitse ukuboko kwanjeko nzokibaha kikaba ahantu hanyu muba, atari Kalebu mwene Yefune na Yosuwa mwene Nuni.
Abana banyu mwavuze ngo bazojanwa kw’inyagano, ni bo nzojanayo banezerererwe ivyiza vy’ico gihugu mwateye ibitugu.
Ariko mweho, imivyimba yanyu izogwa muri ubu bugaragwa.
Abana banyu bazoba abungere hano kumara imyaka mirongo ine, bababazwe n’uguhemuka kwanyu, kugeza aho umuvyimba wa nyuma wo muri mwebwe uzokumbagarira muri ubu bugaragwa.

Kumara imyaka mirongo ine; umwaka wose uzohura n’umusi umwe muri ya misi mirongo ine mwamara muri gutata ico gihugu, muzoyimara mubabazwa kubera ivyaha vyanyu. Ni ho muzomenyera ico ari co kungira nk’umwansi wanyu.’
Ni jewe Uhoraho ndabivuze, kandi nzobishitsa kuri iri hanga ribi, ryahagurukiye rimwe kungwanya. Bazohonera muri ubu bugaragwa; ni ho bazopfira.”
Nuko ba bagabo Mose yari yatumye gutata igihugu, ari bo bagarutse bakagumura iryo hanga ryose kumugwanya mu gukwiza inkuru mbi y’ico gihugu,
abo bagabo nyene bakwije iyo nkuru mbi y’ico gihugu baciye bafatwa n’ikiza aho nyene imbere y’ Uhoraho baca bagwaho.
Muri abo bagabo bari barungitswe gutata ico gihugu hasigaye Yosuwa mwene Nuni na Kalebu mwene Yefune gusa.
Nuko Mose amaze kubibwira Abisirayeli, bose baca baborogera rimwe bikomeye.
Mu gitondo ca kare baca barahaguruka ngo baduge mu karere k’imisozi miremire. Bavuga bati: “Twaracumuye. Ubu turiteguye kuja muri ca gihugu Uhoraho yadusezeranira.”
Ariko Mose arababarira ati: “Ni kuki muriko murarenga kw’itegeko ry’ Uhoraho ? Nta co muzoshikako!
Ntimuduge, kuko Uhoraho atari kumwe namwe. Muzoneshwa n’abansi banyu,
kuko Abamaleki n’Abanyakanani bazobatangirira aho hantu. Kubera ko mwateye ibitugu Uhoraho , ntazobana namwe muzokwicwa n’inkota.”
Ariko banka kwumva, mu bwibone bwabo baraduga baja muri iyo misozi, naho Mose na ya sandugu y’isezerano batigeze bava aho bari bacumbitse.
Nuko Abamaleki n’Abanyakanani baba muri iyo misozi baramanuka barabatera bagenda barabica gushika i Horuma.
Uhoraho abarira Mose ati:
“Vugana n’Abisirayeli ubabwire uti: ‘Nimwinjira mu gihugu ngiye kubaha ngo mucegukire

nimwashikanira Uhoraho ikimazi co guturirwa, kivuye mu masho canke mu mikuku, nk’ubumote bwiza buhawe Uhoraho , yaba ari amashikanwa yo guturirwa canke ibimazi, vyaba ari ivyo gushitsa isezerano canke ivyo gushikana bitanzwe n’uwuvyishakiye canke amashikanwa y’imisi mikuru;
uwuzozana ishikanwa ryiwe aze ashikanire Uhoraho ishikanwa ry’ifu ringana n’ic’icumi c’ingero efa y’ifu inoze neza ivanze n’ica kane c’ingero hini y’amavuta.
Ku mwagazi w’intama wose utanzwe nk’ikimazi co guturirwa canke ikindi kimazi, muze mutegure ica kane c’ingero hini y’umuvinyu bibe ikimazi c’ibinyobwa.
Ku mpfizi y’intama yose muze mutegure ishikanwa ry’ifu ringana na bibiri vya cumi vy’ingero efa y’ifu inoze neza ivanze n’ica gatatu c’ingero hini y’amavuta,
hamwe n’ica gatatu c’ingero hini y’umuvinyu ngo bibe ishikanwa ry’ibinyobwa. Mubitange bibe ubumote bwiza bunezereza Uhoraho .
Nimwategura gutanga ishuri y’ikimazi co guturirwa canke ikindi kimazi, ryaba ishikanwa ryo gushitsa isezerano canke ikimazi c’ishimwe gishikaniwe Uhoraho ,
muze muzane iyo shuri hamwe n’ishikanwa ringana na bitatu vya cumi vy’ingero efa y’ifu inoze neza ivanzwe n’igice c’ingero hini y’amavuta.
Kandi muze muzane n’igice c’ingero hini y’umuvinyu bibe ishikanwa ry’ibinyobwa. Rizoba ari ishikanwa riturirwa, rizana ubumote bwiza bunezereza Uhoraho .
Ikimazi cose kigizwe n’ishuri canke impfizi y’intama, umwagazi w’intama canke umwagazi w’impene iyo ari yo yose, bize bitegurwe muri ubwo buryo.
Bize bikorwe gutyo ku kimazi cose gitanzwe, nk’uko igitigiri cavyo kingana.
Umuntu wese w’imvukira yo muri mwebwe aze akore ivyo bintu muri ubwo buryo igihe cose azotanga ikimazi co guturirwa ngo kizane ubumote bwiza bunezereza Uhoraho .

Uko urunganwe ruzogenda rukuranwa n’urundi, umunyamahanga aba muri mwebwe canke umuntu wese wo muri mwebwe azotanga ikimazi co guturirwa ngo kibe ubumote bwiza bunezereza Uhoraho , aze abikore nk’uko namwe mubikora.

Mwese muze mwisunge amategeko amwe, yaba mwebwe imvukira canke umunyamahanga aba muri mwebwe. Iryo rize ribe itegeko rizokwamaho uko urunganwe ruzogenda rukurakuranwa n’urundi. Mwebwe n’umunyamahanga aba muri mwebwe muri co kimwe imbere y’ Uhoraho :
Itegeko rimwe n’icagezwe kimwe ni vyo bizogenga mwebwe n’abanyamahanga baba muri mwebwe.’ ”
Uhoraho abarira Mose ati:
“Vugana n’Abisirayeli ubabwire uti: ‘Nimwashika mu gihugu ngiye kubaha
hanyuma mugafungura ivyo kurya vy’ico gihugu, muze mukureko ico mushikanira Uhoraho .
Muze mukore umukate mw’ifu y’ingano zeze imbere y’izindi, muwushikane nk’ishikanwa ry’ifu mukuye mu ngano za mbere musekuriye ku mbuga.
Uko urunganwe ruzogenda rukurikirana n’urundi muze mwame mushikanira Uhoraho iryo shikanwa rivuye mu vyeze imbere y’ibindi.
Umuntu niyarenga kw’itegeko na rimwe muri ayo Uhoraho yahaye Mose;
ya yandi yose Uhoraho yabategeka ayacishije kuri we, kuva ku musi yatanguriyeko kuyabaha kandi n’ubu akaba akiyabaha gushika uko urunganwe ruzogenda rukurikirana n’urundi;

niyaba yabikoze atabishaka abantu bose batabimenye, abantu bose baze batange ishuri ikiri ntoya nk’ikimazi co guturirwa ibe ubumote bwiza bunezera Uhoraho , hamwe na rya shikanwa ry’ifu ryashinzwe na rya shikanwa ry’ibinyobwa, atange n’isuguru y’impene y’ikimazi c’ivyaha.

Umuherezi aze atangire ikimazi co gukurako icaha ubwoko bwose bw’Abisirayeli, na bo bazoharirwa, kuko vyakozwe atabigabiye kandi bakaba bashikaniye Uhoraho ikimazi co guturirwa n’ikimazi c’ivyaha ku bw’amakosa yabo.
Abisirayeli bose n’abanyamahanga baba muri bo bazoharirwa, kuko abantu bose bazoba bafatanije muri ico gicumuro cakozwe batabigabiye.
Ariko umuntu umwe wenyene niyakora icaha atabigabiye, aze azane umwagazi w’impene umaze umwaka umwe w’ikimazi c’ivyaha.
Umuherezi aze atangire imbere y’ Uhoraho ikimazi gikurako ivyaha uwo muntu yacumuye atabigabiye, ico kimazi niyamara kugitanga, na we azoharirwa.
Iryo bwirizwa rimwe rizogenga abantu bose bacumuye batabigabiye, yaba ari imvukira y’Umwisirayeli canke umunyamahanga aba muri mwebwe.
Ariko umuntu niyakora icaha ibigirankana, ari imvukira canke umunyamahanga, azoba atutse k’ Uhoraho , kandi uwo muntu aze akurwe mu bantu biwe.
Kuko azoba yakengereye ijambo ry’ Uhoraho agacumura ku vyo yategetswe, uwo muntu ntaze abure gukurwaho; icaha ciwe kizomwomako.’ ”
Igihe Abisirayeli bari mu bugaragwa, basanze umugabo ariko arasenya inkwi ku musi w’Isabato.
Abamufashe ariko arasenya bamuzanira Mose na Aroni n’ikoraniro ryose,
baca bamushira mw’ibohero, kuko batari bwamenye ico bomukorera.
Nuko Uhoraho abarira Mose ati: “Uwo muntu akwiye gupfa. Ikoraniro ryose nirimutere amabuye inyuma y’aho bacumbitse.”
Nuko Ikoraniro ryose rimutwara inyuma y’aho bacumbitse bamutera amabuye maze arapfa, nk’uko Uhoraho yari yategetse Mose.
Uhoraho abarira Mose ati:
“Vugana n’Abisirayeli ubabwire uti: ‘Uko urunganwe ruzogenda rukurikirana n’urundi muze mwame mutera ubuyonga ku misozo y’impuzu zanyu, mushireko n’urunyuzi rw’ubururu ku buyonga bwose.
Namwe nimwaraba kuri ubwo buyonga muzokwibuka amategeko yose Uhoraho yabahaye, kugira ngo muyitondere ntimukwegwe n’ivyipfuzo vy’imitima yanyu n’amaso yanyu.
Nuko muzokwibuka kwumvira amategeko yanje yose muzobe mwegukiye Imana yanyu.
Ndi Uhoraho Imana yanyu, nabakuye muri Egiputa ngo mbe Imana yanyu. Ndi Uhoraho Imana yanyu.’ ”
Kora mwene Izihari, akomoka kuri Kohati mwene Lewi, baja hamwe n’abakomoka kuri Reyubeni; Datani na Abiramu, abahungu ba Eliyabu, akomoka kuri Oni mwene Peleti, baragumuka,
bava hasi kugwanya Mose. Bari kumwe n’abandi bakuru amajana abiri na mirongo itanu, bari bazwi neza ko ari abakuru mu bwoko bwose kandi bari baratowe ngo babe abo mu rwego rw’abarongozi.

Bahuza inama nk’umugwi ngo bagwanye Mose na Aroni bababarira bati: “Murarengeje urugero! Iri hanga ryose ni iryera, umuntu wese ku giti ciwe, kandi Uhoraho ari kumwe na bo. None ni iki gituma mwishira hejuru y’ubu bwoko bw’ Uhoraho ?”
Mose yumvise ivyo, yubama hasi.
Maze abarira Kora n’abari bamukurikiye ati: “Ejo mu gitondo Uhoraho azokwerekana uwiwe n’uwejejwe, kandi azomwiyegereza.
Mwebwe, Kora, namwe mwese mwamukurikiye muze mugire mutya: Muze mufate ivyotezo
ejo muze mubishiremwo umuriro n’ibimota neza iyo bituriwe mubizane imbere y’ Uhoraho . Umuntu Uhoraho azorobanura ni we azoba ari uwera. Yemwe bene Lewi, mwarenze akarimbi!”
Mose yongera abarira Kora ati: “Nimwumve ibi, yemwe Balewi!
Mbega ntibihagije ko Imana y’Abisirayeli yabatoranije mu bandi Bisirayeli ikabazana hafi yayo kugira ngo muyikorere ahera h’ Uhoraho kandi ngo muhagarare imbere y’ubu bwoko mubukorere?
Yarabegereje hafi yayo mwebwe n’abagenzi banyu b’Abalewi, ariko ubu na ho muriko murashaka kwigarurira ubuherezi na bwo!
Mwishize hamwe kugwanya Uhoraho . Aroni ni iki aho mumukurira hasi ngo mumugwanye?”
Nuko Mose ahamagara Datani na Abiramu, bene Eliyabu. Ariko bavuga bati: “Ntituza!
Mbega ntibihagije ivyo wadukoreye mu kudukura mu gihugu gitemba amata n’ubuki ukatuzana gupfira mu bugaragwa? None n’ubu na ho ugomba kwigira umwami wacu?
Ikigeretseko, ntiwatuzanye mu gihugu gitemba amata n’ubuki canke ngo uduhe ishamvu yacu canke amatongo y’imizabibu. Mbega wibwira ko twebwe turi impumyi? Oya, ntitugenda tuje!”
Nuko Mose arashavura cane maze abarira Uhoraho ati: “Ntiwemere ishikanwa ryabo. Sinigeze ndabatwara ikintu na kimwe, naho yoba indogoba, nta n’umwe muri bo nagiriye nabi.”
Mose abarira Kora ati: “Wewe n’abagukurikiye muze imbere y’ Uhoraho ejo; wewe na bo na Aroni.

Umwe wese azoze azanye icotezo ciwe ashireko ibimota neza iyo bituriwe; ivyotezo amajana abiri na mirongo itanu vyose hamwe, hanyuma muze imbere y’ Uhoraho . Wewe na Aroni namwe muze muzane ivyotezo vyanyu.”
Nuko umuntu wese azana icotezo ciwe, ashirako umuriro n’ibimota neza iyo bituriwe, bahagararana na Mose na Aroni ku muryango w’Ihema ry’Ibonaniro.
Maze Kora amaze kwegeranya abantu bose ngo bagwanye Mose imbere y’Ihema ry’Ibonaniro ubwiza bw’ Uhoraho bubonekera Abisirayeli bose.
Uhoraho abarira Mose na Aroni ati:
“Nimwitandukanye n’iri koraniro kugira ngo ndabarandure rimwe na rimwe.”
Ariko Mose na Aroni bagwa bubamye baratakamba bati: “Yewe Mana, Mana y’impwemu z’abariho bose, mbega woshavurira ikoraniro ryose kandi hacumuye umuntu umwe?”
Nuko Uhoraho abarira Mose ati:
“Bwira ikoraniro uti: ‘Nimwigire kure y’amahema ya Kora, Datani na Abiramu.’ ”
Mose ava hasi aja kwa Datani na Abiramu, kandi n’abakuru b’Abisirayeli baramukurikira.
Aburira ikoraniro ati: “Mwigire kure y’amahema y’abanyakibi! Ntimukore ku kintu na kimwe cabo, kugira ngo ntimurandurwe muzira ivyaha vyabo.”
Nuko bigira kure y’amahema ya Kora, Datani na Abiramu. Datani na Abiramu bari basohotse bahagaze imbere y’amahema yabo n’abagore babo, n’abana n’abakiri bato.
Nuko Mose aravuga ati: “Iki ni co kizobamenyesha ko Uhoraho ari we yantumye gukora ibi bintu ko bitari ivyo niyumviriye:
Aba bantu nibapfa urupfu rusanzwe bagahura n’ibisanzwe biba ku bandi bose, Uhoraho azoba atantumye.
Ariko Uhoraho niyazana ikintu gishasha, isi ikasama ikabamira n’ivyabo vyose, bakaja mu mva ari bazima, aho ni ho muzomenyera ko aba bantu bakengereye Uhoraho .”
Ahejeje kuvuga ivyo vyose, aho bari bahagaze harasama
isi yugurura akanwa kayo irabamira, n’ivyo batunze vyose n’abantu bose bari inyuma ya Kora n’ivyo bari batunze vyose.
Bamanuka i kuzimu ari bazima, n’ivyo bari batunze vyose; isi ica iriyugara, barahona bakurwa mu bandi Bisirayeli.
Abisirayeli bari hafi y’aho abo bari, bumvise ugutaka kwabo barahunga, kuko batinya ko isi ibamira na bo.
Umuriro uvuye k’ Uhoraho uraza utongora ba bagabo amajana abiri na mirongo itanu bariko baraturira ibimota neza.
Uhoraho abarira Mose ati:
“Bwira Eliyazeri mwene Aroni, umuherezi, agende atore birya vyotezo biri mu muriro, asuke kure amakara, kuko ivyo vyotezo ari ivyera vyanje;
ivyotezo vy’abo bantu bacumuye bigatuma bapfa. Muze mubicuremwo amabati yo gupfuka igicaniro, kuko vyashikirijwe Uhoraho bigaca biba ivyera. Bize bibere ikimenyetso Abisirayeli.”
Nuko Eliyazeri umuherezi yegeranya vya vyotezo vy’umwakaka vy’abatongowe n’umuriro, babicuramwo ivyo gupfuka igicaniro,

nk’uko Uhoraho yari yamutegetse abicishije muri Mose. Uko kwari ukwibutsa Abisirayeli ko ata muntu n’umwe atari uwo mu ruvyaro rwa Aroni yokwubahuka guturirira ibimota neza imbere y’ Uhoraho , atagomba kuba nka Kora n’abamukurikiye.
Bukeye ikoraniro ry’Abisirayeli bose bidodombera Mose na Aroni bavuga bati: “Mwishe abantu b’ Uhoraho .”
Ariko igihe abagize ikoraniro bariko baratonganya Mose na Aroni bahindukiye ngo barabe ihema ry’ibonaniro, ubwo nyene igicu caciye kiripfuka ubwiza bw’ Uhoraho buraboneka.
Nuko Mose na Aroni baca baja imbere y’ihema ry’ibonaniro,
maze Uhoraho abarira Mose ati:
“Igira kure ya rino koraniro kugira ngo ndabaherengeteze ubu nyene.” Baca bubama hasi.

Nuko Mose abarira Aroni ati: “Fata icotezo ushiremwo ibimota neza n’umuriro uvuye ku gicaniro, uce wihuta uje mu bantu ubatangire ikimazi gikura icaha. Uburake buvuye k’ Uhoraho buraje, ikiza kiratanguye.”
Nuko Aroni akora nk’uko Mose yamubwiye, aca yiruka mu bantu. Ikiza cari camaze gutangura kwica abantu. Ariko Aroni aturira ibimota neza ngo abatangire ikimazi gikura ivyaha.
Ahagarara hagati y’abazima n’abapfuye, ikiza kirahagarara.
Ariko abantu ibihumbi cumi na bine n’amajana indwi barapfa bishwe n’ico kiza, biyongera kuri bamwe bicwa kubera kugarariza kwa Kora.
Nuko Aroni agaruka aho Mose yari ari imbere y’ihema ry’ibonaniro, kuko ico kiza cari cahagaze.
Uhoraho abarira Mose ati:
“Bwira Abisirayeli bazane inkoni icumi na zibiri, imwimwe ku muryango wose ivuye ku mukuru aserukira uwo muryango. Uze wandike izina rya nyene inkoni ku nkoni yiwe.
Ku nkoni ya Lewi uze wandike izina rya Aroni, kuko hategerezwa kuba inkoni imwe ku mukuru w’umuryango wose.
Muze muzishire mw’Ihema ry’Ibonaniro imbere y’Isandugu y’Isezerano, aho mbonanira namwe.
Inkoni y’uwo nzoba ntoranije izoshurika, gutyo nzoba nikuriyeho imyidogo Abisirayeli bama bakwidogera.”
Nuko Mose avugana n’Abisirayeli, maze abakuru babo bazana inkoni zabo icumi na zibiri, imwimwe ku mukuru w’umuryango wose, n’inkoni ya Aroni yarimwo.
Mose ashira za nkoni imbere y’ Uhoraho mw’Ihema ry’ibishingantahe.
Bukeye Mose yinjira mw’Ihema ry’ibishingantahe aca asanga inkoni ya Aroni yaserukira umuryango wa Lewi, ntiyatutuje amababi gusa ahubwo yashuritse yongera yama na alumonde zihiye.
Nuko Mose asohora za nkoni azikura imbere y’ Uhoraho azizanira Abisirayeli bose. Baziravye, umwe wese atora iyiwe.
Uhoraho abarira Mose ati: “Subiza ya nkoni ya Aroni imbere y’Isandugu y’ibishingantahe, kugira ngo ibe ikimenyetso c’abagumutse. Ivyo bizokuraho imyidodombo banyidodombera, kugira ngo ntibapfe.”
Mose aca akora nk’uko Uhoraho yamutegetse nyene.
Abisirayeli babarira Mose bati: “Ehe tugiye gupfa! Turaheze, twese turaheze!
Umuntu wese agize ngo aregera gusa ihema ry’ Uhoraho aca apfa. Mbega none dupfe twese dushire?”

Uhoraho abarira Aroni ati: “Wewe n’abahungu bawe n’abo mu nzu ya so ni mwebwe muzobazwa ibicumuro vyose bizokorerwa mw’ihema ry’ibonaniro, kandi wewe n’abahungu bawe ni mwebwe mwenyene muzobazwa ibicumuro vyose bizokorwa ku bijanye n’ubuherezi.
Uze uzane Abalewi bagenzawe bagufashe mu gihe wewe n’abahungu bawe muriko murakora igikorwa canyu imbere y’ihema ry’ibishinga intahe.
Baze bagukorere bakore ibikorwa vy’ihema, ariko ntibaze begere ibikoresho vyera canke igicaniro, kugira ngo ntihagire uwupfa, yaba wewe canke bo.
Bazoba abo kugufasha mu gutunganya ivy’Ihema ry’Ibonaniro, ibikorwa vyose bijanye na ryo; kandi nta wundi yemerewe kwegera aho uri.
Mwebwe muzobazwa ivyo gutunganya ivy’ahera n’igicaniro, kugira ngo ishavu ryanje ntiryongere kuziriringa ku Bisirayeli.
Ni jewe ubwanje narobanuye bagenzi banyu b’Abalewi ndabakuye mu bandi Bisirayeli nk’ingabire ndabahaye, yeguriwe Uhoraho kugira ngo bakore ibikorwa vyo mw’ihema ry’ibonaniro.

Ariko wewe wenyene n’abahungu bawe ni mwebwe muzokora igikorwa c’ubuherezi hamwe n’ibintu vyose bijanye n’igicaniro no hirya ya ca gihuzu gikingiriye ahera. Nabahaye igikorwa c’ubuherezi nk’ingabire. Uwundi muntu wese azokwegera ahera aze yicwe.”
Nuko Uhoraho abarira Aroni ati: “Ni jewe ubwanje nakujeje ibimazi vyose banshikanira; ibimazi vyose vyera Abisirayeli banshikanira ndabiguhaye wewe n’abahungu bawe nk’umugabane wawe w’ibihe vyose.

Muze mwakire umugabane ku bimazi birusha ibindi kwera vyasigaye ku vyo baturiye. Ku mashikanwa banzanira nk’ibimazi bisumba ibindi kwera, ari ivyo ifu canke ibimazi vy’ivyaha canke vyo kwisaba, uwo mugabane uzoba ari uwawe n’abahungu bawe.
Muze mubirye muzi ko ari ivyera birusha ibindi; abagabo n’abahungu bonyene ni bo bemerewe kubiryako. Muze mubifate nk’ivyera nyene.

N’ibi na vyo ni ivyanyu: ibizova ku mashikanwa yo kuzungagiza atangwa n’Abisirayeli, ndabiguhaye wewe n’abahungu bawe n’abakobwa bawe nk’umugabane wanyu ibihe vyose. Umuntu wese aba mu nzu yanyu adahumanye yemerewe kubiryako.
Ndabahaye n’amavuta ya Elayo yose n’umuvinyu mushasha wose n’ingano banshikanira nk’ivyeze imbere y’ibindi mu vyimburwa vyabo.
Ivyeze imbere y’ibindi mu gihugu banshikanira jewe Uhoraho bizoba ari ivyanyu. Umuntu wese adahumanye aba mu nzu iwawe yemerewe kubiryako.
Ivyo Abisirayeli bagereye Uhoraho vyose ni ivyanyu.
Icavutse ubwambere cose, ari umuntu canke igitungano, bihawe Uhoraho vyose ni ivyanyu. Ariko muze mucungure imfura zanyu z’abahungu n’ivy’uburiza vy’ibikoko bizira.
Mu gihe bimaze ukwezi, muze mubicungure murihe ikiguzi co kubicungura kingana na shekeli zitanu z’ifeza, zipimwe hakoreshejwe ingero shekeli y’Ahera, ipima gera mirongo ibiri.

Ariko ntimuze mucungure iriza ry’ishuri, intama canke impene; bizoba ari ivyera. Muze mumijagire amaraso yavyo ku gicaniro muturire n’ibinure vyavyo nk’ikimazi co guturirwa, ubumote bwiza bunezera Uhoraho .
Inyama zavyo zizoba ari izanyu, hamwe n’igikiriza c’ishikanwa ryo kuzugunzwa n’itako ry’i buryo.

Ndabahaye ivyo Abisirayeli bazanye nk’amashikanwa yera; bizoba ari umugabane wanyu ibihe vyose wewe n’abahungu bawe n’abakobwa bawe, nk’uko isezerano ry’intahava nasezeranye nawe n’uruvyaro rwawe riri.”
Uhoraho abarira Aroni ati: “Nta shamvu canke umugabane uzoronka mu gihugu nzoha Abisirayeli ngo kibe icabo; ni jewe mugabane n’ubutunzi bwanyu hagati mu bandi Bisirayeli.
Mpaye Abalewi bose ibigiracumi vyose bivuye mu Bisirayeli nk’umugabane wabo kubera igikorwa bakora kw’ihema ry’ibonaniro.
Kuva ubu Abisirayeli ntibaze begere ihema ry’ibonaniro, kuko hoba inkurikizi mbi ku caha cabo bagapfa.

Abalewi ni bo bazokora igikorwa co kw’ihema ry’ibonaniro kandi babazwe amakosa yose yokorwa kuri ryo. Iri rize ribe itegeko ryamaho uko urunganwe ruzogenda rukurikirana n’urundi. Nta mugabane bazoronka mu bandi Bisirayeli.
Ariko, mpaye Abalewi nk’umugabane wabo ibigiracumi Abisirayeli bashikanira Uhoraho . Ni co gituma nabavuzeko nti: ‘Ntibazoronka umugabane mu Bisirayeli.’ ”
Uhoraho abarira Mose ati:
“Vugana n’Abalewi ubabwire uti: ‘Nimwakira ivyo bigiracumi ndabahaye nk’umugabane wanyu, muze mutange ikigiracumi c’ivyo mwakiriye nk’ishikanwa mushikaniye Uhoraho .
Iryo shikanwa ryanyu rizoba ari nk’ishikanwa ry’ingano canke ry’ibinyobwa abandi batanga babikuye mu vyimburwa vyabo no mu mato yabo baganiramwo inzabibu.
Uko ni ko namwe muzotanga ishikanwa k’ Uhoraho rivuye mu bigiracumi muronka bivuye mu Bisirayeli. Kuri ivyo bigiracumi muze mutange umugabane w’ Uhoraho uhabwa Aroni umuherezi.
Muze mutange nk’umugabane w’ Uhoraho umugabane urusha iyindi kwera ku bintu vyose muhawe.’
Bwira Abalewi uti: ‘Nimwashikana uwo mugabane uruta iyindi, uzoba ari nk’icavuye mu vyo mwimbuye ku mbuga no mu bwato muganiramwo.
Mwebwe n’abo mu mazu iwanyu muze murire ibisigaye aho ari ho hose kuko ari impembo yanyu kubera igikorwa canyu mukora mw’ihema ry’ibonaniro.
Nimwashikana wa mugabane uruta iyindi ntimuzoba mucumuye kuri ico; aho rero ntimuzohumanya amashikanwa yera y’Abisirayeli, ngo bibazanire gupfa.’ ”
Uhoraho abarira Mose na Aroni ati:
“Ibi ni vyo bisabwa n’Ivyagezwe Uhoraho yatanze: Ubwire Abisirayeli baze bakuzanire inka ifise ibara ryitwa akagajo itagira agasembwa kandi itigeze ikoreshwa ibikorwa vyo gukwega ingogo.
Uyihe Eliyazeri umuherezi. Iyo ni iyo kujanwa inyuma y’aho mucumbitse igakerererwa imbere yiwe.
Nuko Eliyazeri umuherezi aze yakire ku maraso yayo ayamijagire n’urutoke rwiwe incuro indwi atumbereye ku muryango w’Ihema ry’Ibonaniro.
Akiri ngaho nyene, iyo nka baze bayiturire urusato, inyama, amaraso n’amayezi.
Umuherezi aze afate igiti c’isederi, ishami rya ezobu n’ubwoya bw’intama busize irangi ritukura, abiterere muri uwo muriro uriko uraturira iyo nka.
Inyuma y’ivyo, umuherezi aze amesure impuzu ziwe yiyuhagire n’amazi, aho ni ho azoshobora kugaruka aho mucumbitse, ariko azoba agihumanye gushika ku mugoroba.
N’uwo muntu ayiturira na we nyene aze amesure impuzu ziwe yiyuhagire n’amazi kandi na we nyene azoguma ahumanye gushika ku mugoroba.

Umuntu azoba adahumanye aze yegeranye umunyota w’iyo nka awushire mu kibanza kidahumanye inyuma y’aho mucumbitse. Uze uzigamwe n’Abisirayeli kugira ngo baze bame bawukoresha mu mazi yo guhumanurwa; ni uwo gukurako ubuhumane bw’ivyaha.

Uwo muntu azokwegeranya uwo munyota w’iyo nka na we nyene aze amesure impuzu ziwe kandi azogume ahumanye gushika ku mugoroba. Iri rize ribe itegeko ry’intahava ku Bisirayeli no ku banyamahanga baba muri bo.
Uwuzokora ku muvyimba w’umuntu uwo ari we wese azoba ahumanye imisi indwi yose.
Aze yihumanure akoresheje ayo mazi yo guhumanurwa ku musi ugira gatatu no ku wugira indwi; ni ho azobona guhumanuka. Ariko natihumanura ku musi ugira gatatu no ku wugira indwi, ntazohumanuka.

Uwuzokora ku muvyimba w’umuntu uwo ari we wese hanyuma akananirwa no kwihumanura azoba yanduje ahera h’ Uhoraho . Uwo muntu aze akurwe mu Bisirayeli. Kuko atimijagiye ayo mazi ahumanura, azoba ahumanye; kandi ubwo buhumane buzomugumako.
Iri ni ryo tegeko rigenga uwapfiriye mw’ihema: umuntu wese azokwinjira muri iryo hema n’umuntu wese yari muri ryo bazoba bahumanye imisi indwi yose,
n’igikoresho cose kiri muri iryo hema kidapfundikijwe umupfundikizo kandi ukomeye kizoba gihumanye.
Umuntu azoba ari hanze agakora ku muntu yishwe n’inkota canke yishwe n’urupfu rusanzwe, canke agakora kw’igufa ry’umuntu canke ku mva, azoba ahumanye kumara imisi indwi.
