Ku bw’uwo yahumanye, uze ushire umunyota wa ya nka yaturirwa mu rwavya usukemwo amazi meza.

Hanyuma umuntu azoba adahumanye aze afate ezobu, ayikoze muri ya mazi ayamijagire kw’ihema n’ibikoresho biri muri ryo n’abantu bose bari bahari. Aze ayamijagire na wa muntu wese yakoze kw’igufa ry’umuntu canke ku mva canke ku muntu yishwe canke yapfuye urupfu rusanzwe.

Ku musi ugira gatatu no ku wugira indwi, aze ayamijagire kuri uwo muntu ahumanye, hanyuma ku musi ugira indwi aze amuhumanure. Uwo muntu ariko arahumanurwa aze amesure impuzu ziwe yiyuhagire n’amazi, maze ku mugoroba w’uwo musi azoba ahumanutse.
Ariko uwo muntu ahumanye natihumanura, aze akurwe mu bwoko bwanyu, kuko azoba ahumanije ahera h’ Uhoraho . Kubera ya mazi ahumanura atazoba yacucagiwe kuri we, azoba agihumanye.
Iri ni itegeko ridata igihe kuri bo. Uwo muntu amijagira ayo mazi ahumanura na we nyene aze amesure impuzu ziwe, n’uwuzokora kuri ayo mazi yo guhumanurwa azoba ahumanye gushika ku mugoroba.
Ikintu cose uwo ahumanye azokorako kizoba gihumanye, kandi uwuzogikorako wese azoba ahumanye gushika ku mugoroba.”
Mu kwezi kwa mbere Abisirayeli bose bashika mu bugaragwa bw’i Zini, baca baguma i Kadeshi. Aho ni ho Miriyamu yapfiriye aca ahambwaho.
Nuko habura amazi, abantu bahagurukira kugwanya Mose na Aroni.
Batatira Mose bavuga bati: “Iyo dupfuma dupfira rimwe na benewacu hamwe bagwa imbere y’ Uhoraho !
Ni kuki mwazanye abantu b’ Uhoraho muri ubu bugaragwa, kugira ngo twebwe n’ibitungwa vyacu dupfire hano?
Ni kuki mwatuduganye mudukuye muri Egiputa mukatuzana aha hantu habi? Nta ngano, nta misukoni, nta mizabibu canke amakomamanga; kandi nta n’amazi yo kunywa ariho!”
Mose na Aroni bava imbere y’ikoraniro baja ku muryango w’Ihema ry’Ibonaniro bubama hasi, maze ubwiza bw’ Uhoraho burababonekera.
Uhoraho abarira Mose ati:

“Akira ya nkoni yawe, ugende mwe na Aroni mukurwawe ukoranye Abisirayeli bose. Uze ubwire ico gitandara imbere yabo na co kizosuka amazi yaco. Uzokura amazi muri ico gitandara kugira ngo iryo koraniro ryose n’ibitungwa vyabo baze banywe.”
Nuko Mose afata ya nkoni ayikura imbere y’ Uhoraho , nk’uko yari yamutegetse.
We na Aroni bakoranya Abisirayeli bose imbere ya ca gitandara hanyuma Mose ababarira ati: “Umvirize yemwe mwa bagarariji mwe! Mbega twoshobora gukura amazi muri iki gitandara ngo munywe?”
Nuko Mose akiriza ukuboko kwiwe akubita ca gitandara kabiri na ya nkoni yiwe. Amazi aca aradudubiza, abantu baranywa n’ibitungwa vyabo.
Ariko Uhoraho abarira Mose na Aroni ati: “Kubera yuko mutanyizigiye bikwiye ngo mumpeshe icubahiro nk’Uwera imbere y’Abisirayeli, ntimuzoshikana ubu bwoko mu gihugu ngiye kubaha.”
Ayo ni yo mazi y’i Meriba, amazi y’imitongano, aho Abisirayeli batonganije Uhoraho na we akerekana ukwera kwiwe muri bo.
Mose arungika intumwa zivuye i Kadeshi ku mwami wa Edomu abatuma ati: “Ibi ni vyo abavukanyi banyu b’Abisirayeli babasavye: Murazi ibihe bigoye twaciyemwo.
Ba sogokuruza bacu bagiye muri Egiputa, hanyuma tubayo imyaka myinshi cane. Abanyegiputa badukorera ikibi cane twebwe na ba sogokuru bacu,
ariko tumaze gutakambira Uhoraho , aratwumva aca atuma umumarayika adukura muri Egiputa. Ubu rero turi ngaha i Kadeshi, igisagara kiri ku rubibe rw’igihugu canyu.

Nimutureke duce mu gihugu canyu. Ntituzoca mu murima n’umwe canke mu mizabibu, canke ngo tunywe amazi yo mw’iriba na rimwe. Tuzoca mw’Ibarabara ry’Umwami tudahindukira i buryo canke i bubamfu kugeza turenganye igihugu canyu.”
Ariko Abanyedomu babishura bati: “Ntimuze muce hano; nimwanabigerageza, tuzosohoka tubatere tubagwanishe inkota.”
Abisirayeli babishura bati: “Tuzokwijanira ibarabara rikuru, kandi yaba twebwe canke ibitungwa vyacu bizonywa ku mazi yanyu, tuzoyariha. Ico tugomba ni ukurengana nta kindi.”
Barasubira babishura bati: “Ntimuze muce hano.” Nuko Abanyedomu baraza kubatangira ngo babagwanye bafise ingabo nyinshi kandi zikomeye.
Abanyedomu bamaze kubima inzira ngo bace mu gihugu cabo, Abisirayeli barahindukira bicira ahandi.
Nuko Abisirayeli bose bava i Kadeshi baja ku musozi Hori.
Kuri uwo musozi Hori, hafi y’urugabano rwa Edomu, Uhoraho abarira Mose na Aroni ati:
“Aroni agiye gupfa ahamvye ab’iwabo. Ntazokwinjira mu gihugu ngiye guha Abisirayeli, kuko mwempi mwagararije itegeko ryanje ku mazi y’i Meriba.
Twara Aroni n’umuhungu wiwe Eliyazeri ku musozi Hori.
Wambure Aroni impuzu ziwe uzambike umuhungu wiwe Eliyazeri, kuko Aroni agiye guhamvya ab’iwabo, azopfira aho nyene.”
Mose akora nk’uko Uhoraho yamutegetse: Baduga wa musozi Hori ishengero ryose ribaraba.
Mose yambura Aroni za mpuzu ziwe azambika umuhungu wiwe Eliyazeri. Maze Aroni apfira aho nyene ku gatwe k’uwo musozi. Mose na Eliyazeri bamanuka wa musozi,
abantu bose bamaze kumenya ko Aroni yapfuye, Abisirayeli bose baramugandarira imisi mirongo itatu.
Umwami w’Umunyakanani yaganza ahitwa Aradi, yaba i Negebu, yumva ko Abisirayeli bariko baraza baciye mu nzira ija i Atarimu, aca atera Abisirayeli kandi afata bamwe muri bo abagira imbohe.
Nuko Abisirayeli basezerana iri sezerano imbere y’ Uhoraho bati: “Niwagabura aba bantu mu maboko yacu, natwe tuzosambura rwose ibisagara vyabo.”
Uhoraho yumva ugutakamba kwabo aca agabura abo Banyakanani mu maboko yabo. Baca barabarandura bose mbere basambura n’ibisagara vyabo vyose. Aho hantu haca hitwa Horuma risigura “imisaka”.
Baragenda bava ku musozi Hori bajana inzira ija ku Kiyaga Gitukura, kugira ngo bazunguruke ntibace mu gihugu ca Edomu. Ariko abantu barambirwa n’urugendo;
batangura kuvuga nabi Imana na Mose bati: “Ni kuki mwadukuye muri Egiputa ngo tuze gupfira mu bugaragwa? Nta vyokurya bihari! Nta mazi ahari! Kandi n’ibi vyokurya manu bitagira ikimazi vyatuduhiye!”
Nuko Uhoraho arungika inzoka z’ubumara muri bo; zirabakomora Abisirayeli benshi barapfa.
Abantu baza aho Mose yari ari bamubarira bati: “Twacumuye kuko twavuze nabi Uhoraho na wewe. Dusengere Uhoraho adukuremwo izi nzoka.” Nuko Mose aca arabasengera.
Uhoraho abarira Mose ati: “Kora inzoka uyimanike ku giti; umuntu wese yakomowe n’inzoka niyayiraba arakira.”
Nuko Mose acura inzoka mu mwakaka ayimanika ku giti. Maze umuntu wese yari yakomowe n’inzoka, aravye ya nzoka y’umuringa, yaca akira.
Maze Abisirayeli barunguruza bacumbika i Oboti.
Mu nyuma barunguruza bava i Oboti bacumbika muri Iye Abarimu, mu bugaragwa buri mu buseruko bwa Mowabu.
Bava ngaho barunguruza bacumbika mu kiyaya ca Zeredi.
Bava aho barabandanya bacumbika ku nkengera za Arunoni. Urwo ruzi Arunoni ni rwo rwagabura igihugu ca Mowabu n’ic’Abamori.
Ni co gituma mu gitabu c’ivy’Intambara z’ Uhoraho hariho ahavuga ngo: “Wahebu muri Sufa n’imigezi yisuka muri rwo, Arunoni
n’imigezi yisuka muri rwo inkombe zarwo zo kuri Ari ni zo rubibe rwa Mowabu.”
Bava ngaho barabandanya no kuri Beyeri, iriba riri aho Uhoraho yabwiriye Mose ati: “Koranya abantu nanje ngiye kubaha amazi.”
Nuko Abisirayeli baririmba indirimbo ivuga ngo: “Dudubiza, wa riba! Nimuriririmbe
rya riba ryimbwa n’abaganwa, ryatobowe n’abanyacubahiro bakoresheje amacumu yabo n’inkoni zabo.” Nuko bava mu bugaragwa baja i Matana,
Bava i Matana baja i Nahaliyeli, bava i Nahaliyeli baja i Bamoti,
bavuye i Bamoti baja mu kiyaya c’i Mowabu aho umuntu ashobora kubona ubugaragwa ari ku gatwe k’umusozi wa Pisiga.
Abisirayeli barungika intumwa kubwira Sihoni umwami w’Abamori bati:

“Nimutureke duce mu gihugu canyu. Ntituzohindukira ngo turabe ku ruhande mu mirima yanyu canke mu nzabibu zanyu, canke ngo tunywe amazi yo mu mariba yanyu. Tuzokwicira mw’Ibarabara ry’Umwami, gushika twirenganiye tukava mu gihugu canyu.”
Ariko Sihoni ntiyemerera Abisirayeli guca mu gihugu ciwe. Aca akoranya ingabo ziwe zose aja mu bugaragwa gutera Abisirayeli; ashitse i Yahazi, agwana na bo.

Abisirayeli baramugwanya baramunesha babamarisha inkota bafata n’igihugu ciwe kuva ku ruzi Arunoni gushika kuri Yaboki, gushika ku rubibe rwo mu buseruko bw’Abamoni, kuko urwo rubibe rwari ruzitijwe inzitiro.
Bafata ibisagara vyose vy’Abamori, harimwo Heshiboni n’imihana yose ihakikuje.
Heshiboni cari igisagara ca Sihoni umwami w’Abamori, uwo yari yaragwanye n’umwami yahora aganza i Mowabu aca afata ico gihugu ciwe gushika ku ruzi rwa Arunoni.
Ni co gituma abavuga ivyese bavuze ngo: “Nimuze i Heshiboni muhubake; igisagara ca Sihoni nigisubire cubakwe.
Umuriro wadutse uva muri Heshiboni urubeya rwavuye mu gisagara ca Sihoni. Rwaturiye muri Ari ahantu ho muri Mowabu, N’abanyagihugu baba ku nkengera za Arunoni.
Uragowe, yewe Mowabu! Murasambuwe, yemwe bantu basenga Kemoshi! Abahungu babo babaye impunzi n’abakobwa babaye inyagano, za Sihoni umwami w’Abamori.
Ariko twarashe imyampi ku Bamori; I Heshiboni hasambuwe, gushika i Diboni. Twahasambuye gushika i Nofa, mbere n’Umuriro wararurumvye gushika i Medeba.”
Nuko Abisirayeli baca bashinga amahema mu gihugu c’Abamori.
Mose amaze kurungika abatasi mu gisagara c’i Yazeri, Abisirayeli baca bafata ibigwati bihakikuje basohora Abamori bari muri vyo.
Nuko barahindukira bafata inzira iduga ija i Bashani; maze Ogi, umwami w’i Bashani, n’ingabo ziwe zose baza guhura na bo kugira ngo bagwanire ahitwa Edireyi.
Uhoraho abarira Mose ati: “Ntimumutinye kuko namutanze mu maboko yanyu, we n’ingabo ziwe zose n’igihugu ciwe. Muze mumukorere nk’ivyo mwakoreye Sihoni umwami w’Abamori, yaganza i Heshiboni.”
Nuko baramugwanya baramunesha, n’abahungu biwe bose n’ingabo ziwe zose, ntibasigaza umuntu n’umwe. Baca begukira igihugu ciwe.
Nuko Abisirayeli bagenda berekeye ku kiyaya c’i Mowabu, baca bacumbika ku nkengera y’uruzi Yorodani hakurya y’i Yeriko.
Maze Balaki mwene Zipori abona ivyo Abisirayeli bakoreye Abamori,
Abanyamowabu baca bagira ubwoba bwinshi kuko Abisirayeli bari benshi. Kandi vy’ukuri Abanyamowabu baciye bihebura kubera Abisirayeli.

Nuko Abanyamowabu babarira abatware b’i Midiyani bati: “Iri sinzi ry’aba bantu bagiye kurigata ibintu vyose bidukikuje, baturigate nk’uko inka irisha ubwatsi.” Nuko Balaki mwene Zipori ari we yari umwami w’i Mowabu muri ico gihe,
Arungika intumwa guhamagara Balamu mwene Beyori, yari i Petori, hafi y’uruzi Efurate, iyo yavuka. Balaki aravuga ati: “Hari abantu bavuye muri Egiputa; buzuye igihugu cose kandi begereye aho ndi.
Nuko rero nuze ubamvumire, kuko bandusha inkomezi. Kumbure noshobora kubanesha nkabasohora mu gihugu canje. Kuko nzi ko abo uhezagiye bahezagirwa, abo uvumye bakabako umuvumo.”
Maze za ntumwa zari zigizwe n’abakuru b’i Mowabu n’i Midiyani baragenda, batwaye n’ingemu. Bashitse kwa Balamu, bamubarira ivyo Balaki yabatumye.
Balamu ababarira ati: “Nimurare ngaha, nanje nzobabwira inyishu Uhoraho azompa.” Nuko abo bakuru b’i Mowabu bagumana na we.
Maze Imana iraza ibaza Balamu iti: “Abo bantu muri kumwe ni ba nde?”
Balamu yishura Imana ati: “Balaki mwene Zipori, umwami w’i Mowabu, yantumyeko ubutumwa buvuga ngo:
‘Abantu bavuye muri Egiputa buzuye igihugu cose. None nuze ubamvumire. Kumbure noshobora kubagwanya no kubirukana mu gihugu.’ ”
Ariko Imana ica ibwira Balamu iti: “Ntujane na bo. Ntuze uvume abo bantu kuko bahezagiwe.”
Bukeye mu gitondo Balamu aravyuka abarira ba bakuru ba Balaki ati: “Nimusubire mu gihugu canyu, kuko Uhoraho yanse ko njana namwe.”
Maze ba bakuru b’i Mowabu basubira kuri Balaki baramubwira bati: “Balamu yanse kuzanana natwe.”
Hanyuma Balaki atuma abandi bakuru benshi kuruta ba bandi babarusha n’icubahiro.
Bashika kwa Balamu baramubwira bati: “Balaki mwene Zipori avuze ngo: Ntihagire ikikubuza kuza iwanje,
kuko nzoguha impembo ishimishije kandi nzokora ico uzombwira cose. Nuze umvumire aba bantu.”
Ariko Balamu arabishura ati: “Naho Balaki yompa inzahabu n’ifeza vyuzuye inzu yiwe, sinokora ikintu na kimwe, caba kinini canke gito, ngo ndenge kw’itegeko ry’ Uhoraho Imana yanje.
Nuko nimurare hano nk’uko abandi bagize, nanje menye ico Uhoraho ari bumbarire.”
Iryo joro Imana iraza ibaza Balamu iti: “Aba bantu ko baje kuguhamagara, jana na bo, ariko uze ukore ico nzokubwira gusa.”
Balamu avyuka mu gitondo, ategura indogoba yiwe ajana n’abo bakuru b’i Mowabu.
Ariko Imana ishavuzwa cane n’uko Balamu agiye, maze umumarayika w’ Uhoraho ahagarara mu nzira ngo amutangire. Balamu yari ku ndogoba yiwe, kandi yari kumwe n’abakozi biwe babiri.
Ya ndogoba ibona wa mumarayika w’ Uhoraho ahagaze mu nzira afise inkota isokoye mu rwubati, ica irakevya ija mw’ishamba; ariko Balamu arayikubita ayisubiza mu nzira.
Nuko wa mumarayika w’ Uhoraho ahagarara ahantu inzira yaga hagati y’imizabibu ibiri, hari impome zibiri ku mpande zose.
Ya ndogoba ibonye wa mumarayika w’ Uhoraho , igerageza kumuca i ruhande yegera uruzitiro ruri ku nzira, ica ifyondera ikirenge ciwe kuri rwa ruzitiro. Nuko aca arasubira arayikubita.
Maze wa mumarayika w’ Uhoraho arasubira yigira imbere ahagarara aho inzira yaga ata ho ishobora gukebereza, haba i buryo canke i bubamfu.
Ya ndogoba ibonye wa mumarayika w’ Uhoraho , ica iryama hasi Balamu akiri kuri yo, na we aca arashavura cane aca arayikubita.
Nuko Uhoraho yugurura akanwa ka ya ndogoba, ibwira Balamu iti: “Mbega nagukoreye iki ko umaze kunkubita gatatu kose?”
Balamu yishura iyo ndogoba ati: “Wankinishije! Iyo mba mfise inkota, mba ndakwishe ubu nyene!”
Ya ndogoba yishura Balamu iti: “Mbega sindi indogoba yawe, iyo wahora ugenderako, gushika uwu musi? Mbega nari bwagukorere nk’ibi?” Arishura ati: “Oya.”
Nuko Uhoraho yugurura amaso ya Balamu, abona wa mumarayika w’ Uhoraho ahagaze mu nzira yasokoye inkota mu rwubati. Aca arunama aryama hasi.
Wa mumarayika w’ Uhoraho aramubaza ati: “Wakubitiye iki iyo ndogoba yawe gatatu kose? Nzanywe no kugutangira kuko inzira uriko urajana itari yo mu maso yanje.
Indogoba yambonye ica irakevya gatatu kose. Iyo idakevya, ubu mba nakwishe, ariko yo nkayireka.”
Balamu yishura Umumarayika w’ Uhoraho ati: “Nacumuye. Sinamenye ko uhagaze mu nzira ngo untangire. Ubu niwaba udashaka ko ngenda, nca nsubira inyuma.”
Uwo mumarayika w’ Uhoraho abarira Balamu ati: “Jana n’abo bantu, ariko uzovuga ivyo nkubwira gusa.” Nuko Balamu ajana n’abo bakuru ba Balaki.
Balaki amenye ko Balamu ariko araza, arasohoka aja kumusanganira mu gisagara c’Abanyamowabu kiri ku nkengera ya Arunoni, ku rubibe rw’igihugu ciwe.
Balaki abarira Balamu ati: “Mbega ko nagutumyeko ubutumwa bwihutirwa ntuze? Ni kubera iki utaje kare? Mbega wibaza ko ntashoboye kuguha ingero ikwiye?”
Balamu arishura ati: “Ehe ndaje ubu, ariko sinshobora kuvuga ico nishakiye. Nja kuvuga ivyo Imana ija gushira mu kanwa kanje gusa.”
Nuko Balamu ajana na Balaki i Kiriyati-Huzoti.
Balaki atanga ibimazi vy’inka n’intama, bimwe abiha Balamu na ba bakuru bari kumwe na we.
Bukeye mu gitondo Balaki atwara Balamu ku musozi Bamoti-Bayali, aho ashobora kubona igice c’Abisirayeli.
Balamu aravuga ati: “Nyubakira ibicaniro indwi ngaha, munzanire n’impfizi indwi z’inka n’izindi indwi z’intama”
Balaki akora nk’uko Balamu avuze, hanyuma bompi batangira impfizi y’inka n’impfizi y’intama ku gicaniro cose.

Nuko Balamu abarira Balaki ati: “Guma ngaha hafi y’ikimazi cawe nanje ngiye harya hirya ndabe ko Uhoraho hari ico yombwira. Ico ampishurira cose ndakikubwira.” Nuko Balamu aca araduga aja ku gatwe k’umusozi ata co kamerako.
Imana ibonana na we, maze Balamu aravuga ati: “Nateguye ibicaniro indwi, kandi natangiye ku gicaniro cose impfizi y’inka n’iy’intama.”
Uhoraho aramubwira ati: “Subira kwa Balaki umubwire ubu butumwa.”
Nuko asubira kwa Balaki amusanga i ruhande ya ca kimazi ciwe, ari kumwe na ba baganwa b’i Mowabu.
Nuko Balamu atangura kuvugishwa ati: “Balaki yanzanye ankuye muri Aramu, umwami w’i Mowabu yankuye mu misozi yo mu buseruko. Ati: ‘Nuze, umvumire aba Yakobo; vuga ivy’ibibi ku Bisirayeli.’
Novuma nte Abo Imana itavumye? Novuga gute ibibi ku bantu Uhoraho atavugako ibibi?
Ndi ku dutwe tw’agasozi k’amabuye nababona, ndi hejuru ku misozi, nabitegereza. Mbona ari ihanga ryibera ukwaryo ritandukanye n’ayandi mahanga.
Ni nde yoharura umukungugu wa bene Yakobo? Ngo adondagure isinzi ry’Abisirayeli? Uzompe gupfa urupfu rw’abagororotsi, kandi n’iherezo ryanje rize ribe nk’iryabo!”
Balaki abarira Balamu ati: “Unkoreye ibiki? Nakuzanye kumvumira abansi banje, none nta kindi uriko urakora atari ukubahezagira!”
Aramwishura ati: “Mbega sinkwiye kuvuga ivyo Uhoraho ashize mu kanwa kanje?”
Nuko Balaki aramubwira ati: “Ingo tujane ahandi aho ushobora kubabona bose. Aha ubona igice cabo gusa ariko ntushobora kubabona bose. Aho ni ho uca ubamvumira.”
Nuko amujana ku kibuga co gushibamako c’i Zofimu ku gatwe k’umusozi Pisiga, ahubaka ibicaniro indwi abituririrako impfizi y’inka n’impfizi y’intama kuri kimwekimwe cose.
Balamu abarira Balaki ati: “Guma ngaha hafi y’ikimazi cawe nanje ngiye guhura n’ Uhoraho hariya.”
Uhoraho ahura na Balamu ashira mu kanwa kiwe ivyo aja kuvuga, aca aramubwira ati: “Subira aho Balaki ari umushire ubu butumwa.”
Nuko aja iyo Balaki ari amusanga agihagaze i ruhande ya vya bimazi vyiwe, ari kumwe na ba bakuru b’i Mowabu. Balaki aramubaza ati: “ Uhoraho yavuze iki?”
Maze Balamu atangura kuvugishwa ati: “Haguruka, Balaki wumvirize; nunyumve, yewe mwene Zipori.
Imana si umuntu, ngo ibeshe, canke umwana w’umuntu, ngo yivuguruze. Iyo ivuze ikintu, iragikora; iyo isezeranye, irashitsa isezerano.
Nategetswe guhezagira; Imana yarahezagiye, nanje sinoshobora kubihindura.
Nta kibi yabonye mu ba Yakobo, nta karenganyo yabonye mu Bisirayeli. Uhoraho Imana yabo iri kumwe na bo; impundu y’Umwami yumvikana muri bo.
Imana yabakuye muri Egiputa; bafise inkomezi nk’iz’imbogo.
Nta muvumo ushobora gushika ku ba Yakobo, nta bupfumu bwogira ico bumara ku Bisirayeli. Guhera ubu bizohora bivugwa kuri Yakobo no kuri Isirayeli ngo: ‘Raba ivyo Imana yakoze!’
Iryo hanga rihaguruka nk’intambwe y’ingore; bahaguruka nk’intare itaruhuka itaratabagura ico yishe kandi itaranywa amaraso y’ivyo yahize.”
Nuko Balaki abarira Balamu ati: “Nimba udashaka kubavuma reka no kubahezagira!”
Balamu arishura ati: “Sinakubwiye ko ntegerezwa gukora ivyo Uhoraho avuze?”
Balaki abarira Balamu ati: “Nuze ndakujane ahandi. Kumbure bizohimbara Imana ikureke ubamvumire uri ngaho.”
Balaki ajana Balamu ku gatwe k’umusozi wa Peyori, hahanamiye ubugaragwa.
Balamu aravuga ati: “Nyubakira ibicaniro indwi ngaha, untegurire impfizi indwi z’inka n’impfizi z’intama indwi.”
Balaki akora nk’uko Balamu yavuze, aca ashikana impfizi y’inka n’iy’intama ku gicaniro cose.

Maze Balamu abonye ko Uhoraho yashimye guhezagira Abisirayeli, ntiyagenda hirya kurondera uguhishurirwa n’ Uhoraho nk’uko yari yamye abikora ubwa mbere, ariko arahindukira yerekeza amaso mu bugaragwa.
Maze Balamu araramuye amaso abona Abisirayeli bacumbitse bakurikije uko imiryango yabo imeze, Mpwemu w’Imana amuzako
aca aravugishwa ati: “Uku ni ko Balamu mwene Beyori avuga, uku ni ko uwubona neza avuga,
Uku ni ko uwumva amajambo y’Imana avuga, uwubona ivyo yeretswe n’Iyishoboravyose, uwubama hasi, amaso yiwe akuguruka:
Ese ingene amahema yawe ari meza, yewe Yakobo, amazu wiberamwo, yewe Isirayeli!
Bimeze nk’inzuzi zitemba, ni nk’imirima itewe hafi y’umugezi; ni nk’ibiterwa vyitwa Alowe vyatewe n’ Uhoraho , ni nk’ibiti vy’amasederi ari i ruhande y’amazi.
Amazi azosesa arenge inkombe zayo Imbuto zavyo zizoronka amazi menshi. Umwami wabo azoba uwuhambaye kuruta Agagi; ubwami bwabo buzoshirwa hejuru.
Imana yabakuye muri Egiputa; bafise inkomezi nk’iz’imbogo. Bazorigata amahanga abanka amagufa yabo bayagire ubunywenywe; bazobatobaguza imyampi yabo.
Baricaye barabunze nk’intambwe, mbere nk’intambwe y’ingore; ni nde yobavyura? Abaguhezagira baragahezagirwa, abakuvuma na bo barakavumwa!”
Nuko Balaki ashavurira Balamu cane. Akubita amashi ku yandi aramubwira ati: “Nagutumyeko kuvuma abansi banje, ariko wabahezagiye incuro zitatu zose.
Va ngaha, taha ubu nyene! Nari navuze ko ndakugerera ingero ishimishije, ariko Uhoraho akubujije kugererwa.”
Balamu yishura Balaki ati: “Nari nabwiye abo watumye kumpamagara nti:
‘Naho Balaki yompa ikirimba ciwe cuzuye inzahabu n’ifeza, sinzogira ico nkora na kimwe nigeneye, caba ciza canke kibi, ngo nyuranye n’ico Uhoraho yategetse; ntegerezwa kuvuga ivyo Uhoraho avuga’?
Ubu rero ndisubiriye iwacu, ariko reka ndakuburire ivyo aba bantu bazokorera abantu bawe mu misi izoza.”
Nuko atangura kuvugishwa ati: “Uku ni ko Balamu mwene Beyori avuga, uwufise amaso abona neza avuga ibi,
uwufise amatwi yumva amajambo y’Imana avuga ibi, uwufise ukumenya kuva ku Yisumbavyose, akabona ivyo yeretswe n’Iyishoboravyose, uwuca bugufi akubama, amaso yiwe akuguruka:

Ndamubona, ariko si ubu nyene; ndamwitegereza, ariko ntari hafi. Inyenyeri izova muri Yakobo; icumu ry’ukuganza rizoshingwa muri Isirayeli. Azomenagura mu ruhanga h’Abanyamowabu, amenagure imitwe ya bene Sheti.
Edomu hazoneshwa; Seyiri, mu bansi biwe hazoneshwa, ariko Isirayeli azokuzwa.
Uwuganza azova muri Yakobo arandure amasigarira y’igisagara.”
Nuko Balamu abonye Abamaleki atangura kuvugishwa ati: “Abamaleki bahora ari ihanga rya mbere mu yandi, ariko iherezo ryabo bazoranduka rwose.”
Abonye Abakayini abavugishwako ati: “Wibera ahatekanye, icari cawe kiri ku gitandara;
ariko mwebwe Abakayini muzosamburwa igihe Abashuri bazokujana uri inyagano.”
Yongera kuvugishwa ati: “Yo! Mbega ni nde azosigara Imana atari yo imushigaje?
Amato azova ku nkengera za Kupuro; acinyize Ashuri kandi ababaze Eberi, ariko na bo nyene amaherezo bazoranduka.”
Nuko Balamu ava hasi yitahira iwe Balaki na we ajana inzira yiwe.
Abisirayeli bakiri i Shitimu, abagabo batangura gusambana n’abakobwa b’Abanyamowabukazi,
babatumirira guha ibimazi ibigirwamana vyabo.
Nuko Abisirayeli bifatanya na bo mu gusenga Bayali-Peyori. Uhoraho arabashavurira cane.
Uhoraho abarira Mose ati: “Fata ba bakuru bose b’ubu bwoko, ubice ubanikire ku zuba imbere y’ Uhoraho , kugira ngo ishavu ryanje rive ku Bisirayeli.”
Nuko Mose abarira abacamanza b’Abisirayeli ati: “Umuntu wese wo muri mwebwe niyice abagabo bose bifatanije n’abandi mu gusenga Bayali-Peyori.”
Nuko umugabo w’Umwisirayeli azana i muhira iwe umugore w’Umumidiyanikazi amucisha imbere ya Mose n’Abisirayeli bose aho bariko bararirira ku muryango w’Ihema ry’Ibonaniro.
Nuko Finehasi mwene Eliyazeri, umuhungu wa Aroni, umuherezi, abibonye, ava mw’ikoraniro, afata icumu
akurikira wa Mwisirayeli mw’ihema ryiwe. Abatobekeranya bompi na rya cumu, wa Mwisirayeli na wa mugore. Maze ikiza cari ku Bisirayeli kirahagarara;
ariko abari bamaze gupfa kubera ico kiza bashika ku bihumbi mirongo ibiri na bine.
Uhoraho abarira Mose ati:
“Finehasi mwene Eliyazeri, umuhungu wa Aroni, umuherezi, ahwamitse ishavu ryanje riva ku Bisirayeli. Kubera ko yagize ishaka nkanje ryo kugarukana icubahiro canje, bitumye nigarura ngo sindabamare.
Nuko umubwire ko ngiranye na we isezerano ry’amahoro.
We n’uruvyaro rwiwe rwose baronse isezerano ridahera ry’ubuherezi, kuko yagize ishaka ryo guhesha icubahiro Imana yiwe agatangira Abisirayeli bose ikimazi gikuraho ivyaha.”
Uwo Mwisirayeli yicanywe n’uwo Mumidiyanikazi yitwa Zimuri mwene Salu, umukuru w’umuryango w’Abasimeyoni.
Kandi uwo mugore w’Umumidiyanikazi yishwe yitwa Kozibi umukobwa wa Zuri, umukuru w’umuryango umwe w’Abamidiyani.
Uhoraho abarira Mose ati:
“Mufate Abamidiyani nk’abansi banyu kandi muze mubice,
kuko babafashe nk’abansi babo igihe babahenda mu vy’i Peyori no mu vya Kozibi, umukobwa w’umukuru w’umuryango umwe mu miryango yabo, wa mugore yicwa igihe icago catera kubera inkurikizi y’i Peyori.”
Inyuma y’ico kiza Uhoraho abarira Mose na Eliyazeri mwene Aroni, umuherezi ati:
“Harura Abisirayeli bose uko imiryango yabo iri; abamaze imyaka mirongo ibiri n’iyirenga bashobora kuja ku rugamba.”
Nuko bari mu biyaya vy’i Mowabu ku nkengera za Yorodani aharabana n’i Yeriko, Mose na Eliyazeri umuherezi bavugana na bo bababarira bati:
“Harura abagabo bamaze imyaka mirongo ibiri n’iyirenga, nk’uko Uhoraho yategetse Mose.” Aba ni bo Bisirayeli bavuye muri Egiputa:
Abo mu ruvyaro rwa Reyubeni, imfura ya Isirayeli, bari: abakomoka kuri Hanoki, umuryango w’Abahanoki; abakomoka kuri Palu, umuryango w’Abapalu;
abakomoka kuri Hezironi, umuryango w’Abahezironi; abakomoka Kuri Karumi, umuryango w’Abakarumi.
Iyo ni yo yari imiryango y’Abareyubeni; Abaharuwe bari ibihumbi mirongo ine na bitatu n’amajana indwi na mirongo itatu.
Mwene Palu yari Eliyabu,
bene Eliyabu bari Nemuweli, Datani na Abiramu. Abo nyene Datani na Abiramu bari abakuru b’abantu bagumukanye Mose na Aroni bakaba bari mu bakurikiye Kora igihe bagumuka k’ Uhoraho .
Isi irasama irabamira hamwe na Kora, abamukurikira na bo bapfuye igihe umuriro warandura abantu amajana abiri na mirongo itanu. Ibatangako akarorero.
Ariko inzu ya Kora ntiyaherengeteye.
Abo mu ruvyaro rwa Simeyoni nk’uko inzu zabo zari zimeze ni: abakomoka kuri Nemuweli, inzu y’Abanemuweli; abakomoka kuri Yamini, inzu y’Abayamini; abakomoka kuri Yakini, inzu y’Abayakini;
abakomoka kuri Zera, inzu y’Abazera; abakomoka kuri Sawuli, inzu y’Abasawuli.
Izo ni zo zari inzu z’Abasimeyoni; bari abagabo ibihumbi mirongo ibiri na bibiri n’amajana abiri.
Abo mu ruvyaro rwa Gadi nk’uko inzu zabo zari ziri ni: abakomoka kuri Zefoni, inzu y’Abazefoni; abakomoka kuri Hagi, inzu y’Abahagi; abakomoka kuri Shuni, inzu y’Abashuni;
abakomoka kuri Ozuni, inzu y’Abozuni; abakomoka kuri Eri, inzu y’Aberi;
abakomoka kuri Arodi, inzu y’Abarodi; abakomoka kuri Areli, inzu y’Abareli.
Iyo ni yo yari imiryango ya Gadi; abaharuwe bari ibihumbi mirongo ine n’amajana atanu.
Eri na Onani ni bo bari bene Yuda, ariko bapfiriye i Kanani.
Abakomoka kuri Yuda nk’uko inzu zabo zari ziri ni: abakomoka kuri Shela, inzu y’Abashela; abakomoka kuri Perezi, inzu y’Abaperezi; abakomoka kuri Zera, inzu y’Abazera.
Abo mu ruvyaro rwa Perezi bari: abakomoka kuri Hezironi, inzu y’Abahezironi; abakomoka kuri Hamuli, inzu y’Abahamuli.
Abo ni abo mu nzu za Yuda; abaharuwe bari ibihumbi mirongo indwi na bitandatu n’amajana atanu.
Abo mu ruvyaro rwa Isakari nk’uko inzu zabo zari ziri ni: abakomoka kuri Tola, inzu y’Abatola; abakomoka kuri Puwa, inzu y’Abapuwa;
abakomoka kuri Yashubi, inzu y’Abayashubi; abakomoka kuri Shimuroni, inzu y’Abashimuroni.
Izo ni zo zari inzu z’Abisakari; abaharuwe bari ibihumbi mirongo itandatu na bine n’amajana atatu.
Abo mu ruvyaro rwa Zebuloni nk’uko inzu zabo zari ziri ni: abakomoka kuri Seredi, inzu y’Abaseredi; abakomoka kuri eloni, inzu y’Abeloni; abakomoka kuri Yahileyeli, inzu y’Abayahileyeli.
Izo ni zo zari inzu z’Abazebuloni; abaharuwe bari ibihumbi mirongo itandatu n’amajana atanu.
Abo mu ruvyaro rwa Yosefu nk’uko inzu zabo zari ziri bakomotse kuri Manase na Efurayimu ni:
Abo mu ruvyaro rwa Manase: abakomoka kuri Makiri, inzu y’Abamakiri (Makiri ni we yari se wa Gileyadi); abakomoka kuri Gileyadi, inzu y’Abagileyadi.
Aba ni abo mu ruvyaro rwa Gileyadi: abakomoka kuri Iyezeri, inzu y’Abiyezeri; abakomoka kuri Heleki, inzu y’Abaheleki;
abakomoka kuri Asiriyeli, inzu y’Abisirayeli; abakomoka kuri Shekemu, inzu y’Abashekemu;
abakomoka kuri Shemida, inzu y’Abashemida; abakomoka kuri Heferi, inzu y’Abaheferi.
(Zelofehadi mwene Heferi nta bahungu yari afise; yari afise abakobwa gusa, amazina yabo ni Mahala, Nowa, Hogula, Milika na Tiriza.)
Izo ni zo nzu z’Abamanase; abaharuwe bari ibihumbi mirongo itanu na bibiri n’amajana indwi.
Aba ni bo bari abo mu ruvyaro rwa Efurayimu nk’uko inzu zabo zari ziri: abakomoka kuri Shutela, inzu y’Abashutela; abakomoka kuri Bekeri, inzu y’Ababekeri; abakomoka kuri Tahani, inzu y’Abatahani.
Abakomoka kuri Shutela ni: abakomoka kuri Erani, inzu y’Aberani.
Izo ni zo nzu z’Abefurayimu; abaharuwe bari ibihumbi mirongo itatu na bibiri n’amajana atanu. Aba ni bo bakomoka kuri Yosefu nk’uko inzu zabo zari ziri.
Abo mu ruvyaro rwa Benyamini nk’uko inzu zabo zari ziri ni: abakomoka kuri Bela, inzu y’Ababela; abakomoka kuri Ashibeli, inzu y’Abashibeli; abakomoka kuri Ahiramu, inzu y’Abahiramu;
abakomoka kuri Shufamu, inzu y’Abashufamu; abakomoka kuri Hufamu, inzu y’Abahufamu.
Abakomoka kuri Bela biciye kuri Aridi na Namani ni: abakomoka kuri Aridi, inzu y’Abaridi; abakomoka kuri Namani, inzu y’Abanamani.
Izo ni zo nzu z’Ababenyamini; abaharuwe bari ibihumbi mirongo ine na bitanu n’amajana atandatu.
Aba ni abo mu ruvyaro rwa Dani nk’uko inzu zabo zari ziri: abakomoka kuri Shuhamu, inzu y’Abashuhamu. Izo ni zo nzu z’Abadani:
Bose bari abo mu nzu y’Abashuhamu; kandi abaharuwe bari ibihumbi mirongo itandatu na bine n’amajana ane.
Aba ni abo mu ruvyaro rwa Asheri nk’uko inzu zabo zari ziri: abakomoka kuri Imuna, inzu y’Abimuna; abakomoka kuri Ishuvi, inzu y’Abishuvi; abakomoka kuri Beriya, inzu y’Ababeriya;
Abakomotse ku ruvyaro rwa Beriya ni: abakomoka kuri Heberi, inzu y’Abaheberi; abakomoka kuri Malukiyeli, inzu y’Abamalukiyeli.
Asheri yari afise umukobwa yitwa Sera.
Izo ni zo zari inzu z’Abasheri; abaharuwe bari ibihumbi mirongo itanu na bitatu n’amajana ane.
Abo mu ruvyaro rwa Nafutali nk’uko inzu zabo zari ziri ni: abakomoka kuri Yahaziyeli, inzu y’Abayahaziyeli; abakomoka kuri Guni, inzu y’Abaguni;
abakomoka kuri Yezeri, inzu y’Abayezeri; abakomoka kuri Shilemu, inzu y’Abashilemu.
Izo ni zo nzu z’Abanafutali; abaharuwe bari ibihumbi mirongo ine na bitanu n’amajana ane.
Igitigiri cose c’abagabo b’Abisirayeli cari ibihumbi amajana atandatu na kimwe n’amajana indwi na mirongo itatu.
Uhoraho abarira Mose ati:
“Igihugu kize kigaburwe hisunzwe ibitigiri vy’imiryango.
Umuryango munini muze muwuhe hanini, umuryango muto muwuhe hatoya; umwe wese aze aronke umugabane wiwe hisunzwe ibitigiri vyaharuwe.
Kandi muze mukoreshe ubupfindo mu kugabura igihugu, umugwi uwo ari wo wose uzoronka umugabane wawo hisunzwe amazina y’umuryango wa ba sekuru.
Umugabane uzotangwa hakoreshejwe ubupfindo kandi harabwe ko umuryango ari munini canke mutoya.”
Aba ni bo Balewi baharuhwe nk’uko inzu zabo zari ziri: abakomoka kuri Gerishoni, inzu y’Abagerishoni; abakomoka kuri Kohati, inzu y’Abakohati; abakomoka kuri Merari, inzu y’Abamerari.
N’izi na zo zari inzu z’Abalewi: inzu y’Abalibuni, inzu y’Abaheburoni, inzu y’Abamahili, inzu y’Abamushi inzu y’Abakora. (Kohati yari se wa Amuramu;
Muka Amuramu yitwa Yokebedi, yanduruka mu ruvyaro rwa Lewi, yavukiye muri Egiputa. Yavyaranye na Amuramu Aroni, Mose na mushiki wabo Miriyamu.
Aroni ni se wa Nadabu na Abihu, Eliyazeri na Itamari.
Ariko Nadabu na Abihu bapfuye igihe baturirira amashikanwa imbere y’ Uhoraho bakoresheje umuriro utemewe.)
Abahungu bose b’Abalewi bari bamaze ukwezi no kurenga baharuwe bari ibihumbi mirongo ibiri na bitatu. Ntibaharuwe hamwe n’abandi Bisirayeli kuko ata mugabane bari bafise muri bo.
Abo ni bo baharuwe na Mose na Eliyazeri umuherezi igihe baharura Abisirayeli mu kiyaya c’i Mowabu ku nkombe ya Yorodani aharabana n’i Yeriko.
Nta n’umwe yari muri bamwe baharurwa na Mose na Aroni umuherezi igihe babaharurira mu bugaragwa bw’i Sinayi.
Kuko Uhoraho yari yarabwiye abo Bisirayeli ko bazopfira mu bugaragwa, kandi nta n’umwe yari agisigaye kiretse Kalebu mwene Yefune na Yosuwa mwene Nuni.

Abakobwa ba Zelofehadi mwene Heferi, umuhungu wa Gileyadi, Gileyadi mwene Makiri, Makiri mwene Manase, bose bakomoka kuri Manase mwene Yosefu. Amazina y’abo bakobwa yari Mahala, Noha, Hogula, Milika na Tiriza. Baragenda begera
umuryango w’Ihema ry’Ibonaniro bahagarara imbere ya Mose, ya Eliyazeri umuherezi, ya ba bakuru n’ikoraniro ryose, bavuga bati:
“Data yapfiriye mu bugaragwa. Ntiyari mu bakurikiye Kora, bagize akagwi ko kugwanya Uhoraho , ariko yishwe n’icaha ciwe kandi nta bahungu yasize.
None ni co cotuma izina rya data rizimangana mu muryango wiwe ngo ni uko ata muhungu yavyaye? Turasavye umugabane mu bo mu muryango wa data.”
Nuko Mose ajana ikibazo cabo imbere y’ Uhoraho
hanyuma Uhoraho amubwira ati:
“Ivyo abakobwa ba Zelofehadi bavuga ni vyo. Uze ubahe itongo nk’iragi muri ba sewabo, umugabane wa se uwubahe.
Bwira Abisirayeli uti: ‘umuntu niyapfa adasize umuhungu, umugabane wiwe uze uhabwe umukobwa wiwe.
Niyaba adafise umukobwa, umugabane wiwe uze uhabwe abahungu bavukana na we.
Niyaba adafise abahungu bavukana, uwo mugabane wiwe uze uhabwe abahungu bavukana na se wiwe.

Se wiwe niyaba adafise abahungu bavukana, muze muhe uwo mugabane wiwe uwo mu muryango wiwe wa hafi, kugira ngo awegukire. Iki kize kibe ikintu cemewe n’amategeko mu Bisirayeli, nk’uko Uhoraho yabitegetse Mose.’ ”
Nuko Uhoraho abarira Mose ati: “Duga uwu musozi wo mu misozi igize Abarimu urabe igihugu ngiye guha Abisirayeli.
Niwamara kukibona, nawe nyene uzohamvya abanyu, nk’uko vyagenze kuri Aroni mukurwawe,

kuko igihe ikoraniro ryagumuka kuri ya mazi yo mu bugaragwa bw’i Zini, mwempi ntimwumviye itegeko ryanje ngo mumpeshe icubahiro nk’Uwera imbere y’amaso yabo.” (Ayo ni ya mazi y’i Meriba i Kadeshi, mu bugaragwa bw’i Zini.)
Mose abarira Uhoraho ati:
“Icompa Uhoraho , Imana y’impwemu z’abantu bose, agashiraho umuntu wo kurongora ubu bwoko
kugira ngo abaje imbere amaja n’amaza, uwuzobarongora basohotse canke binjira, kugira ngo abantu b’ Uhoraho ntibabe nk’intama zitagira umwungere.”
Nuko Uhoraho abarira Mose ati: “Jana Yosuwa mwene Nuni, umuntu arimwo Mpwemu, umurambikeko ikiganza.
Umuhagarike imbere ya Eliyazeri umuherezi n’ishengero ryose umushikirize ibikorwa imbere yabo.
Umuhe ku bubasha bwawe kugira ngo ishengero ry’Abisirayeli bose baze bamwumvire.

Aze ahagarare imbere ya Eliyazeri umuherezi, kuko ari we azomushikiriza ingingo zivuye k’ Uhoraho , azoronka akoresheje ubupfindo bwa Urimu. Ategetse we n’Abisirayeli bose bazosohoka, ategetse bazokwinjira.”
Mose akora nk’uko Uhoraho yari yamutegetse. Ajana Yosuwa amuhagarika imbere ya Eliyazeri umuherezi n’ikoraniro ryose.
Maze amurambikako ibiganza aca aramutuma, nk’uko Uhoraho yari yabitegetse biciye muri Mose.
Uhoraho abarira Mose ati:
“Tegeka Abisirayeli ubabwire uti: ‘Mwiyubare kugira ngo mu gihe cashinzwe muze mushikanire imfungurwa zanje ari vyo vya bimazi vyo kwoswa nk’umubabwe umota neza unezera.’
Ubabwire uti: ‘Iri ni ryo shikanwa ryo guturirwa mukwiye gushikanira Uhoraho : imyagazi y’intama ibiri imaze umwaka itagira agasembwa, nk’ikimazi co guturirwa cama gitangwa ku musi ku musi.
Muze mushikane umwe mu gitondo, uwundi ku mugoroba,
hamwe n’ishikanwa ry’ifu ringana n’ic’icumi c’ingero efa y’ifu inoze neza n’ica kane c’ingero hini y’amavuta ya elayo.
Ico ni ikimazi co guturirwa cama gitangwa nk’uko vyashinzwe ku Musozi Sinayi ngo kibe ubumote bwiza bushikaniwe Uhoraho .
Ishikanwa ry’ibinyobwa riherekeza iryo rize ribe ica gatatu c’ingero hini, hamwe n’uwo mwagazi. Muze musuke iryo shikanwa ry’ibinyobwa ahera imbere y’ Uhoraho .
Muze mushikane umwagazi wa kabiri ku mugoroba, hamwe n’ishikanwa ry’ifu n’iry’ibinyobwa risa n’irya mbere ryo mu gitondo. Ico ni ikimazi giturirwa, ishikanwa rimota neza rihimbara Uhoraho .

Ku musi w’Isabato, muze mutange imyagazi y’intama ibiri imaze umwaka umwe kandi itagira agasembwa, hamwe n’ishikanwa ry’ibinyobwa n’ishikanwa bijanye rigizwe na bibiri vya cumi vy’ingero efa y’ifu ikaranzwe mu mavuta ya elayo.
Ni co kimazi co guturirwa kizotangwa uko Isabato ishitse, ciyongera kuri ca kimazi co ku musi ku musi n’ishikanwa bijana ry’ibinyobwa.

Kw’igenekerezo rya mbere ry’ukwezi kwose, muze mushikanire Uhoraho ikimazi giturirwa kigizwe n’impfizi zibiri z’inka, impfizi y’intama ikuze imwe, n’impfizi z’intama indwi zimaze umwaka umwe, zitagira agasembwa.

Impfizi yose y’inka muze muyishikane hamwe n’ishikanwa ry’ifu rigizwe na bitatu vya cumi vy’ingero efa y’ifu inoze neza ikaranze mu mavuta, hanyuma impfizi yose y’intama ize ijane n’ishikanwa ry’ifu rigizwe na bibiri vya cumi vy’ingero efa y’ifu inoze neza ikaranzwe mu mavuta;
kandi umwagazi w’intama wose, uze ujane n’ica cumi c’ingero efa y’ifu inoze neza ikaranzwe mu mavuta. Ico ni co kimazi co guturirwa, ubumote bwiza bushikaniwe Uhoraho .

Impfizi yose ize iherekezwe n’ishikanwa ry’ibinyobwa ringana n’igice c’ingero hini y’umuvinyu; hanyuma impfizi yose y’intama na yo iherekezwe n’ica gatatu c’ingero hini; umwagazi w’intama na wo, uherekezwe n’ica kane c’ingero hini. Ico ni ikimazi gitangwa uko ukwezi kwose mu mezi agize umwaka gutanguye.
I ruhande y’ibimazi vyo guturirwa vyama bitangwa n’ishikanwa ribiherekeza, haze hatangwe n’isuguru y’impene y’ikimazi c’ivyaha gishikaniwe Uhoraho .
Ku musi ugira icumi na kane w’ukwezi kwa mbere muze muhimbaze Pasika y’ Uhoraho .
Ku musi ugira icumi na gatanu w’ukwo kwezi nyene muze mugire umusi mukuru; muze mumare imisi indwi murya imikate itarimwo umwambiro.
Ku musi wa mbere muzogire ikoraniro ryera kandi ntimuze mugire igikorwa muwukorako.
Muze mushikanire Uhoraho ibimazi vyo guturirwa n’umuriro, bigizwe n’impfizi zibiri z’inka, impfizi y’intama imwe n’imyagazi y’intama indwi imaze umwaka, kandi itagira agasembwa.
Ishuri yose izojana n’ishikanwa ry’ifu rigizwe na bitatu vya cumi vy’ingero efa y’ifu inoze neza ikaranze mu mavuta; impfizi y’intama na yo ijane n’ibilo bitandatu;
kandi umwagazi w’intama wose muri iyo ndwi, uzojana n’ibilo bitatu.
Muze mwongereko isuguru y’impene imwe y’ikimazi c’ivyaha co kubabera igikuraho icaha.
Ivyo bizokwiyongera ku bimazi biturirwa muzokwama mutanga imisi yose mu gatondo.

Uko ni ko muzokwama mushikana ivyo bimazi ku musi ku musi muri iyo misi yose uko ari indwi, imfungurwa z’amashikanwa y’ubumote bwiza bunezera Uhoraho ; bize vyame bitegurwa vyiyongera ku bimazi vyo guturirwa muhora mutanga ku musi hamwe n’ishikanwa rijana na vyo ry’umuvinyu.
Ku musi ugira indwi muze mugire ikoraniro ryera kandi ntimuze mugire igikorwa muwukorako.
Ku musi wo gushikanira Uhoraho ivyatanguye kwera imbere y’ibindi mu misi mikuru y’amayinga, muze mugire ikoraniro ryera kandi ntimuze mugire igikorwa na kimwe mukora.
Muze mutange ikimazi co guturirwa c’amashuri abiri akiri mato, impfizi y’intama ikuze imwe n’impfizi z’intama indwi zimaze umwaka, bibe ubumote bwiza buhimbara Uhoraho .
Impfizi yose ize iherekezwe n’ishikanwa ringana na bitatu vya cumi vy’ingero efa y’ifu inoze neza ikaranze mu mavuta; impfizi y’intama imwe na yo iherekezwe na bibiri vya cumi vy’ingero efa;
umwagazi wose muri iyo myagazi indwi, uzoherekezwa n’ica cumi c’ingero efa.
Uze ushiremwo n’isuguru y’impene imwe yo gutanga nk’ikimazi gikurako ivyaha vyanyu.

Muze mutegure ibi vyose hamwe n’ishikanwa ry’ibinyobwa bijanye, bizokwiyongera kuri ca kimazi co guturirwa co ku musi ku musi n’ishikanwa ry’ifu bijanye. Muze mwiyubare ivyo bitungwa ntibize bibe bifise agasembwa.

headings.text: Ibimazi vyo ku musi ku musi

verses.text: Ku musi wa mbere w’ukwezi kw’indwi muze mugire ikoraniro ryera kandi ntimuze mugire ico mukora. Uzoba ari umusi mukuru kuri mwebwe wo kuvuza inzamba.
Ikimazi c’ubumote bwiza bunezera Uhoraho , kizobe ikimazi co guturirwa kigizwe n’ishuri imwe ikiri nto, impfizi y’intama imwe n’imyagazi y’intama indwi imaze umwaka, vyose bibe ibitagira agasembwa.
Iyo shuri ize iherekezwe n’ishikanwa ringana na bitatu vya cumi vy’ingero efa y’ifu inoze neza ivanze n’amavuta ya elayo; hanyuma iyo mpfizi y’intama na yo izoherekezwe na bibiri vya cumi;
kandi umwagazi wose uzoherekezwa na kimwe ca cumi.
Muze mushiremwo n’isuguru y’impene imwe y’ikimazi c’ivyaha kugira ngo kibe ikimazi co kubakurako ivyaha vyanyu.

Ivyo bize vyiyongere kuri vya bimazi bitangwa uko ukwezi gutashe n’ivyo ku musi ku musi n’amashikanwa y’ifu n’ay’ibinyobwa nk’uko vyashinzwe. Bizoba ari ibimazi vyo guturirwa n’umuriro bishikaniwe Uhoraho ; ubumote bwiza bumuhimbara.
Ku musi ugira icumi w’uko kwezi kw’indwi muze mugire ikoraniro ryera. Muze mwisonzeshe kandi ntihagire ico mukora.

Muze mutange ishikanwa ribe ubumote bwiza bunezera Uhoraho , rizoba ari ikimazi co giturirwa kigizwe n’impfizi y’inka ikiri nto, impfizi y’intama imwe n’imyagazi y’intama indwi imaze umwaka, vyose bitagira agasembwa.
Impfizi yose izoherekezwa n’ishikanwa ringana na bitatu vya cumi vy’ingero efa y’ifu inoze neza ikaranze mu mavuta; hanyuma ya mpfizi y’intama na yo izoherekezwa n’ibilo bitandatu;
kandi umwagazi wose muri iyo ndwi uzoherekezwa n’ibilo bitatu.
Muze mushiremwo n’isuguru y’impene imwe y’ikimazi c’ivyaha, hejuru y’iryo shikanwa ry’ivyaha hamwe n’ibimazi biturirwa biri kumwe n’ishikanwa ry’ifu bijanye, n’amashikanwa y’ibinyobwa.
Ku musi ugira icumi na gatanu w’uko kwezi kw’indwi, muze mugire ikoraniro ryera kandi ntihagire ico mukora. Muhimbaze umusi mukuru w’ Uhoraho imisi indwi.

Muze mushikanire Uhoraho ikimazi co guturirwa nk’ubumote bwiza bunezera Uhoraho , ikimazi co guturirwa kigizwe n’amashuri icumi n’atatu, impfizi z’intama zibiri n’imyagazi y’intama icumi n’ine imaze umwaka, vyose bibe bitagira agasembwa.
Ishuri yose muri izo icumi na zitatu ize iherekezwe na bitatu vya cumi vy’ingero efa y’ifu inoze neza ikaranze mu mavuta; hanyuma impfizi y’intama yose ize iherekezwe n’ibilo bitandatu;
kandi umwagazi wose muri ya myagazi icumi n’ine, uzoherekezwe n’ibilo bitatu.
Muze mwongereko isuguru y’impene y’ikimazi c’ivyaha, yiyongera ku kimazi co guturirwa cama gitangwa ku musi ku musi n’ishikanwa ry’ifu n’iry’ibinyobwa bijanye.
Ku musi wa kabiri muze mutegure amashuri icumi n’abiri, impfizi z’intama zibiri n’imyagazi y’intama icumi n’ine imaze umwaka umwe, vyose bibe bitagira agasembwa.
Kuri ayo mashuri, izo mpfizi z’intama n’iyo myagazi, muze mwongereko amashikanwa y’ifu n’ay’ibinyobwa bijanye mukurikije igitigiri cavuzwe.

Ku musi ugira kane muze mutegure amashuri icumi, impfizi z’intama zibiri n’imyagazi y’intama icumi n’ine imaze umwaka, vyose bibe bitagira agasembwa.

Ku musi ugira gatanu muze mutegure amashuri icenda, impfizi z’intama zibiri n’imyagazi y’intama icumi n’ine imaze umwaka, vyose bibe bitagira agasembwa.
Kuri ayo mashuri, izo mpfizi z’intama n’iyo myagazi, muze mwongereko amashikanwa y’ifu n’ay’ibinyobwa bijanye mukurikije igitigiri cavuzwe.

Kuri ayo mashuri, izo mpfizi z’intama n’iyo myagazi, muze mwongereko amashikanwa y’ifu n’ay’ibinyobwa bijanye mukurikije igitigiri cavuzwe.

Ku musi ugira indwi muze mutegure amashuri indwi, impfizi z’intama zibiri n’imyagazi y’intama icumi n’ine imaze umwaka, vyose bibe bitagira agasembwa.
Kuri ayo mashuri, izo mpfizi z’intama n’iyo myagazi, muze mwongereko amashikanwa y’ifu n’ay’ibinyobwa bijanye mukurikije igitigiri cavuzwe.

Ku musi ugira umunani muze mugire ikoraniro ryera kandi ntihagire ico mukora.
Muze mutange ikimazi co guturirwa ubumote bwiza buhimbara Uhoraho , ikimazi co guturirwa kigizwe n’ishuri imwe, impfizi y’intama imwe n’imyagazi y’intama imaze umwaka, vyose bibe bitagira agasembwa.
Kuri iyo shuri, iyo mpfizi y’intama, n’iyo myagazi, muze mwongereko amashikanwa y’ifu n’amashikanwa y’ibinyobwa bijanye mukurikije ibitigiri vyatanzwe.
Muze mwongereko isuguru y’impene y’ikimazi c’ivyaha, ciyongera ku kimazi co guturirwa cama gitangwa ku musi ku musi n’ishikanwa ry’ifu n’iry’ibinyobwa bijanye.

Ivyo bimazi vyose muze mubishikanire Uhoraho ku misi mikuru uko yashinzwe. Mushobora kwongerako ivyo musezerana muvyishakiye bivuye ku mitima yanyu. Muze mutegurire Uhoraho mu misi mikuru: ibimazi vyanyu vyo kwoswa, amashikanwa y’ifu, amashikanwa y’ibinyobwa n’ibimazi vy’ishimwe.’ ”
Mose abarira Abisirayeli ivyo Uhoraho yamutegetse vyose.
Nuko Mose amenyesha abakuru b’imiryango y’Abisirayeli ati: “Ibi ni vyo Uhoraho yategetse:
Umuntu niyasezeranira Uhoraho gukora ikintu kanaka akagisezerana ashizeko n’indahiro, ntaze yirahuruze ariko aze ashire mu ngiro ivyo yavuze.
Umukobwa akiri mu nzu kwa se niyasezeranira Uhoraho kumushikanira ishikanwa canke kudakora ikintu ashizeko indahiro
hanyuma se wiwe akavyumva ariko ntagire ico abarira umukobwa wiwe, ivyo yasezeranye n’ivyo yarahiye bizogumaho.
Ariko se wiwe niyamubuza amaze kuvyumva, nta na kimwe mu vyo yasezeranye canke yarahiye gushitsa kizofata; Uhoraho azomubohora kuko se wiwe yamubujije.
Niyagira ubukwe amaze kurahira canke iminwa yiwe imaze guhurudukana isezerano rimuboha
hanyuma umugabo wiwe akavyumva ariko ntagire ico amubwira, ivyo yasezeranye n’iyo ndahiro bizogumaho.
Ariko umugabo wiwe niyavyumva hanyuma akamubuza, azoba ahagaritse iryo sezerano ryamuboha canke iyo ndahiro yapfuye kuvuga atiyumviriye neza ikamuboha, kandi Uhoraho azomubohora.
Isezerano canke indahiro bigizwe n’umupfakazi canke uwahukanye bizomuboha.
Umugore abana n’umugabo wiwe niyasezerana isezerano canke akarahira indahiro imuboha
hanyuma umugabo wiwe akavyumva ariko ntagire ico amubwira kandi ntamubuze, ivyo yasezeranye vyose n’ivyo yarahiye vyose bizogumaho.
Ariko uwo mugabo wiwe amaze kwumva ivyo yasezeranye agaca abihagarika ubwo nyene akivyumva iryo sezerano canke iyo ndahiro bizoba bihagaze. Umugabo wiwe azoba yabihinduye kandi Uhoraho azomubohora.
Umugabo wiwe ashobora kwemeza canke guhakana ivyo yibohesheje.
Ariko umugabo wiwe natagira ico abimubwirako hagaca umusi wose, azoba yemeje ivyo uwo mugore yasezeranye n’indahiro yarahiye zizomuboha. Azoba avyemeje kuko ata co yavuze amaze kuvyumva.
Ariko uwo mugabo niyabihindura amaze igihe avyumvise, ivyo uwo mugore yasezeranye bizoja ku mutwe w’uwo mugabo.”
Ayo ni yo mategeko Uhoraho yahaye Mose yerekeye imigenderanire hagati y’umugabo n’umugore wiwe, no hagati ya se n’umukobwa wiwe akiba mu nzu iwe.
Uhoraho abarira Mose ati:
“Genda utere Abamidiyani ubahoye ivyo bakoreye Abisirayeli. Inyuma y’aho uzoca uhamvya abanyu.”
Nuko Mose abarira abantu ati: “Nihagire abantu bo muri mwebwe bambara ibigwanisho baje kugwanya Abamidiyani kugira ngo bashitse uguhora kw’ Uhoraho kuri bo.
Umuryango wose mu Bisirayeli urungike abagabo igihumbi.”
Nuko abagabo ibihumbi cumi na bibiri mu Bisirayeli bambara ibigwanisho bitegurira kuja mu ntambara, umuryango wose urungika abagabo igihumbi.

Mose abarungika mu ntambara, ari igihumbi ku muryango wose, abarungikana Finehasi mwene Eliyazeri, umuherezi, ari we yatwaye ibikoresho vyera vyo mw’ihema hamwe n’inzamba zo gutanga ikimenyetso c’akamo k’intambara.
Bagwanya Abamidiyani, nk’uko Uhoraho yategetse Mose, bica abagabo bose.
Mu bo bishe harimwo Evi, Rekemu, Zuri, Huri na Reba, abami batanu b’i Midiyani. Bicisha inkota na Balamu mwene Beyori.
Abisirayeli bafata mpiri abagore n’abana b’Abamidiyani batwara n’amasho y’Abamidiyani, n’imikuku n’ibindi vyiza vyose.
Baturira ibisagara vyose Abamidiyani babamwo, n’amakambi yabo.
Batwara ibintu vyose n’abantu ivyo bari bigaruriye vyose,
babizanira Mose na Eliyazeri umuherezi n’ikoraniro ry’Abisirayeli bose aho bari bacumbitse mu biyaya vy’i Mowabu, ku nkombe ya Yorodani aharabana n’i Yeriko.
Mose, Eliyazeri umuherezi n’abakuru b’abantu bose baja kubasanganirira hanze y’aho bakoraniye.
Mose ashavurira abakuru b’ingabo; abarongoye ingabo igihumbi n’abatwara ingabo ijana; bari bavuye mu ntambara.
Arababarira ati: “Mbega mwakoze iki ko mwaretse abagore ntimubice?
Ni bo bakurikije inama bagiriwe na Balamu kandi ni bo batumye Abisirayeli bakevya bakava k’ Uhoraho mu vyabaye i Peyori, gushika n’aho ikiza gitera abantu.
Ubu rero nimwice abahungu bose. Kandi mwice umugore wese yaryamanye n’umugabo,
ariko mwisigarize abakobwa bose batigeze baryamana n’umugabo.
Umuntu wese wo muri mwebwe yishe umuntu canke yakoze ku wapfuye agume inyuma y’aho mucumbitse kumara imisi indwi. Ku musi wa gatatu no ku musi w’indwi muze mwihumanure mwebwe n’abanyagano banyu.
Muhumanure n’impuzu zose n’ikintu cose gikozwe mu rusato, mu bwoya bw’impene canke mu biti.”
Nuko Eliyazeri umuherezi abarira ingabo zagiye ku rugamba ati: “Ibi ni vyo Ivyagezwe Uhoraho yahaye Mose bivuga:
Inzahabu, ifeza, imiringa, ivyuma, n’ubundi butare

mbere n’ibindi vyose bidashobora gusha bize bishirwe mu muriro, ni ho bizoba bihumanuwe. Ariko kandi bize bihumanurwe n’amazi yo guhumanura. Kandi ikintu cose kidashobora kurinda umuriro, kize gicishwe muri ayo mazi.
Ku musi w’indwi muze mumesure impuzu zanyu namwe muzoba muhumanuwe. Ni ho muzoshobora kwinjira aho ducumbitse.”
Uhoraho abarira Mose ati:
“Wewe na Eliyazeri umuherezi n’abakuru b’imiryango y’ubu bwoko muze muharure abantu n’ibitungwa vyanyazwe.
Mugaburire ivyanyazwe abagabo bagiye kugwana n’abasigaye bo mw’ikoraniro.
Ku mugabane w’abasoda bagwanye mu ntambara, uze ukureko umugabane wanje jewe Uhoraho ungana n’ikintu kimwe ku bintu amajana atanu, baba ari abantu, amasho, indogoba intama canke impene.
Uze wakire uwo mugabane ku mugabane wabo uwushikirize Eliyazeri umuherezi nk’umugabane w’ Uhoraho .

Ku mugabane w’Abisirayeli, muze mutoranye kimwe ku bintu mirongo itanu, baba abantu, amasho, indogoba, intama, impene canke ibindi bitungwa vyose. Muze mubihe Abalewi, bashinzwe gutunganya ihema ry’ Uhoraho .”
Nuko Mose na Eliyazeri umuherezi bakora nk’uko Uhoraho yari yategetse Mose.
Ivyasigaye mu vyo abagiye ku rugamba banyaze vyari intama amajana atandatu na mirongo indwi na bitanu,
inka ibihumbi mirongo indwi na bibiri,
indogoba ibihumbi mirongo itandatu na kimwe
n’abakobwa batigeze baryamana n’umugabo ibihumbi mirongo itatu na bibiri.
Igice cegukira abagiye ku rugamba cari: Intama ibihumbi amajana atatu na mirongo itatu n’indwi n’amajana atanu,
muri izo umugabane w’ Uhoraho ukaba wari intama amajana atandatu na mirongo indwi na zitanu;
inka ibihumbi mirongo itatu na bitandatu, muri izo umugabane w’ Uhoraho ukaba wari inka mirongo indwi na zibiri;
indogoba ibihumbi mirongo itatu n’amajana atanu, muri izo umugabane w’ Uhoraho ukaba wari indogoba mirongo itandatu n’imwe;
abantu ibihumbi cumi na bitandatu, muri bo umugabane w’ Uhoraho ukaba wari abantu mirongo itatu na babiri.
Mose aha wa mugabane w’ Uhoraho Eliyazeri umuherezi, nk’uko Uhoraho yategetse Mose.
Igice cegukira Abisirayeli, ico Mose yari yashize ukwaco agitandukanya n’ic’abagiye ku rugamba;
ari co gice cagerewe abasigaye; cari intama ibihumbi amajana atatu na mirongo itatu n’indwi n’amajana atanu,
inka ibihumbi mirongo itatu na bitandatu,
indogoba ibihumbi mirongo itatu n’amajana atanu
n’abantu ibihumbi cumi na bitandatu.

Mu vyagenewe Abisirayeli, Mose akuramwo kimwe ku mirongo itanu baba abantu canke ibitungwa, nk’uko Uhoraho yari yamutegetse, aca abiha Abalewi, ari bo bari bajejwe igikorwa co gutunganya ihema ry’ Uhoraho .
Maze abakuru b’ingabo bari barongoye imice y’ingabo, baba abatwara imice y’abantu igihumbi canke abatwara imice y’abantu ijana, baja aho Mose ari,
baramubwira bati: “twebwe abasavyi bawe twaharuye ingabo turongoye, kandi nta n’umwe abuze.

None twari tuzanye ishikanwa k’ Uhoraho ry’ibikoresho vyose bikozwe mu nzahabu twaronse: imigufu, ivyo kwambara ku maboko, impeta, ivyo ku matwi; ngo tubitangeko ikimazi cacu co kwikurako icaha imbere y’ Uhoraho .”
Mose na Eliyazeri umuherezi babakirira izo nzahabu zari mu vyacuzwe vyose.
Inzahabu zatanzwe n’abarongoye imice y’ingabo igihumbi n’ijana izo Mose na Eliyazeri bashikaniye Uhoraho zapimye shekeli ibihumbi cumi na bitandatu n’amajana indwi na mirongo itanu.
Uwagiye ku rugamba wese yatwaye isahu yari yazanye.
Mose na Eliyazeri umuherezi bakira ivyo abo bakuru b’ingabo igihumbi n’ijana batanze bavyinjiza mw’Ihema ry’Ibonaniro nk’icibutso ku Bisirayeli imbere y’ Uhoraho .
Abareyubeni n’Abagadi, ari bo bari bafise amasho menshi n’imikuku myinshi, babona ko intara za Yazeri na Gileyadi zari nziza ku bitungwa.
Nuko baza aho Mose, Eliyazeri umuherezi n’abakuru b’abantu bari bari, baravuga bati:
“Ibisagara vy’i Ataroti, Diboni, Yazeri, Nimura, Heshiboni, Eliyalehi, Sebamu, Nebo na Beyoni;
intara Uhoraho yagabuye mu maboko y’Abisirayeli, ni ahantu heza ku bitungwa, kandi twebwe abasavyi banyu turafise ibitungwa.
Nitwaba tugiriwe ubuntu imbere yanyu, twemerere aha hantu hatwegukire nk’umugabane wacu. Twebwe ntitujabuke hakurya ya Yorodani.”
Mose abarira Abagadi n’Abareyubeni ati: “Abanyu boja mu ntambara namwe mwiyicariye ngaho?
Ni kuki mugomba guca intege Abisirayeli ngo ntibajabuke mu gihugu Uhoraho aduhaye?
Ivyo ni vyo ba so bakoze igihe nabarungika turi i Kadeshi Baruneya ngo bagende gutata ico gihugu.
Bamaze kuduga bajanye akabande k’i Eshikoli bararaba ico gihugu, bagarutse baciye intege Abisirayeli ngo ntibinjire ico gihugu Uhoraho yabahaye.
Ishavu ry’ Uhoraho ryaraduze aca ararahira kuri uwo musi ati:
‘Kuko batankurikiye n’umutima wose, nta n’umwe mu bantu bafise imyaka mirongo ibiri n’iyirenga yavuye muri Egiputa azobona igihugu nasezeraniye Aburahamu na Isaka na Yakobo;
nta n’umwe atari Kalebu mwene Yefune Umunyakenizi na Yosuwa mwene Nuni, kuko bakurikiye Uhoraho n’umutima wose.’
Ishavu ry’ Uhoraho ryaraziririnze ku Bisirayeli atuma bayerera mu bugaragwa imyaka mirongo ine, gushika aho urunganwe rwose rw’abari bakoze ibibi mu nyonga ziwe ruherengetera.
None ehe raba namwe, mwa kagwi k’abanyavyaha, muhagaze mu kibanza ca ba so mugomba gutuma Uhoraho ashavurira Abisirayeli mbere birengeje.
Nimwamutera umugongo, azosubira ate iri hanga ryose muri ubu bugaragwa, kandi ni mwebwe muzoba mubaye impamvu y’uguhona kwabo.”
Nuko basubira kuza aho ari baravuga bati: “Twagomba kwubaka impongore z’ibitungwa vyacu hano n’ibisagara vy’abagore bacu n’abana bacu.

Ariko turiteguye kwambara ibigwanisho no kuja imbere y’Abisirayeli gushika tubashikanye iwabo. Muri ico gihe abagore bacu n’abana bacu bazoba baba mu bisagara vyubakiwe inzitiro, kugira ngo bakingirwe abantu b’iki gihugu.
Ntituzotaha ngo tuje mu mazu yacu gushika aho Umwisirayeli wese azoba amaze kuronka umugabane wiwe.
Ntituzoronka umugabane hamwe na bo hakurya ya Yorodani, kuko umugabane wacu uzoba uri ngaha mu buseruko bwa Yorodani.”
Nuko Mose arababarira ati: “Nimwakora uko, nimwambara ibigwanisho imbere y’ Uhoraho mukagwana,
nimwajabuka Yorodani mwese mwambaye ibigwanisho imbere y’ Uhoraho gushika yirukanye abansi biwe,
igihugu nicafatwa imbere y’ Uhoraho , mushobora kugaruka mukaba abidegemvya imbere y’ Uhoraho n’imbere y’Abisirayeli. Kandi aha hantu hazobegukira imbere y’ Uhoraho .
Ariko nimutakora mutyo, muzoba mucumuye k’ Uhoraho ; kandi mumenye ko icaha canyu kizobakurikirana.
Nimwubake ibisagara vy’abagore banyu n’abana banyu n’impongore z’ibitungwa vyanyu, ariko muze mushitse ivyo mwasezeranye.”
Abagadi n’Abareyubeni babarira Mose bati: “Twebwe abasavyi bawe tuzokora nk’uko Uhoraho abidutegeka.
Abana bacu n’abagore bacu n’amasho yacu n’imikuku yacu bizoguma hano mu bisagara vy’i Gileyadi.
Ariko abasavyi bawe, umugabo wese yambaye ibigwanisho, tuzojabuka tugwane imbere y’ Uhoraho , nk’uko wabivuze nyakwubahwa.”
Maze Mose atanga amategeko aberekeye ayaha Eliyazeri umuherezi na Yosuwa mwene Nuni n’abakuru b’imiryango y’Abisirayeli.

Arababarira ati: “Abagadi n’Abareyubeni, umugabo wese niyambara ibigwanisho, bakajabukana namwe Yorodani imbere y’ Uhoraho , igihe igihugu kizoba kimaze gufatwa, muze mubahe igihugu c’i Gileyadi nk’umugabane wabo.
Ariko nibatajabukana namwe bambaye ibigwanisho, baze bemere basangire namwe umugabane i Kanani.”
Abagadi n’Abareyubeni barishura bati: “Abasavyi bawe tuzokora nk’uko Uhoraho yavuze.
Tuzojabuka muri Kanani imbere y’ Uhoraho kandi twambaye ibigwanisho, ariko umugabane wacu uzoba hakuno ya Yorodani.”

Nuko Mose aha Abagadi, Abareyubeni n’igice c’Abamanase bakomoka kuri Yosefu ubwami bwari ubwa Sihoni umwami w’Abamori n’ubwami bwa Ogi umwami w’i Bashani; igihugu cose n’ibisagara vyaho n’intara zihakikije.
Abagadi basubira kwubaka Diboni, Ataroti, Aroweri,
Aturoti-Shofani, Yazeri, Yogibeha,
Beti-Nimura n’i Beti-Harani nk’ibisagara bizitijwe inzitiro, kandi bubaka impongore z’ibitungwa vyabo.
Abareyubeni na bo basubira kwubaka i Heshiboni, i Eliyalehi, i Kiriyatayimu,
i Nebo, i Bayali-Meyoni (aya mazina yarahinduwe) n’i Sibuma. Ibisagara basubiyemwo baciye babiha ayandi mazina.
Abakomoka mu ruvyaro rwa Makiri mwene Manase baja i Gileyadi, barahafata basohora Abamori bari ngaho.
Nuko Mose aha Gileyadi Abamakiri, bakomoka kuri Manase, baca barahaba.
Yayiro, wo mu ruvyaro rwa Manase, afata ibigwati vyaho aca avyita Havoti Yayiro risobanurwa ngo ibigwati vy’i Yayiro.
Noba afata i Kenati n’ibigwati bihakikije aca ahita Nobati nk’uko izina ryiwe ryari.

headings.text: Imiryango yagabanye mu buseruko bwa Yorodani

verses.text: Uku ni ko urugendo rw’Abisirayeli rwagenze uhereye igihe bava muri Egiputa bari mu migwi barongowe na Mose na Aroni.
Mose yandika aho baciye hose mu rugendo rwabo abitegetswe n’ Uhoraho . Aha ni ho bagiye barahagarara:
Abisirayeli bavuye i Ramusesi ku musi ugira icumi na gatanu w’ukwezi kwa mbere, umusi wakurikira Pasika. Basohokana icubahiro imbere y’Abanyegiputa babaraba,
bariko barahamba imfura zabo, Uhoraho yari yahoneje; kuko Uhoraho yari yaciriye urubanza imana zabo.
Abisirayeli bava i Ramusesi bacumbika i Sukoti.
Bava i Sukoti bacumbika i Etamu, ku nkengera y’ubugaragwa.
Bava i Etamu, basubira inyuma baja i Pi Hahiroti, berekeye mu buseruko bw’i Bayali-Zefoni, baca bacumbika hafi y’i Migidoli.
Bava i Pi Hahiroti baca mu kiyaga bashika mu bugaragwa, bamaze kugenda imisi itatu mu bugaragwa bw’i Etamu, bacumbika i Mara.
Bava i Mara baja i Elimu, hari amariba icumi n’abiri n’ibigazi mirongo indwi, baca bacumbikaho.
Bava i Elimu bacumbika ku Kiyaga Gitukura.
Bava ku Kiyaga Gitukura bacumbika mu bugaragwa bw’i Sini.
Bava mu bugaragwa bw’i Sini bacumbika i Dofuka.
Bava i Dofuka bacumbika i Alushi.
Bava i Alushi bacumbika i Refidimu, aho abantu babuze amazi yo kunywa.
Bava i Refidimu bacumbika mu bugaragwa bw’i Sinayi.
Bava mu bugaragwa bw’i Sinayi bacumbika i Kiburoti Hatayava.
Bava i Kiburoti Hatayava bacumbika i Hazeroti.
Bava i Hazeroti bacumbika i Rituma.
Bava i Rituma bacumbika i Rimoni Peresi.
Bava i Rimoni Peresi bacumbika i Libuna.
Bava i Libuna bacumbika i Risa.
Bava i Risa bacumbika i Kehelata.
Bava i Kehelata bacumbika ku Musozi Sheferi.
Bava ku musozi Sheferi bacumbika i Harada.
Bava i Harada bacumbika i Makeloti.
Bava i Makeloti bacumbika i Tahati.
Bava i Tahati bacumbika i Tera
Bava i Tera bacumbika i Mituka
Bava i Mituka bacumbika i Hashimona.
Bava i Hashimona bacumbika i Mosera
Bava i Mosera bacumbika i Bene Yayakani.
Bava i Bene Yayakani bacumbika Hori Hagidugadi.
Bava i Hori Hagidugadi bacumbika i Yotubata
Bava i Yotubata bacumbika i Aburoma.
Bava i Aburoma bacumbika i Eziyoni Geberi.
Bava i Eziyoni Geberi bacumbika i Kadeshi, mu bugaragwa bw’i Zini.
Bava i Kadeshi bacumbika ku musozi Hori, ku rubibe rwa Edomu.
Aroni umuherezi aduga ku musozi Hori abitegetswe n’ Uhoraho , ari ho yapfiriye ku musi wa mbere w’ukwezi kwa gatanu w’umwaka ugira mirongo ine Abisirayeli bavuye muri Egiputa.
Aroni yari amaze imyaka ijana na mirongo ibiri n’itatu igihe yapfira ku musozi Hori.
Umwami w’Umunyakanani yatwara i Aradi, yaba muri Negebu ho muri Kanani, yumva ko Abisirayeli bariko baraza.
Bava ku musozi Hori bacumbika i Zalumona.
Bava i Zalumona bacumbika i Punoni.
Bava i Punoni bacumbika i Oboti.
Bava i Oboti bacumbika i Iye Abarimu, ku rubibe rwa Mowabu.
Bava i Iye Abarimu bacumbika i Diboni Gadi.
Bava i Diboni Gadi bacumbika i Alumoni-Dibulatayimu.
Bava i Alumoni-Dibulatayimu bacumbika mu misozi y’i Abarimu, hafi y’i Nebo.
Bava mu misozi y’i Abarimu bacumbika mu biyaya vy’i Mowabu ku nkombe ya Yorodani, aharabana n’i Yeriko.
Bacumbitse hafi ya Yorodani mu biyaya vy’i Mowabu, kuva i Beti-Yeshimoti gushika i Abeli-Shitimu.
Mu biyaya vy’i Mowabu i ruhande ya Yorodani n’i Yeriko hakurya ya Yorodani Uhoraho abarira Mose ati:
“Vugana n’Abisirayeli ubabwire uti: ‘Nimwajabuka Yorodani muja i Kanani,
muze musohore ababa muri ico gihugu bose. Muze mumenagure ibishushanyo bibajwe mu mabuye canke bicuzwe mu butare vy’ibigirwamana vyabo, musambure n’ibibanza vyabo vyo gusengeramwo ku misozi.
Muze mufate ico gihugu mukibemwo, kuko ndabahaye ico gihugu ngo kibe icanyu.

Muze mugabuze ico gihugu ubufindo, nk’uko imiryango yanyu iri, ku mugwi munini muze mutange umugabane munini, n’umugwi muto muwuhe umugabane muto. Aho ubufindo buzokwerekana hazoba ari ahabo mukigabure mukurikije amazu ya ba sogokuruza banyu.
Ariko nimutirukana ababa muri ico gihugu, abo muzosigaza bazoba nk’amahwa mu maso yanyu no mu mbavu zanyu. Bazobateza amagorwa mu gihugu mugiye kubamwo.
Nanje nzokorera mwebwe ivyo niteguye gukorera abo.’ ”
Uhoraho abarira Mose ati:
“Tegeka Abisirayeli ubabwire uti: ‘Nimwashika i Kanani, igihugu mugiye kwinjiramwo ngo kibe icanyu kizoba gifise imbibe zikurikira:
Urubibe rwanyu rwo mu bumanuko ruzoba rugarukira ku bugaragwa bw’i Zini, ku rubibe rw’igihugu ca Edomu. Mu buseruko, urubibe ruzotangurira aho Ikiyaga c’Umunyu giherera,
ruce mu bumanuko bw’akadugo ka Akurabimu, n’i Zini, ruce no mu bumanuko bwa Kadeshi Baruneya. Ruzobandanya ruce i Hazari-Adari n’i Azimoni,
ruce rukebanuka, rufatane n’umugezi Wadi wa Egiputa ruruhukire ku Kiyaga Mediterane.
Urubibe rwanyu rwo mu burengero ruzoba ari Ikiyaga Mediterane. Urwo ni rwo ruzoba urubibe rwanyu rwo mu burengero.
Ku vyerekeye urubibe rwanyu rwo mu buraruko, muze muve ku Kiyaga Mediterane mushike ku musozi Hori
no kuva ku musozi Hori mushike i Lebo-Hamati. Maze urwo rubibe ruze rubandanye gushika i Sedadi,
rushishikare gushika i Zifuroni ruherere i Hazari-Enani. Urwo ni rwo ruzoba urubibe rwanyu rwo mu buraruko.
Ku vyerekeye urubibe rwanyu rwo mu buseruko, ruze ruve i Hazari-Enani rushike i Shefamu.
Urwo rubibe ruze rumanuke kuva i Shefamu ruja i Ribula ku ruhande rwo mu buseruko bwa Ayini rushishikare gushika ku nkombe z’Ikiyaga c’i Kinereti.
Maze urwo rubibe ruze rumanuke rujane Yorodani rushike ku Kiyaga c’Umunyu. Ico ni co kizoba igihugu canyu, kizoba gifise imbibe zaco impande zose.’ ”
Mose ategeka Abisirayeli ati: “Muze mugabure ico gihugu mukoresheje ubupfindo nk’umugabane wanyu. Uhoraho yategetse ko kizogaburirwa imiryango icenda n’igice,
kuko imiryango ya Reyubeni, na Gadi n’igice c’umuryango wa Manase baronse imigabane yabo.
Iyo miryango ibiri n’igice yaronse umugabane wayo mu buseruko bwa Yorodani hakurya ya Yeriko.”
Uhoraho abarira Mose ati:
“Aya ni yo mazina y’abantu bazobagaburira ico gihugu nk’umugabane wanyu: Eliyazeri umuherezi na Yosuwa mwene Nuni.
Kandi uze utore umukuru umwe mu muryango wose wo gufasha kugabura ico gihugu.
Aya ni yo mazina yabo: Kalebu mwene Yefune, wo mu muryango wa Yuda;
Samweli mwene Amihudi, wo mu muryango wa Simeyoni;
Elidadi mwene Kisiloni, wo mu muryango wa Benyamini;
Buki mwene Yoguli, umukuru wo mu muryango wa Dani;
Haniyeli mwene Efodi, umukuru wo mu muryango wa Manase mwene Yosefu;
Kemuweli mwene Shifutani, umukuru wo mu muryango wa Efurayimu mwene Yosefu;
Elizafani mwene Parunaki, umukuru wo mu muryango wa Zebuloni;
Palutiyeli mwene Azani, umukuru wo mu muryango wa Isakari;
Ahihudi mwene Shelomi, umukuru wo mu muryango wa Asheri;
Pedaheli mwene Amihudi, umukuru wo mu muryango wa Nafutali.”
Abo ni bo bagabo Uhoraho yategetse ko batorwa ngo bagaburire Abisirayeli imigabane yabo mu gihugu c’i Kanani.
Mu biyaya vy’i Mowabu ku nkengera z’uruzi Yorodani hakurya ya Yeriko, Uhoraho abarira Mose ati:
“Bwira Abisirayeli baze bahe Abalewi ibisagara vyo kubamwo bivuye mu mugabane Abisirayeli bazoronka. Kandi babahe n’uburagiro i ruhande y’ivyo bisagara.
Ni ho bazoronka ibisagara vyo kubamwo n’uburagiro bw’amasho yabo, imikuku yabo n’ibindi vyose batunze.
Uburagiro buzoba buri inyuma y’ibisagara muzoha Abalewi buzoba bushika ku ngero z’igice c’ukuboko igihumbi uvuye ku ruzitiro rw’igisagara.

Inyuma y’igisagara, muze mupime ingero z’igice c’ukuboko ibihumbi bibiri mu buseruko, ingero z’igice c’ukuboko ibihumbi bibiri mu bumanuko, ingero z’igice c’ukuboko ibihumbi bibiri mu burengero n’ingero z’igice c’ukuboko ibihumbi bibiri mu buraruko, igisagara na co kibe hagati. Ubwo buzoba ari uburagiro bwabo bwegukira ivyo bisagara.
Ibisagara bitandatu mu vyo muzoha Abalewi bize bibe ibisagara vy’ubuhungiro, ivyo umuntu yishe uwundi azoshobora guhungiramwo. Kuri ivyo, muze mwongereko ibisagara mirongo ine na bibiri.
Vyose hamwe muze muhe Abalewi ibisagara mirongo ine n’umunani, biri kumwe n’uburagiro bwavyo.

Ibisagara muzoha Abalewi mu gihugu Abisirayeli bagiye kuzokwegukira bize bitangwe muravye uko umugabane w’umuryango wose ungana: muze mutange ibisagara vyinshi ku muryango ufise abantu benshi, ariko ku wufise bake muze mutange bike.”
Nuko Uhoraho abarira Mose ati:
“Vugana n’Abisirayeli ubabwire uti: ‘Nimwajabuka Yorodani muja i Kanani,
muze mutoranye ibisagara bimwe kuba ibisagara vy’ubuhungiro, ivyo umuntu azoba yishe uwundi atabiteguye azohungiramwo.
Bizoba ibibanza vyo guhungiramwo umuhozi, kugira ngo uwo muntu yagirizwa ubwicanyi ntapfe ataracirirwa urubanza imbere y’ikoraniro.
Ivyo bisagara bitandatu bizoba ibisagara vy’ubuhungiro.
Muze mutange ibisagara bitatu hakuno ya Yorodani na bitatu i Kanani.
Ivyo bisagara uko ari bitandatu bize bibe ivyo guhungiramwo ku Bisirayeli, inyambukira canke uwundi muntu wese aba hagati muri mwebwe, kugira ngo uwishe uwundi atabishaka ashobore guhungirayo.
Umuntu niyakubita uwundi icuma agaca apfa, azoba ari umwicanyi; uwo mwicanyi aze yicwe.
Canke umuntu azoba afise ibuye mu ntoke rishobora kwica, akaritera uwundi ngo apfe, azoba ari umwicanyi; uwo mwicanyi aze yicwe.
Kandi umuntu niyaba afise ikintu gikozwe mu giti mu ntoke gishobora kwica, hanyuma akagikubita umuntu kugira ngo apfe, ni umwicanyi; uwo mwicanyi aze yicwe.
Uwuhora amaraso yasheshwe aze yice uwo mwicanyi; niyahura na we, aze amwice.
Umuntu niyasunika mugenziwe n’inzigo canke akamutera ikintu afise intumbero yo kumwica
canke akamukubita ingumu n’inzigo kugira ngo apfe, azoba ari umwicanyi. Uwujejwe guhora amaraso yasheshwe aze yice uwo mwicanyi niyahura na we.
Ariko umuntu niyica mugenziwe ata nzigo yari amufitiye mu kumusunika atabigabiye canke akamutera ikintu
canke akamurekurirako ibuye atamubonye bigatuma apfa, ko atari umwansi wiwe kandi atari yagabiye kumugirira nabi,
ikoraniro rize ribacire urubanza we n’umuhozi bisunze aya mategeko.

Ikoraniro rize rikingire uwagirijwe ko yishe umuntu ngo umuhozi ntamwice kandi baze bamurungike asubire mu gisagara c’ubuhungiro aho yari yahungiye. Aze agumeyo gushika aho umuherezi mukuru azopfira, uwarobanujwe amavuta yo kurobanura.
Ariko uwo yagirizwa niyaja hanze akarenga imbibe z’igisagara c’ubuhungiro yahungiyemwo
maze umuhozi akamusanga hanze y’ico gisagara, uwo muhozi ashobora kumwica kandi ntazotsindwa n’urubanza ko ari umwicanyi.
Uwo yagirizwa ategerezwa kuguma mu gisagara c’ubuhungiro gushika aho umuherezi mukuru azopfira; inyuma y’urupfu rw’umuherezi mukuru ni ho honyene yemerewe gusubira iwe.
Aya azobe amategeko mugenderako uko urunganwe ruzokurikirana n’urundi, aho muzoba muba hose.
Umuntu wese azokwica uwundi aze yicwe nk’umwicanyi ariko nihaboneka abamwagiriza. Ariko ntihaze hagire uwicwa hisunzwe ivyavuzwe n’icabona kimwe.
Ntimuze mwemere incungu y’umwicanyi, kandi ategerezwa gupfa. Ntaze abure kwicwa.
Ntimuze mwemere incungu y’uwahungiye mu gisagara c’ubuhungiro ngo mumwemerere kugaruka ngo abe iwe imbere y’uko umuherezi mukuru apfa.
Ntimuze muhumanye igihugu mubamwo. Amaraso asheshwe ahumanya igihugu, kandi nta mpongano ishobora gutangwa aho amaraso yasesetse, atari amaraso y’uwayasheshe.
Ntimuze muhumanye igihugu mubamwo kuko nanje ari ho mba. Ndi Uhoraho kandi mba hagati mu Bisirayeli.’ ”
Abakuru b’umuryango wa Gileyadi mwene Makiri, Makiri mwene Manase, bari abo mu ruvyaro rwa Yosefu, baza kuvugana na Mose n’abakuru b’imiryango y’Abisirayeli.
Baravuga bati: “Nyakwubahwa, igihe Uhoraho yakubwira, ko uzogaburira Abisirayeli igihugu ukoresheje ubupfindo, yavuze ko uzoha umugabane w’umuvukanyi wacu Zelofehadi abakobwa biwe.
Hamwe borongorwa n’abo mu yindi miryango y’Abisirayeli; umugabane wabo woca uja mu muryango bagiyemwo, ukava ku mugabane w’umuryango wacu. Aho rero igice c’umugabane wari uwacu woba ugiye ahandi.
Umwaka wa Yubile y’Abisirayeli ushitse, umugabane wabo uzoca wegukira wa muryango barongowemwo, maze ukurwe ku mugabane wa ba sogokuru.”
Nuko Mose atanga iri tegeko ku Bisirayeli abibwiwe n’ Uhoraho ati: “Ivyo ab’umuryango wa Yosefu bariko baravuga ni vyo.
Ibi ni vyo Uhoraho ategetse abakobwa ba Zelofehadi: bashobora kurongorwa n’uwo bipfuza, ariko aze abe ari uwo mu muryango wa ba sekuru.
Ntihaze hagire umugabane w’umuryango uzoja mu wundi muryango, kuko Umwisirayeli wese azogumya umugabane yahawe mu muryango wiwe.
Umukobwa wese azoragwa itongo mu muryango wose w’Abisirayeli, azotegerezwa kurongorwa mu muryango wa ba sekuru, kugira ngo Umwisirayeli wese aze agumane umugabane wa ba sekuru biwe.
Ntihaze hagire umugabane uva mu muryango ngo uje mu wundi, nuko rero umuryango wose w’Abisirayeli uze ugumye itongo warazwe.”
Nuko abakobwa ba Zelofehadi bakora nk’uko Uhoraho yategetse Mose.
Abakobwa ba Zelofehadi: Mahala, Tiriza, Hogula, Milika na Noha, barongorwa na bavyara babo bo mu muryango wa se.
Barongowe mu muryango wa Manase mwene Yosefu, maze umugabane wabo uca uguma mu muryango wa sewabo.
Ayo ni yo mategeko n’amabwirizwa Uhoraho yahaye Abisirayeli abicishije kuri Mose bari mu biyaya vy’i Mowabu ku nkombe ya Yorodani hakurya ya Yeriko.
